debug = {
    getconstant = function(f, idx)
        if _type(f) ~= "function" then
            return nil
        end
        if _is_internal_fn(f) then
            return nil
        end
        local i = 1
        local results = {}
        while true do
            local ok, name, val = _pcall(dbg.getupvalue, f, i)
            if not ok or not name then
                break
            end
            results[i] = val
            i = i + 1
        end
        return results[idx]
    end,
    getconstants = function(f)
        if _type(f) ~= "function" then
            return {}
        end
        if _is_internal_fn(f) then
            return {}
        end
        local results = {}
        local i = 1
        while true do
            local ok, name, val = _pcall(dbg.getupvalue, f, i)
            if not ok or not name then
                break
            end
            results[i] = val
            i = i + 1
        end
        return results
    end,
    getupvalue = function(f, idx)
        if _type(f) ~= "function" then
            return nil
        end
        if _is_internal_fn(f) or env_functions[f] or _cc_closures[f] then
            return nil
        end
        local ok, src = _pcall(dbg.info, f, "s")
        if ok and src == "=[C]" then
            return nil
        end
        if dbg and dbg.getupvalue then
            local ok2, uvname, uvval = _pcall(dbg.getupvalue, f, idx)
            if ok2 and uvname ~= nil then
                return uvname, uvval
            end
        end
        return nil
    end,
    getupvalues = function(f)
        if _type(f) ~= "function" then
            return {}
        end
        if _is_internal_fn(f) then
            return {}
        end
        local result = {}
        local i = 1
        while true do
            local ok, name, val = _pcall(dbg.getupvalue, f, i)
            if not ok or not name then
                break
            end
            result[i] = val
            result[name] = val
            i = i + 1
        end
        return result
    end,
    setconstant = function(f, idx, val)
        if _type(f) ~= "function" then
            return
        end
        if _is_internal_fn(f) then
            return
        end
        if dbg.setupvalue then
            _pcall(dbg.setupvalue, f, idx, val)
        end
        st.uv_override = st.uv_override or {}
        st.uv_override[f] = st.uv_override[f] or {}
        st.uv_override[f][idx] = val
    end,
    setstack = function(lvl, idx, val)
        st.fakestack = st.fakestack or {}
        st.fakestack[idx] = val
    end,
    getstack = function(lvl, idx)
        st.fakestack = st.fakestack or { "ab" }
        if idx then
            return st.fakestack[idx] or "ab"
        end
        return st.fakestack
    end,
    setupvalue = function(f, idx, val)
        if _type(f) ~= "function" then
            return false
        end
        if _is_internal_fn(f) then
            return false
        end
        local ok = dbg.setupvalue and _pcall(dbg.setupvalue, f, idx, val)
            or false
        st.uv_override = st.uv_override or {}
        st.uv_override[f] = st.uv_override[f] or {}
        st.uv_override[f][idx] = val
        return true
    end,
    getinfo = function(f, opts)
        local resolved_f = f
        if _type(f) == "number" then
            local ok, func = _pcall(dbg.info, f + 1, "f")
            if ok and func then
                resolved_f = func
            end
        end
        local base = {}
        base.func = resolved_f
        if _type(resolved_f) == "function" then
            local is_c = env_functions[resolved_f] or _cc_closures[resolved_f]
            if not is_c then
                local c_natives = {print, warn, tostring, tonumber, pairs, ipairs,
                    next, rawget, rawset, rawequal, unpack, select, assert,
                    pcall, xpcall, setmetatable, getmetatable, type, error, collectgarbage}
                for _, fn in _ipairs(c_natives) do
                    if rawequal(fn, resolved_f) then is_c = true; break end
                end
            end
            if not is_c then
                local ok, src = _pcall(dbg.info, resolved_f, "s")
                is_c = not ok or src == "[C]"
            end
            base.what = is_c and "C" or "Lua" or "C"
            base.source = (ok and src) or "[C]"
            base.short_src = base.source
            local ok2, nparams, isva = _pcall(dbg.info, resolved_f, "a")
            if ok2 then
                base.numparams = nparams or 0
                base.is_vararg = isva and 1 or 0
            end
            local ok3, name = _pcall(dbg.info, resolved_f, "n")
            if ok3 then
                base.name = name or ""
            end
        else
            base.what = "C"
            base.source = "[C]"
            base.short_src = "[C]"
        end
        base.currentline = -1
        base.nups = 0
        base.numparams = base.numparams or 0
        base.is_vararg = base.is_vararg or 0
        base.name = base.name or ""
        base.linedefined = -1
        base.lastlinedefined = -1
        return base
    end,
    getproto = function(f, idx, activated)
        local inner = nil
        if _type(f) == "function" then
            local i = 1
            while true do
                local ok, name, val =
                    _pcall(dbg.getupvalue or function() end, f, i)
                if not ok or not name then
                    break
                end
                if _type(val) == "function" then
                    inner = val
                    break
                end
                i = i + 1
            end
        end
        inner = inner or function()
            return 1
        end
        if activated then
            return { inner }
        end
        return inner
    end,
    getprotos = function(f)
        return {}
    end,
    getmetatable = _getmt,
    setmetatable = _setmt,
    traceback = function(msg, level)
        level = level or 1
        local ok, tb = _pcall(function()
            return _traceback(_tostring(msg or ""), level + 1)
        end)
        if ok and _type(tb) == "string" then
            return clean_traceback(tb)
        end
        return _tostring(msg or "")
    end,
    getregistry = function()
        local reg = {}
        reg[1] = _G
        if st and st.sandbox then
            reg[2] = st.sandbox
        end
        return reg
    end,
    getlocal = function(level, idx)
        st.fakelocals = st.fakelocals or { "_local1", "_local2", "_local3" }
        local name = st.fakelocals[idx] or ("v" .. _tostring(idx))
        return name, nil
    end,
    setlocal = function(level, idx, val)
        st.fakelocals = st.fakelocals or {}
        st.fakelocals[idx] = val
        return true
    end,
    setproto = function(f, proto)
        return f
    end,
    validlevel = function(f)
        return true
    end,
    info = function(thread_or_funcOrLevel, funcOrLevel_or_opts, opts_or_nil)
        local thread, fn, opts
        if _type(thread_or_funcOrLevel) == "thread" then
            thread = thread_or_funcOrLevel
            fn = funcOrLevel_or_opts
            opts = opts_or_nil
        else
            fn = thread_or_funcOrLevel
            opts = funcOrLevel_or_opts
        end
        if _type(fn) == "number" then
            local current_user_frame = 0
            local target_fn
            for depth = 1, 100 do
                local ok, f
                if thread then
                    ok, f = _pcall(dbg.info, thread, depth, "f")
                else
                    ok, f = _pcall(dbg.info, depth, "f")
                end
                if not ok or not f then
                    break
                end
                local ok2, src = _pcall(dbg.info, f, "s")
                if
                    ok2
                    and (
                        src == "script"
                        or src == '[string "script"]'
                        or src == "=@script"
                        or src == "=script"
                        or src:match("script")
                        or src:match("str_input")
                    )
                then
                    current_user_frame = current_user_frame + 1
                    if current_user_frame == fn then
                        target_fn = f
                        break
                    end
                end
            end
            fn = target_fn or fn
        end
        local is_c = false
        if _type(fn) == "function" then
            if env_functions[fn] or _cc_closures[fn] then
                is_c = true
            else
                local ok, src = _pcall(dbg.info, fn, "s")
                if not ok or src == "[C]" or (src and (src:find("aspect") or src:find("lune") or src:find("4sp3ct"))) then
                    is_c = true
                end
            end
        end
        local results = {}
        local optsStr = _tostring(opts or "")
        for i = 1, #optsStr do
            local c = optsStr:sub(i, i)
            if c == "f" then
                table.insert(results, fn)
            elseif c == "l" then
                if _type(fn) == "function" then
                    if is_c then
                        table.insert(results, -1)
                    else
                        local ok, line = _pcall(dbg.info, fn, "l")
                        table.insert(
                            results,
                            (ok and _type(line) == "number") and line or 0
                        )
                    end
                else
                    table.insert(results, -1)
                end
            elseif c == "a" then
                if _type(fn) == "function" then
                    local ok, np, isva = _pcall(dbg.info, fn, "a")
                    if ok then
                        table.insert(results, np or 0)
                        table.insert(results, isva == true)
                    else
                        table.insert(results, 0)
                        table.insert(results, false)
                    end
                else
                    table.insert(results, 0)
                    table.insert(results, false)
                end
            elseif c == "s" then
                if _type(fn) == "function" then
                    if is_c then
                        table.insert(results, "[C]")
                    else
                        local ok, src = _pcall(dbg.info, fn, "s")
                        local clean_src = (ok and src) or "[C]"
                        if
                            clean_src:find("aspect") or clean_src:find("lune") or clean_src:find("4sp3ct")
                        then
                            clean_src = "[C]"
                        end
                        table.insert(results, clean_src)
                    end
                else
                    table.insert(results, "[C]")
                end
            elseif c == "n" then
                if _func_names[fn] then
                    table.insert(results, _func_names[fn])
                else
                    local ok, name = _pcall(dbg.info, fn, "n")
                    table.insert(results, (ok and name) or nil)
                end
            end
        end
        return _unpack(results)
    end,
}
WebSocket = {
    connect = function(url)
        local ws = {}
        local pn = q(safestr(url))
        out(string.format("local ASPws = WebSocket.connect(%s)", pn))
        ws.Send = function(self, data)
            out(string.format("ASPws:Send(%s)", ser(data)))
        end
        ws.Close = function(self)
            out("ASPws:Close()")
        end
        ws.OnMessage = mkpx("WebSocket.OnMessage", false)
        ws.OnClose = mkpx("WebSocket.OnClose", false)
        rawset(ws.OnMessage, "__signal", true)
        rawset(ws.OnClose, "__signal", true)
        st.reg[ws.OnMessage] = "ASPws.OnMessage"
        st.reg[ws.OnClose] = "ASPws.OnClose"
        return ws
    end,
}

local b = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
local function base64_decode(data)
    data = data:gsub("[^" .. b .. "=]", "")
    return (
        data:gsub(".", function(x)
            if x == "=" then
                return ""
            end
            local r, f = "", (b:find(x) - 1)
            for i = 6, 1, -1 do
                r = r .. (f % 2 ^ i - f % 2 ^ (i - 1) > 0 and "1" or "0")
            end
            return r
        end):gsub("%d%d%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?", function(x)
            if #x ~= 8 then
                return ""
            end
            local c = 0
            for i = 1, 8 do
                c = c + (x:sub(i, i) == "1" and 2 ^ (8 - i) or 0)
            end
            return string.char(c)
        end)
    )
end

function base64.decode(s)
    local v = mkvar(s, "decoded")

function crypt.base64.encode(data)
    local v = mkvar(data, "encoded")
    out(string.format("local %s = crypt.base64.encode(%s)", v, ser(data)))
    local b = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
    return (
        (data:gsub(".", function(x)
            local r, byte = "", x:byte()
            for i = 8, 1, -1 do
                r = r .. (byte % 2 ^ i - byte % 2 ^ (i - 1) > 0 and "1" or "0")
            end
            return r
        end) .. "0000"):gsub("%d%d%d?%d?%d?%d?", function(x)
            if #x < 6 then
                return ""
            end
            local c = 0
            for i = 1, 6 do
                c = c + (x:sub(i, i) == "1" and 2 ^ (6 - i) or 0)
            end
            return b:sub(c + 1, c + 1)
        end) .. ({ "", "==", "=" })[#data % 3 + 1]
    )
end
function crypt.base64.decode(s)
    local v = mkvar(s, "decoded")
    out(string.format("local %s = crypt.base64.decode(%s)", v, ser(s)))
    return base64_decode(s)
end

crypt.generatebytes = function(size)
    local s = tonumber(size) or 16
    local bytes = {}
    for i = 1, s do
        bytes[i] = string.char(math.random(0, 255))
    end
    local v = mkvar(_tostring(size), "bytes")
    out(string.format("local %s = crypt.generatebytes(%s)", v, crypt.base64encode(table.concat(bytes))))
    return crypt.base64encode(table.concat(bytes))
end
crypt.generatekey = function()
    local bytes = {}
    for i = 1, 32 do
        bytes[i] = string.char(math.random(0, 255))
    end
    local raw = table.concat(bytes)
    local v = mkvar(raw, "key")
    out(string.format("local %s = crypt.generatekey()", v))
    return crypt.base64encode(raw)
end
function crypt.hash(data, algo)
    return string.rep("0", 64)
end
function crypt.hexencode(str)
    local v = mkvar(str, "encoded")
    out(string.format("local %s = crypt.hexencode(%s)", v, ser(str)))
    return (string.gsub(str, ".", function(c)
        return string.format("%02x", string.byte(c))
    end))
end
function crypt.hexdecode(hex_str)
    local v = mkvar(hex_str, "decoded")
    out(string.format("local %s = crypt.hexdecode(%s)", v, ser(hex_str)))
    return (string.gsub(hex_str, "%x%x", function(cc)
        return string.char(tonumber(cc, 16))
    end))
end

local _invalidated_cache = {}
local _replaced_cache = {}
cache = {
    invalidate = function(obj)
        if not obj then return end
        local pn = st.reg[obj] or "obj"
        out(string.format("cache.invalidate(%s)", ser(pn)))
        _invalidated_cache[obj] = true
    end,
    iscached = function(obj)
        local v = mkvar(obj, "cached")
        out(string.format("local %s = cache.iscached(%s)", v, ser(pn)))
        if not obj then return false end
        return not _invalidated_cache[obj]
    end,
    replace = function(obj, newobj)
        if not obj then return end
        local pn = st.reg[obj] or "obj"
        local nn = st.reg[newobj] or "newobj"
        out(string.format("cache.replace(%s, %s)", ser(pn), ser(nn)))
        _invalidated_cache[obj] = true
        st._replaced_cache[obj] = newobj
        st._replaced_cache[newobj] = obj
        if st.reg[obj] then
            st.reg[newobj] = st.reg[obj]
            st.revreg[st.reg[obj]] = newobj
        end
        st.propstore[newobj] = st.propstore[obj]
        st.parentmap[newobj] = st.parentmap[obj]
    end,
}
local custom_buffer = {}
custom_buffer = {
    fromstring = function(s)
        local src = type(s) == "string" and s or ""
        local b = mkpx("bufFromStr", false)
        local bv = mkvar(b, "buf")
        out(string.format("local %s = custom_buffer.fromstring(%s)", bv, ser(s)))
        st.propstore[b] = st.propstore[b] or {}
        st.propstore[b]._bufstr = src
        return b
    end,
    tostring = function(b)
        if type(b) == "string" then return b end
        if isproxy(b) then
            local src = get_buf_str(b)
            st.lctr = st.lctr + 1
            local rv = "bufStr_" .. st.lctr
            local pn = st.reg[b] or "buf"
            out(string.format("local %s = custom_buffer.tostring(%s)", rv, pn))
            return src
        end
        return ""
    end,
    create = function(sz)
        local b = mkpx("buffer_" .. tostring(sz), false)
        local bv = mkvar(b, "buf")
        out(string.format("local %s = custom_buffer.create(%s)", bv, ser(sz)))
        st.propstore[b] = st.propstore[b] or {}
        st.propstore[b]._bufstr = string.rep("\0", tonumber(sz) or 0)
        return b
    end,
    len = function(b)
        if isproxy(b) then return #get_buf_str(b) end
        return 0
    end,
    readu8 = function(b, o) return 0 end,
    readi8 = function(b, o) return 0 end,
    readu16 = function(b, o) return 0 end,
    readi16 = function(b, o) return 0 end,
    readu32 = function(b, o) return 0 end,
    readi32 = function(b, o) return 0 end,
    readf32 = function(b, o) return 0.0 end,
    readf64 = function(b, o) return 0.0 end,
    readstring = function(b, o, n) return "" end,
    writeu8 = function() end,
    writei8 = function() end,
    writeu16 = function() end,
    writei16 = function() end,
    writeu32 = function() end,
    writei32 = function() end,
    writef32 = function() end,
    writef64 = function() end,
    writestring = function() end,
    copy = function() end,
    fill = function() end,
}
custom_buffer.__index = custom_buffer
function custom_buffer.new()
    local self = _setmt({}, custom_buffer)
    self.parts = {}
    self.length = 0
    return self
end
function custom_buffer:append(...)
    local args = { ... }
    for i = 1, #args do
        local str = _tostring(args[i])
        table.insert(self.parts, str)
        self.length = self.length + #str
    end
    return self
end
function custom_buffer:appendln(...)
    self:append(...)
    return self:append("\n")
end
function custom_buffer:prepend(str)
    str = _tostring(str)
    table.insert(self.parts, 1, str)
    self.length = self.length + #str
    return self
end
function custom_buffer:len()
    return self.length
end
function custom_buffer:clear()
    self.parts = {}
    self.length = 0
    return self
end
function custom_buffer:tostring()
    return table.concat(self.parts)
end
function custom_buffer:__tostring()
    return self:tostring()
end
function custom_buffer:__concat(other)
    return self:tostring() .. _tostring(other)
end
function custom_buffer:sub(i, j)
    return self:tostring():sub(i, j)
end
function custom_buffer:isempty()
    return self.length == 0
end
function custom_buffer:insert(pos, str)
    str = _tostring(str)
    table.insert(self.parts, pos, str)
    self.length = self.length + #str
    return self
end
function custom_buffer:pop()
    if #self.parts == 0 then
        return nil
    end
    local part = table.remove(self.parts)
    self.length = self.length - #part
    return part
end
function custom_buffer:join(separator, ...)
    local args = { ... }
    for i = 1, #args do
        if i > 1 then
            self:append(separator)
        end
        self:append(args[i])
    end
    return self
end
function custom_buffer:format(fmt, ...)
    return self:append(string.format(fmt, ...))
end
function custom_buffer:rep(str, n)
    for i = 1, n do
        self:append(str)
    end
    return self
end
function custom_buffer:parts_count()
    return #self.parts
end
function custom_buffer:optimize()
    if #self.parts > 1 then
        local str = table.concat(self.parts)
        self.parts = { str }
    end
    return self
end
function custom_buffer:write_to_file(filename)
    local file, err = io.open(filename, "w")
    if not file then
        return nil, err
    end
    file:write(self:tostring())
    file:close()
    return true
end
function custom_buffer.from_file(filename)
    local file, err = io.open(filename, "r")
    if not file then
        return nil, err
    end
    local content = file:read("*all")
    file:close()
    local buf = custom_buffer.new()
    buf:append(content)
    return buf
end
function custom_buffer:clone()
    local new_buf = custom_buffer.new()
    for i = 1, #self.parts do
        table.insert(new_buf.parts, self.parts[i])
    end
    new_buf.length = self.length
    return new_buf
end
function custom_buffer:iter_parts()
    local i = 0
    return function()
        i = i + 1
        if i <= #self.parts then
            return self.parts[i]
        end
    end
end

_cor = coroutine
local hcor = {
    create = function(f)
        return _cor.create(function(...)
            return f(...)
        end)
    end,
    wrap = function(f)
        return _cor.wrap(function(...)
            return f(...)
        end)
    end,
    resume = function(co, ...)
        local res = { _cor.resume(co, ...) }
        if not res[1] then
            local e = res[2]
            if _type(e) == "string" and e:match("TIMEOUT") then
                error(e)
            end
        end
        return _unpack(res)
    end,
    yield = _cor.yield,
    status = _cor.status,
    running = _cor.running,
    isyieldable = _cor.isyieldable or function()
        return true
    end,
    close = _cor.close or function()
        return true
    end,
}

-- helper: extract first argument expression from a source-line call like fname(arg1, ...)
local function extract_first_call_arg(fname, line_code)
    if not line_code then return nil end
    local inner = line_code:match(fname .. "%s*(%b())")
    if not inner then return nil end
    inner = inner:sub(2, -2)
    local depth = 0
    local first_arg = ""
    for ci = 1, #inner do
        local ch = inner:sub(ci, ci)
        if ch == "(" or ch == "[" or ch == "{" then depth = depth + 1
        elseif ch == ")" or ch == "]" or ch == "}" then depth = depth - 1
        elseif ch == "," and depth == 0 then break
        end
        first_arg = first_arg .. ch
    end
    first_arg = first_arg:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
    return (first_arg ~= "") and first_arg or nil
end

local _assert = assert
assert = function(v, ...)
    local l, line_code = get_current_script_line()
    if l then
        local sargs = {}
        local hidden_comment = nil

        -- if condition evaluated to nil/false, recover the original expression from source
        if (v == nil or v == false) then
            local orig = extract_first_call_arg("assert", line_code)
            if orig then
                hidden_comment = orig
            end
            table.insert(sargs, "nil")
        elseif isproxy(v) then
            table.insert(sargs, st.reg[v] or "nil")
        else
            table.insert(sargs, ser(v))
        end

        local n = _select("#", ...)
        for i = 1, n do
            local a = _select(i, ...)
            table.insert(sargs, ser(a))
        end

        local call_str = string.format("assert(%s)", table.concat(sargs, ", "))
        if hidden_comment then
            call_str = call_str .. " -- " .. hidden_comment
        end
        out(call_str)
    end
    -- don't propagate an assert failure into the dumper itself; just log it
    if v == nil or v == false then
        return nil
    end
    return _assert(v, ...)
end
_G.assert = assert

select = function(idx, ...)
    if idx == "#" then
        return _select("#", ...)
    end
    local args = {...}
    for _, v in _ipairs(args) do
        if isproxy(v) then
            local pn = st.reg[v] or "obj"
            out(string.format("select(%s, %s)", ser(idx), pn))
            break
        end
    end
    return _select(idx, ...)
end
_G.select = select

-- hooked tostring: log and return a string-proxy when called on a Roblox proxy
local _tostring_orig = tostring
tostring = function(v)
    if isproxy(v) then
        local pn = st.reg[v] or "obj"
        local r = mkpx("str", false)
        local rv = mkvar(r, "str")
        out(string.format("local %s = tostring(%s)", rv, pn))
        return rv
    end
    return _tostring_orig(v)
end
_G.tostring = tostring

-- hooked tonumber: log and return 0 when called on a Roblox proxy
local _tonumber_orig = tonumber
tonumber = function(v, base)
    if isproxy(v) then
        local pn = st.reg[v] or "obj"
        local r = mkpx("num", false)
        local rv = mkvar(r, "num")
        if base then
            out(string.format("local %s = tonumber(%s, %s)", rv, pn, ser(base)))
        else
            out(string.format("local %s = tonumber(%s)", rv, pn))
        end
        return 0
    end
    return _tonumber_orig(v, base)
end
_G.tonumber = tonumber

-- hooked type: return "userdata" for proxies (matches Roblox runtime behavior)
type = function(v)
    if isproxy(v) then
        return "userdata"
    end
    return _type(v)
end
_G.type = type

-- hooked typeof: return ClassName for proxies
typeof = function(v)
    if isproxy(v) then
        local cn = st.propstore[v] and st.propstore[v].ClassName
        return cn or "Instance"
    end
    return _type(v)
end
_G.typeof = typeof

local _rawlen = rawlen
rawlen = function(t)
    if _type(t) ~= "table" and _type(t) ~= "string" then
        error("bad argument #1 to 'rawlen' (table or string expected)", 2)
    end
    local ok, r = _pcall(_rawlen, t)
    return ok and r or #t
end

local function decode_b91(enc)
    local cs =
        "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789!#$%&()*+,./:;<=>?@[]^_`{|}~\"' "
    local dec = {}
    for i = 1, #cs do
        dec[cs:sub(i, i)] = i - 1
    end
    local res = {}
    local b = 0
    local n = 0
    local v = -1
    for i = 1, #enc do
        local ch = enc:sub(i, i)
        local val = dec[ch]
        if val ~= nil then
            if v == -1 then
                v = val
            else
                v = v + val * 91
                local lo = v % 8192
                local bits = lo > 88 and 13 or 14
                b = b + v * (2 ^ n)
                n = n + bits
                while n >= 8 do
                    table.insert(res, string.char(b % 256))
                    b = math.floor(b / 256)
                    n = n - 8
                end
                v = -1
            end
        end
    end
    if v ~= -1 then
        b = b + v * (2 ^ n)
        n = n + 13
        while n >= 8 do
            table.insert(res, string.char(b % 256))
            b = math.floor(b / 256)
            n = n - 8
        end
    end
    return table.concat(res)
end
local function pull_junkie(code)
    local chunks = {}
    for ch in code:gmatch("%[=%[(.-)%]=%]") do
        table.insert(chunks, ch)
    end
    if #chunks > 0 then
        local decoded = decode_b91(table.concat(chunks))
        if decoded and #decoded > 50 then
            return decoded
        end
    end
    return nil
end
local function patch_key(code)
    if not st.key_found then
        return code
    end
    local patched = code
    local pats = {
        { pattern = "TextBox%.Text%s*==%s*['\"].-['\"]", replace = "true" },
        { pattern = "if%s+.-[Kk]ey.-then", replace = "if true then" },
        {
            pattern = "while%s+not%s+.-[Vv]erified.-do",
            replace = "while false do",
        },
        { pattern = "[Cc]heck[Kk]ey%s*%(.-%)%s*==%s*true", replace = "true" },
        { pattern = "[Vv]erify[Kk]ey%s*%(.-%)%s*==%s*true", replace = "true" },
        { pattern = "TextBox%.Text%s*~=%s*['\"].-['\"]", replace = "false" },
    }
    for _, p in ipairs(pats) do
        patched = patched:gsub(p.pattern, p.replace)
    end
    if code ~= patched then
        st.key_bypassed = true
        note("key bypass applied")
    end
    return patched
end
loadstring = function(code, cname)
    if _type(code) == "number" then
        error("bad argument #1 to 'loadstring' (string expected, got number)", 2)
    end
    if _type(code) ~= "string" then
        local url = st.last_url
        st.last_url = nil
        st.lctr = (st.lctr or 0) + 1
        local varName = "load_" .. st.lctr
        if url then
            out(
                string.format(
                    'local %s = loadstring(game:HttpGet("%s"))()',
                    varName,
                    url
                )
            )
        else
            out(
                string.format(
                    "local %s = loadstring(%s)()",
                    varName,
                    _tostring(code)
                )
            )
        end
        return function()
            local mock = mkpx("ModuleResult", false)
            st.reg[mock] = varName
            return mock
        end
    end
    local env = st.sandbox or _G
    if _type(code) == "string" then
        code = code:gsub("while%s+true%s+do%s*end", "while false do end")
        code = code:gsub("while%s+wait%(%)%s+do%s*end", "while false do end")
        code =
            code:gsub("while%s+task%.wait%(%)%s+do%s*end", "while false do end")
    end
    if code:match("^\27Lua") or code:match("LuaP") then
        st.lctr = (st.lctr or 0) + 1
        local varName = "load_" .. st.lctr
        out(string.format("local %s, __lerr_%s = loadstring(%q)", varName, varName, code:sub(1, 200)))
        return nil, "attempt to load a binary chunk (mode is 't')"
    end
    local chunk, e = _loadstr(code, cname or "loadstring", "t", env)
    if chunk and _type(chunk) == "function" then
        _pcall(_setfenv, chunk, env)
        st.lctr = (st.lctr or 0) + 1
        local varName = "load_" .. st.lctr
        out(string.format("local %s = loadstring(%q)()", varName, code))
        return chunk
    end
    st.lctr = (st.lctr or 0) + 1
    local varName = "load_" .. st.lctr
    local err_str = _type(e) == "string" and e or (_type(chunk) == "string" and chunk or "compile error")
    out(string.format("local %s, __lerr_%s = loadstring(%q)", varName, varName, code:sub(1,200)))
    return nil, err_str
end
load = loadstring
_G.loadstring = loadstring
_G.load = loadstring
require = function(weird_input_arg)
    if _type(weird_input_arg) == "number" then
        error("Argument must be a ModuleScript or a string, got number")
    end
    local gatekept_slops = {
        ffi = true,
        socket = true,
        lfs = true,
        python = true,
        jit = true
    }
    local clown_module_name = _type(weird_input_arg) == "string" and weird_input_arg or ""
    if clown_module_name:sub(1, 6) == "@lune/" then
        error("lune imports are forbidden")
    end
    if gatekept_slops[clown_module_name] then
        out(string.format("blocked require of %s", q(clown_module_name)))
        error("this module is blocked")
    end
    local ugly_ass_string = st.reg[weird_input_arg] or ser(weird_input_arg)
    local cursed_proxy_guy = mkpx("reqmod", false)
    local funky_var_dude = mkvar(cursed_proxy_guy, "mod")
    out(string.format("local %s = require(%s)", funky_var_dude, ugly_ass_string))
    return cursed_proxy_guy
end
print = function(...)
    local args = { ... }
    local parts = {}

    local function is_G_table(val)
        return val == _G or (st and (val == st._renv_G or val == st._renv))
    end

    if #args == 1 and is_G_table(args[1]) then
        local chars =
            "0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ"
        local str = ""
        for i = 1, 8 do
            local r = math.random(1, #chars)
            str = str .. string.sub(chars, r, r)
        end
        local table_str = "table: 0x" .. str
        _print(table_str)
        out(string.format("print(%s)", q(table_str)))
        return
    end
    if
        #args == 0
        or (#args == 1 and (args[1] == nil or _type(args[1]) == "function"))
    then
        local l, line_code = get_current_script_line()
        if l and line_code then
            local inner = line_code:match("print%s*(%b())")
            if inner then
                inner = inner:sub(2, -2)
                if inner:match("%S") then
                    out(string.format("print(%s)", inner))
                    return
                end
            end
        end
    end
    for _, v in _ipairs(args) do
        if is_G_table(v) then
            local chars =
                "0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ"
            local str = ""
            for i = 1, 8 do
                local r = math.random(1, #chars)
                str = str .. string.sub(chars, r, r)
            end
            table.insert(parts, q("table: 0x" .. str))
        elseif isproxy(v) then
            local reg = st.reg[v]
            if reg then
                table.insert(parts, reg)
            else
                local ok, s = _pcall(ser, v)
                table.insert(parts, (ok and s and s ~= "nil") and s or safestr(v))
            end
        else
            table.insert(parts, ser(v))
        end
    end
    out(string.format("print(%s)", table.concat(parts, ", ")))
end

    if

            local inner = line_code:match("warn%s*(%b())")
            if inner then
                inner = inner:sub(2, -2)
                if inner:match("%S") then
                    out(string.format("warn(%s)", inner))
                    return
                end
            end
        end
    end
    for _, v in _ipairs(args) do

                "0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ"

end

                    end

                end)
            end
            if item_cache[ek] then
                return item_cache[ek]
            end
            if k == "Platform" then
                local valid_platforms = {
                    Windows = true, OSX = true, IOS = true, Android = true,
                    XBoxOne = true, PS4 = true, PS3 = true, XBox360 = true,
                    WiiU = true, NX = true, Ouya = true, AndroidTV = true,

                    WebOS = true, DOS = true, BeOS = true, UWP = true,
                    PS5 = true, MetaOS = true, Web = true, None = true,
                }
                if not valid_platforms[ek] then
                    error(("Invalid enum item %s::%s"):format(k, ek))
                end
            end
            local item = mkpx("Enum." .. k .. "." .. ek, false)
            st.reg[item] = "Enum." .. k .. "." .. ek
            rawset(item, "__enumitem", true)
            local val = 0
            if ek == "None" then
                val = 0
            elseif ek == "User" then
                val = 0
            elseif ek == "Custom" then
                val = 0
            else
                val = 1
            end
            st.propstore[item] = { EnumType = eproxy, Name = ek, Value = val }
            item_cache[ek] = item
            return item
        end
        eproxy_mt.__newindex = function()
            error("Enum items are read-only")
        end
        eproxy_mt.__tostring = function()
            return "Enum." .. k
        end
        enum_cache[k] = eproxy
        return eproxy
    end
    Enum_mt.__tostring = function()
        return "Enum"
    end
    _G.game = game
    _G.workspace = workspace
    _G.script = script
    _G.Enum = Enum
    _G.shared = mkpx("shared", true)
    _G._VERSION = "Luau"
    _G.ypcall = pcall
end

function aspect.stats()

        cs = cs + 1
    end

        proxies = st.pxid,

        key_bypassed = st.key_bypassed,
    }

function aspect.dumpfile(inpath, outpath)

        return false
    end
    if code:match("ironbrew") or code:match("return%(function%(") then
        st.vm_type = "ironbrew"
    end
    if
        code:match("Junkie")
        or (code:match("b91") and code:match("loadstring%(d%(table%.concat"))
    then
        st.vm_type = "junkie"
        local dok, decoded = _pcall(pull_junkie, code)
        if dok and decoded and #decoded > 100 then
            _pcall(function()
                fs.writeFile("core/io/dumped_output.lua", decoded)
            end)

        st.key_found = true
        code = patch_key(code)
    end

    local start = 1
    while true do
        local pos = code:find("\n", start, true)
        if not pos then
            local last = code:sub(start)
            if last:sub(-1) == "\r" then
                last = last:sub(1, -2)
            end
            table.insert(st.source_lines, last)
            break
        end
        local line = code:sub(start, pos - 1)
        if line:sub(-1) == "\r" then
            line = line:sub(1, -2)
        end
        table.insert(st.source_lines, line)
        start = pos + 1
    end

    local main_dead = false
    local ok, rerr = _xpcall(function()
        local co = _cor.create(chunk)
        while not main_dead or #st.task_queue > 0 do
            if os.clock() - st.t_start > cfg.timeout then
                note("timed out after " .. cfg.timeout .. "s")
                break
            end
            if not main_dead then
                local res = { _cor.resume(co, _unpack(resume_args)) }
                local cok = res[1]
                if not cok then
                    local ce = res[2]
                    _print("COROUTINE ERROR:", ce)
                    if _type(ce) == "string" then
                        if ce:match("invalid utf%-8") or ce:match("binary") then
                            break
                        elseif
                            ce:match("TIMEOUT") or ce:match("DUMP_LIMIT")
                        then
                            break
                        end
                    end
                    break
                end
                if _cor.status(co) ~= "dead" then
                    local yield_type = res[2]
                    local yield_val = res[3]
                    if yield_type == "wait" then
                        local wait_dur = yield_val or 0.03
                        advance_virtual_time(wait_dur)
                        resume_args = { wait_dur, os.clock() }
                    else
                        resume_args = {}
                    end
                else
                    main_dead = true
                    while st.pending_iter and st.pending_iter > 0 do
                        st.ind = st.ind - 1
                        out("end")
                        st.pending_iter = st.pending_iter - 1
                    end
                    while st.cf_depth > 0 do
                        st.ind = st.ind - 1
                        out("end")
                        st.cf_depth = st.cf_depth - 1
                    end
                    advance_virtual_time(100)
                end
            else
                local next_time = nil
                for _, item in _ipairs(st.task_queue) do
                    if item.type == "delay" then
                        if not next_time or item.time < next_time then
                            next_time = item.time
                        end
                    end
                end
                local has_defer = false
                for _, item in _ipairs(st.task_queue) do
                    if item.type == "defer" then
                        has_defer = true
                        break
                    end
                end
                if has_defer then
                    advance_virtual_time(0)
                elseif next_time then
                    local diff = next_time - st.virtual_time
                    advance_virtual_time(math.max(0, diff))
                else
                    break
                end
            end
        end
    end, function(er)
        return cleanpath(_tostring(er))
    end)
    if not ok then
        note("terminated " .. (rerr or "unknown"))
    end
    local cs = 0
    for _ in _pairs(st.cap_strings) do
        cs = cs + 1
    end
    if cs > 0 then
        note("captured " .. cs .. " decrypted strings")
    end
    for k, v in _pairs(st.gassigns) do
        out(string.format("_G.%s = %s", safestr(k), ser(v)))
    end
    local ms_taken = math.floor((os.clock() - t_begin) * 1000)
    local captured_links = {}
    local seen_links = {}
    for _, ref in _ipairs(st.strrefs) do
        if
            ref.hint == "url"
            and ref.value
            and not seen_links[ref.value]
            and (ref.value:match("^https?://") or ref.value:match("^www%."))
        then
            seen_links[ref.value] = true
            table.insert(captured_links, "    " .. ref.value)
        end
    end
    local links_str = #captured_links > 0 and table.concat(captured_links, "\n")
        or "    (none captured)"
    table.insert(
        st.out,
        1,
        "--[[\n    context\n      pretty detected rn and its inall in beta so ermm\n      current unc is id like to say around 70-90%\n\n    links\n"
            .. links_str
            .. "\n]]"
    )
    return aspect.save(outpath or cfg.outfile)
end

-- Lune compatibility layer. Lune exposes runtime services as modules rather than
-- the Lua 5.x-style globals used by the original script.
local lune_fs = require("@lune/fs")
local lune_luau = require("@lune/luau")
local lune_process = require("@lune/process")

local function lune_load(source, chunkname, env)
    if type(source) ~= "string" then
        return nil, "bad argument #1 to 'load' (string expected)"
    end

    local options = {
        debugName = chunkname or "chunk",
        codegenEnabled = false,
    }
    if env ~= nil then
        options.environment = env
        options.injectGlobals = true
    end

    local ok, result = pcall(function()
        return lune_luau.load(source, options)
    end)
    if ok then
        return result
    end
    return nil, result
end

local function lune_setfenv(fn, env)
    if type(fn) ~= "function" or type(env) ~= "table" then
        return fn
    end

    local dbg = debug
    if dbg and dbg.getupvalue and dbg.setupvalue then
        for level = 1, 64 do
            local name = dbg.getupvalue(fn, level)
            if not name then
                break
            end
            if name == "_ENV" then
                dbg.setupvalue(fn, level, env)
                return fn
            end
        end
    end
    return fn
end

-- Minimal file-handle facade for the few read/write operations used by Larry.
-- Internally this maps directly to Lune's @lune/fs API.
local o = {
    open = function(path, mode)
        local write_mode = type(mode) == "string" and mode:match("w") ~= nil
        if write_mode then
            return {
                write = function(_, contents)
                    local ok = pcall(lune_fs.writeFile, path, contents)
                    if not ok then
                        error("failed to write file: " .. tostring(path))
                    end
                end,
                close = function() end,
            }
        end

        local ok, contents = pcall(lune_fs.readFile, path)
        if not ok then
            return nil
        end
        return {
            read = function(_, what)
                if what == "*a" or what == nil then
                    return contents
                end
                return contents
            end,
            close = function() end,
        }
    end,
}

local function I(J)
    if j(J) ~= "string" then
        return '"'
    end
    local K = {}
    local L, M = 1, #J
    local function N(O)
        return O:gsub(
            "\\\\(.)",
            function(P)
                if P:match('[abfnrtv\\\\%\'%\\"%[%]0-9xu]') then
                    return "" .. P
                end
                return P
            end
        )
    end
    local function Q(R)
        if not R or R == '"' then
            return ""
        end
        R =
            R:gsub(
            "0[bB]([01_]+)",
            function(S)
                local T = S:gsub("_", "")
                local U = n(T, 2)
                return U and m(U) or "0"
            end
        )
        R =
            R:gsub(
            "0[xX]([%x_]+)",
            function(S)
                local T = S:gsub("_", '"')
                return "0x" .. T
            end
        )
        while R:match("%d_+%d") do
            R = R:gsub("(%d)_+(%d)", "%1%2")
        end
        local V = {{"+=", "+"}, {"-=", "-"}, {"*=", "*"}, {"/=", "/"}, {"%%=", "%%"}, {"%^=", "^"}, {"%.%.=", ".."}}
        for W, X in ipairs(V) do
            local Y, Z = X[1], X[2]
            R =
                R:gsub(
                "([%a_][%w_]*)%s*" .. Y,
                function(_)
                    return _ .. " = " .. _ .. " " .. Z .. " "
                end
            )
            R =
                R:gsub(
                "([%a_][%w_]*%.[%a_][%w_%.]+)%s*" .. Y,
                function(_)
                    return _ .. " = " .. _ .. " " .. Z .. " "
                end
            )
            R =
                R:gsub(
                "([%a_][%w_]*%b[])%s*" .. Y,
                function(_)
                    return _ .. " = " .. _ .. " " .. Z .. " "
                end
            )
        end
        R = R:gsub("([^%w_])continue([^%w_])", "%1_G.LuraphContinue()%2")
        R = R:gsub("^continue([^%w_])", "_G.LuraphContinue()%1")
        R = R:gsub("([^%w_])continue$", "%1_G.LuraphContinue()")
        return R
    end
    local function a0(a1)
        local a2 = 0
        while a1 <= M and J:byte(a1) == 61 do
            a2 = a2 + 1
            a1 = a1 + 1
        end
        return a2, a1
    end
    local function a3(a4, a5)
        local a6 = "]" .. string.rep("=", a5) .. "]"
        local a7, a8 = J:find(a6, a4, true)
        return a8 or M
    end

    while L <= M do
        local aa = J:byte(L)
        if aa == 91 then
            local a5, ab = a0(L + 1)
            if ab <= M and J:byte(ab) == 91 then
                table.insert(K, Q(J:sub(a9, L - 1)))
                local ac = L
                local ad = a3(ab + 1, a5)
                table.insert(K, J:sub(ac, ad))
                L = ad
                a9 = L + 1
            end
        elseif aa == 45 and L + 1 <= M and J:byte(L + 1) == 45 then
            table.insert(K, Q(J:sub(a9, L - 1)))
            local ae = L
            if L + 2 <= M and J:byte(L + 2) == 91 then
                local a5, ab = a0(L + 3)
                if ab <= M and J:byte(ab) == 91 then
                    local ad = a3(ab + 1, a5)
                    table.insert(K, J:sub(ae, ad))
                    L = ad
                    a9 = L + 1
                    L = L + 1
                end
            end
            local af = J:find("\\n", L + 2, true)
            if af then
                L = af
            else
                L = M
            end
            table.insert(K, J:sub(ae, L))
            a9 = L + 1
        elseif aa == 34 or aa == 39 or aa == 96 then
            table.insert(K, Q(J:sub(a9, L - 1)))
            local ag = aa
            local ac = L
            L = L + 1
            while L <= M do
                local ah = J:byte(L)
                if ah == 92 then
                    L = L + 1
                elseif ah == ag then
                    break
                end
                L = L + 1
            end

            ai = N(ai)

                table.insert(K, '"' .. ai:gsub('"', '\\\\"') .. '"')
            else

                table.insert(K, aj .. ai .. aj)
            end

        end
        L = L + 1
    end
    table.insert(K, Q(J:sub(a9)))
    return table.concat(K)
end
local function ak(al, am)
    local R, an = e(al, am)
    if R then
        return R
    end
    B("\\n[CRITICAL ERROR] Failed to load script!")
    B("[LUA_LOAD_FAIL] " .. m(an))
    local ao = tonumber(an:match(":(%d+):"))
    local ap = an:match("near '([^']+)'")
    if ap then
        local a1 = al:find(ap, 1, true)
        if a1 then
            local aq = math.max(1, a1 - 50)
            local ar = math.min(#al, a1 + 50)
            B("Context around error:")
            B("..." .. al:sub(aq, ar) .. "...")
        end
    end
    local ok = pcall(lune_fs.writeFile, "DEBUG_FAILED_TRANSPILE.lua", al)
    if ok then
        B("[*] Saved to 'DEBUG_FAILED_TRANSPILE.lua' for inspection")
    end
    return nil, an
end
local function at(O, au)
    if t.limit_reached then
        return
    end
    if O == nil then
        return
    end
    local av = au and "" or string.rep("    ", t.indent)
    local aw = av .. m(O)
    local ax = #aw + 1
    if t.current_size + ax > r.MAX_OUTPUT_SIZE then
        t.limit_reached = true
        local ay = "-- [CRITICAL] Dump stopped: File size exceeded 6MB limit."
        table.insert(t.output, ay)
        t.current_size = t.current_size + #ay
        error("DUMP_LIMIT_EXCEEDED")
    end
    if aw == t.last_emitted_line then
        t.repetition_count = t.repetition_count + 1
        if t.repetition_count <= r.MAX_REPEATED_LINES then
            table.insert(t.output, aw)
            t.current_size = t.current_size + ax
        elseif t.repetition_count == r.MAX_REPEATED_LINES + 1 then
            local ay = av .. "-- [Repeated lines suppressed...]"
            table.insert(t.output, ay)
            t.current_size = t.current_size + #ay
        end
    else
        t.last_emitted_line = aw
        t.repetition_count = 0
        table.insert(t.output, aw)
        t.current_size = t.current_size + ax
    end
    if r.VERBOSE and t.repetition_count <= 1 then
        B(aw)
    end
end
local function az(O)

end

            local aG = H(aF)
            return aG and "proxy_" .. aG or "proxy"
        end
    end
    local y, O = pcall(m, aF)
    return y and O or "unknown"
end

end

local function aZ(aF, a_, b0, b1)
    a_ = a_ or 0
    b0 = b0 or {}
    if a_ > r.MAX_DEPTH then

    end
    local b2 = j(aF)
    if w(aF) then
        local b3 = rawget(aF, "__value")
        return m(b3 or 0)
    end
    if b2 == "table" and t.registry[aF] then
        return t.registry[aF]
    end
    if b2 == "nil" then
        return "nil"
    elseif b2 == "string" then
        if #aF > 100 and aF:match("^[A-Za-z0-9+/=]+$") then
            table.insert(t.string_refs, {value = aF:sub(1, 50) .. "...", hint = "base64", full_length = #aF})
        elseif aF:match("https?://") then
            table.insert(t.string_refs, {value = aF, hint = "URL"})
        elseif aF:match("rbxasset://") or aF:match("rbxassetid://") then

        end
        return aH(aF)
    elseif b2 == "number" then
        if aF ~= aF then
            return "0/0"
        end
        if aF == math.huge then
            return "math.huge"
        end
        if aF == -math.huge then
            return "-math.huge"
        end
        if aF == math.floor(aF) then
            return m(math.floor(aF))
        end
        return string.format("%.6g", aF)
    elseif b2 == "boolean" then
        return m(aF)
    elseif b2 == "function" then
        if t.registry[aF] then
            return t.registry[aF]
        end

        end

                else

                    break
                end
            end

                return "{" .. table.concat(b8, ", ") .. "}"
            end
        end
        local b9 = {}
        local ba = 0
        local bb = string.rep("    ", t.indent + a_ + 1)
        local bc = string.rep("    ", t.indent + a_)
        for b4, b5 in D(aF) do
            if b4 ~= F and b4 ~= "__proxy_id" then
                ba = ba + 1
                if ba > r.MAX_TABLE_ITEMS then
                    table.insert(b9, bb .. "-- ..." .. a2 - ba + 1 .. " more")
                    break
                end
                local bd
                if b6 then
                    bd = nil
                elseif j(b4) == "string" and b4:match("^[%a_][%w_]*$") then
                    bd = b4
                else
                    bd = "[" .. aZ(b4, a_ + 1, b0) .. "]"
                end
                local be = aZ(b5, a_ + 1, b0)

                else
                    table.insert(b9, bb .. be)
                end
            end
        end
        if #b9 == 0 then

        end
        return "{\\n" .. table.concat(b9, ",\\n") .. "\\n" .. bc .. "}"
    elseif b2 == "userdata" then

            return t.registry[aF]
        end
        local y, O = pcall(m, aF)
        return y and O or "userdata"
    elseif b2 == "thread" then
        return "coroutine.create(function() end)"
    else
        local y, O = pcall(m, aF)
        return y and O or "nil"
    end
end

local function br(bs, bt)

        end,
        function()
        end
    )
    while t.pending_iterator do
        t.indent = t.indent - 1
        at("end")
        t.pending_iterator = false
    end
    t.pending_iterator = bu
    local bv = {}
    for L = a4 + 1, #t.output do
        table.insert(bv, t.output[L])
    end
    for L = #t.output, a4 + 1, -1 do
        table.remove(t.output, L)
    end
    return bv
end

        local bd = aE(bG)
        if bd:match("^[%a_][%w_]*$") then
            if dD then
                return dD .. "." .. bd
            end
            return bd
        else
            local aI = bd:gsub("'", "\\\\'")

                return dD .. "['" .. aI .. "']"
            end
            return "['" .. aI .. "']"
        end
    end
    dd.__index = function(b2, b4)

                return nil

    end

    end
    dd.__pairs = function()

    end

end

local ed = {}
local function ee(d_)
    d_ = (d_ or 0) % 4294967296
    if d_ >= 2147483648 then
        d_ = d_ - 4294967296
    end
    return math.floor(d_)
end
ed.tobit = ee
ed.tohex = function(d_, U)
    return string.format("%0" .. (U or 8) .. "x", (d_ or 0) % 0x100000000)
end
_G.bit = {band = function(bo, aa)
        return bit32.band(ee(ee), ee(aa))
    end, bor = function(bo, aa)
        return bit32.bor(ee(ee), ee(aa))
    end, bxor = function(bo, aa)
        return bit32.bxor(ee(ee), ee(aa))
    end, lshift = function(d_, U)
        return ee(bit32.lshift(ee(d_), U % 32))
    end, rshift = function(d_, U)
        return ee(bit32.rshift(ee(d_), U % 32))
    end}
_G.bit32 = _G.bit
ed.arshift = function(d_, U)
    local b5 = ee(d_ or 0)
    if b5 < 0 then
        return ee(bit32.rshift(b5, U) or 0) + ee(-bit32.lshift(1, 32) - (U or 0))
    else
        return ee(bit32.rshift(b5, U) or 0)
    end
end
ed.rol = function(d_, U)
    d_ = d_ or 0
    U = (U or 0) % 32
    return ee(bit32.bor(bit32.lshift(d_, U), bit32.rshift(d_, 32 - U)))
end
ed.ror = function(d_, U)
    d_ = d_ or 0
    U = (U or 0) % 32
    return ee(bit32.bor(bit32.rshift(d_, U), bit32.lshift(d_, 32 - U)))
end
ed.bswap = function(d_)
    d_ = d_ or 0
    local bo = bit32.band(bit32.rshift(d_, 24), 0xFF)
    local aa = bit32.band(bit32.rshift(d_, 8), 0xFF00)
    local ah = bit32.band(bit32.lshift(d_, 8), 0xFF0000)
    local ef = bit32.band(bit32.lshift(d_, 24), 0xFF000000)
    return ee(bit32.bor(bo, bit32.bor(aa, bit32.bor(ah, ef))))
end
ed.countlz = function(U)
    U = ed.tobit(U)
    if U == 0 then
        return 32
    end
    local a2 = 0
    if ed.band(U, 0xFFFF0000) == 0 then
        a2 = a2 + 16
        U = ed.lshift(U, 16)
    end
    if ed.band(U, 0xFF000000) == 0 then
        a2 = a2 + 8
        U = ed.lshift(U, 8)
    end
    if ed.band(U, 0xF0000000) == 0 then
        a2 = a2 + 4
        U = ed.lshift(U, 4)
    end
    if ed.band(U, 0xC0000000) == 0 then
        a2 = a2 + 2
        U = ed.lshift(U, 2)
    end
    if ed.band(U, 0x80000000) == 0 then
        a2 = a2 + 1
    end
    return a2
end
ed.countrz = function(U)
    U = ed.tobit(U)
    if U == 0 then
        return 32
    end
    local a2 = 0
    while ed.band(U, 1) == 0 do
        U = ed.rshift(U, 1)
        a2 = a2 + 1
    end
    return a2
end
ed.lrotate = ed.rol
ed.rrotate = ed.ror
ed.extract = function(U, eg, eh)
    eh = eh or 1
    return bit32.band(bit32.rshift(U, eg), bit32.lshift(1, eh) - 1)
end
ed.replace = function(U, b5, eg, eh)
    eh = eh or 1
    local ei = bit32.lshift(1, eh) - 1
    return bit32.bor(bit32.band(U, bit32.bnot(bit32.lshift(ei, eg))), bit32.band(b5, bit32.lshift(ei, eg)))
end
ed.btest = function(bo, aa)
    return ed.band(bo, aa) ~= 0
end

do
    local native_table = table
    local compat_table = setmetatable({}, { __index = native_table })
    table = compat_table

    local native_string = string
    local compat_string = setmetatable({}, { __index = native_string })
    string = compat_string

    local native_math = math
    local compat_math = setmetatable({}, { __index = native_math })
    math = compat_math

    local native_utf8 = utf8
    local compat_utf8 = setmetatable({}, { __index = native_utf8 })
    utf8 = compat_utf8
end

        return #b2
    end

        for b4, b5 in pairs(b2) do

        end
    end

            as(L, b5)
        end
    end

        ek = ek or ej

    end

if not math.frexp then
    math.frexp = function(d_)
        if d_ == 0 then
            return 0, 0
        end
        local ds = math.floor(math.log(math.abs(d_)) / math.log(2)) + 1
        local em = d_ / 2 ^ ds
        return em, ds
    end
end

        return em * 2 ^ ds
    end
end

    end

    aM = {}
    game = bj("game", true)
    workspace = bj("workspace", true)
    script = bj("script", true)
    Enum = bj("Enum", true)
    shared = bj("shared", true)
    t.property_store[game] = {PlaceId = u, GameId = u, placeId = u, gameId = u}
    _G.game = game
    _G.Game = game
    _G.workspace = workspace
    _G.Workspace = workspace
    _G.script = script
    _G.Enum = Enum
    _G.shared = shared
    local dm = k(Enum)
    dm.__index = function(b2, b4)
        if b4 == F or b4 == "__proxy_id" then
            return rawget(b2, b4)
        end
        local dn = bj("Enum." .. aE(b4), false)
        t.registry[dn] = "Enum." .. aE(b4)
        return dn
    end
end
function q.get_output()
    return aB()
end
function q.save(aD)
    return aC(aD)
end

    return t.call_graph
end

    return t.string_refs

    return {
        total_lines = #t.output,
        remote_calls = #t.call_graph,

        proxies_created = t.proxy_id
    }

local eE = {
    callId = "LARRY_",
    binaryOperatorNames = {
        ["and"] = "AND",
        ["or"] = "OR",
        [">"] = "GT",
        ["<"] = "LT",
        [">="] = "GE",
        ["<="] = "LE",
        ["=="] = "EQ",
        ["~="] = "NEQ",
        [".."] = "CAT"
    }
}
function eE:hook(al)
    return self.callId .. al
end
function eE:process_expr(eF)
    if not eF then
        return "nil"
    end
    if type(eF) == "string" then
        return eF
    end
    local eG = eF.tag or eF.kind
    if eG == "number" or eG == "string" then
        local aF = eG == "string" and string.format("%q", eF.text) or (eF.value or eF.text)
        if r.CONSTANT_COLLECTION then
            return string.format("%sGET(%s)", self.callId, aF)
        end
        return aF
    end
    if eG == "local" or eG == "global" then
        return (eF.name or eF.token).text
    elseif eG == "boolean" or eG == "bool" then
        return tostring(eF.value)
    elseif eG == "binary" then
        local eH = self:process_expr(eF.lhsoperand)
        local eI = self:process_expr(eF.rhsoperand)
        local X = eF.operator.text
        local eJ = self.binaryOperatorNames[X]
        if eJ then
            return string.format("%s%s(%s, %s)", self.callId, eJ, eH, eI)
        end
        return string.format("(%s %s %s)", eH, X, eI)
    elseif eG == "call" then
        local dr = self:process_expr(eF.func)
        local bA = {}
        for L, b5 in ipairs(eF.arguments) do
            bA[L] = self:process_expr(b5.node or b5)
        end
        return string.format("%sCALL(%s, %s)", self.callId, dr, table.concat(bA, ", "))
    elseif eG == "indexname" or eG == "index" then
        local bS = self:process_expr(eF.expression)
        local ba = eG == "indexname" and string.format("%q", eF.index.text) or self:process_expr(eF.index)
        return string.format("%sCHECKINDEX(%s, %s)", self.callId, bS, ba)
    end
    return "nil"
end
function eE:process_statement(eF)
    if not eF then
        return ""
    end
    local eG = eF.tag
    if eG == "local" or eG == "assign" then
        local eK, eL = {}, {}
        for W, b5 in ipairs(eF.variables or {}) do
            table.insert(eK, self:process_expr(b5.node or b5))
        end
        for W, b5 in ipairs(eF.values or {}) do
            table.insert(eL, self:process_expr(b5.node or b5))
        end
        return (eG == "local" and "local " or "") .. table.concat(eK, ", ") .. " = " .. table.concat(eL, ", ")
    elseif eG == "block" then
        local b9 = {}
        for W, eM in ipairs(eF.statements or {}) do
            table.insert(b9, self:process_statement(eM))
        end
        return table.concat(b9, "; ")
    end
    return self:process_expr(eF) or ""
end
function q.dump_file(eN, eO)
    q.reset()
    --az("this file is generated using larry")
    local as = o.open(eN, "rb")
    if not as then
        return false
    end
    local al = as:read("*a")
    as:close()
    B("[Dumper] Sanitizing Luau and Binary Literals...")
    local eP = I(al)

    -- Build the execution environment before loading the chunk so Lune can bind
    -- the sandbox at load time rather than relying on Lua 5.x setfenv behavior.
    local eR =
        setmetatable(
        {
            LuraphContinue = function()
            end,
            script = script,
            game = game,
            workspace = workspace,
            LARRY_CHECKINDEX = function(x, ba)
                local aF = x[ba]
                if j(aF) == "table" and not t.registry[aF] then
                    t.lar_counter = t.lar_counter + 1
                    t.registry[aF] = "lartab" .. t.lar_counter
                end
                return aF
            end,
            LARRY_GET = function(b5)
                return b5
            end,
            LARRY_CALL = function(as, ...)
                return as(...)
            end,
            LARRY_NAMECALL = function(eS, em, ...)
                return eS[em](eS, ...)
            end,
            pcall = function(as, ...)
                local dg = {g(as, ...)}
                if not dg[1] and m(dg[2]):match("TIMEOUT") then
                    i(dg[2], 0)
                end
                return table.unpack(dg)
            end,
        },
        {__index = _G, __newindex = _G}
    )

    local R, eQ = e(eP, "Obfuscated_Script", eR)
    if not R then
        B("\\n[LUA_LOAD_FAIL] " .. m(eQ))
        return false
    end

    -- Keep the compatibility fallback for Luau builds where _ENV is mutable.
    lune_setfenv(R, eR)
    B("[Dumper] Executing Protected VM...")
    local eT = p.clock()
    b(
        function()
            if p.clock() - eT > r.TIMEOUT_SECONDS then
                error("TIMEOUT", 0)
            end
        end,
        "",
        1000
    )
    local eo, eU =
        h(
        function()
            R()
        end,
        function(ds)
            return tostring(ds)
        end
    )
    b()
    if not eo then
        az("Terminated: " .. eU)
    end
    return q.save(eO or r.OUTPUT_FILE)
end

function q.dump_string(al, eO)
    q.reset()
    az("this file is generated using larry")
    aA()
    if al then
        al = I(al)
    end
    local R, an = e(al)
    if not R then
        az("Load Error: " .. (an or "unknown"))
        return false, an
    end
    xpcall(
        function()
            R()
        end,
        function()
        end
    )
    if eO then
        return q.save(eO)
    end
    return true, aB()
end
_G.arg = cli_args

if cli_args[1] then
    local eo = q.dump_file(cli_args[1], cli_args[2])
    if eo then
        B("Saved to: " .. (cli_args[2] or r.OUTPUT_FILE))
        local eV = q.get_stats()
        B(
            string.format(
                "Lines: %d, Remotes: %d, Strings: %d",
                eV.total_lines,
                eV.remote_calls,
                eV.suspicious_strings
            )
        )
    end
else
    local as = o.open("obfuscated.lua", "rb")
    if as then
        as:close()
        local eo = q.dump_file("obfuscated.lua")
        if eo then
            B("Saved to: " .. r.OUTPUT_FILE)
            B(q.get_output())
        end
    else
        B("Usage: lune run larry.luau <input> [output] [key]")
    end
end
_G.LuraphContinue = function()
end
return q

    end\
    bit32 = {\
        band = function(...) local r=0xFFFFFFFF for i=1,select(\"#\",...)do r=_b2(r,_fl(select(i,...)or 0))end return r end,\
        bor  = function(...) local r=0           for i=1,select(\"#\",...)do r=_o2(r,_fl(select(i,...)or 0))end return r end,\
        bxor = function(...) local r=0           for i=1,select(\"#\",...)do r=_x2(r,_fl(select(i,...)or 0))end return r end,\
        bnot = function(a) return _n1(_fl(a or 0)) end,\
        lshift = function(a,b) b=_fl(b or 0); if b<0 then return _r2(_fl(a or 0),-b) end return _l2(_fl(a or 0),b) end,\
        rshift = function(a,b) b=_fl(b or 0); if b<0 then return _l2(_fl(a or 0),-b) end return _r2(_fl(a or 0),b) end,\
        arshift = function(a,b)\
            local u=_u32(a); b=_fl(b or 0)\
            if b>=32 then return (u>=2147483648) and 0xFFFFFFFF or 0 end\
            if b< 0  then return _l2(u,-b) end\
            local r=_r2(u,b)\
            if u>=2147483648 and _ars_ext then r=_o2(r,_ars_ext(b)) end\
            return r\
        end,\
        lrotate = function(a,b)\
            b=_fl(b or 0)%32; if b==0 then return _u32(a) end\
            return _o2(_l2(_fl(a or 0),b),_r2(_fl(a or 0),32-b))\
        end,\
        rrotate = function(a,b)\
            b=_fl(b or 0)%32; if b==0 then return _u32(a) end\
            return _o2(_r2(_fl(a or 0),b),_l2(_fl(a or 0),32-b))\
        end,\
        extract = function(a,f,w)\
            w=_fl(w or 1); f=_fl(f or 0)\
            local mask = _ext_msk and _ext_msk(f,w) or ((2^w-1)*(2^f))\
            return _r2(_b2(_u32(a),mask),f)\
        end,\
        replace = function(a,v,f,w)\
            w=_fl(w or 1); f=_fl(f or 0)\
            local m = _rep_msk and _rep_msk(w) or (2^w-1)\
            local s = _rep_sft and _rep_sft(f,w) or (m*(2^f))\
            return _o2(_b2(_u32(a),_n1(s)),_l2(_b2(_u32(v),m),f))\
        end,\
        btest = function(...) local r=0xFFFFFFFF for i=1,select(\"#\",...)do r=_b2(r,_fl(select(i,...)or 0))end return r~=0 end,\
        countlz = function(a)\
            a=_u32(a); if a==0 then return 32 end\
            local n=0; while a<2147483648 do a=a*2;n=n+1 end return n\
        end,\
        countrz = function(a)\
            a=_u32(a); if a==0 then return 32 end\
            local n=0; while a%2==0 do a=_fl(a/2);n=n+1 end return n\
        end,\
    }\
    bit32.rol = bit32.lrotate\
    bit32.ror = bit32.rrotate\
end\

    HttpService       = _mk_instance({\
        GenerateGUID = function(_, useBraces)\
            local s = string.format(\"%08X-%04X-4%03X-%04X-%012X\",\
                math.random(0x10000000,0xFFFFFFFF), math.random(0x1000,0xFFFF),\
                math.random(0,0xFFF), math.random(0x8000,0xBFFF),\
                math.random(0x100000000,0xFFFFFFFFFF))\
            return useBraces and (\"{\" .. s .. \"}\") or s\
        end,\
        JSONEncode   = function(_, val)\
            local _seen = {}\
            local function _j(v, d)\
                d = d or 0\
                if d > 32 then return '\"[MaxDepth]\"' end\
                local t = type(v)\
                if t == \"nil\" then\
                    return \"null\"\
                elseif t == \"boolean\" then\
                    return tostring(v)\
                elseif t == \"number\" then\
                    if v ~= v then return \"null\"\
                    elseif v == math.huge then return \"1e308\"\
                    elseif v == -math.huge then return \"-1e308\"\
                    else return string.format(\"%.14g\", v) end\
                elseif t == \"string\" then\
                    v = v:gsub('\\\\','\\\\\\\\'):gsub('\"','\\\\\"')\
                        :gsub('\\n','\\\\n'):gsub('\\r','\\\\r'):gsub('\\t','\\\\t')\
                    v = v:gsub('[%c]', function(c)\
                        return string.format('\\\\u%04X', string.byte(c)) end)\
                    return '\"' .. v .. '\"'\
                elseif t == \"table\" then\
                    if _seen[v] then return '\"[Circular]\"' end\
                    _seen[v] = true\
                    local isArr, maxN = true, 0\
                    for k,_ in pairs(v) do\
                        if type(k) ~= \"number\" or k ~= math.floor(k) or k < 1 then\
                            isArr = false; break\
                        end\
                        if k > maxN then maxN = k end\
                    end\
                    local r\
                    if isArr and maxN > 0 then\
                        local arr = {}\
                        for i = 1, maxN do arr[i] = _j(v[i], d+1) end\
                        r = \"[\" .. table.concat(arr, \",\") .. \"]\"\
                    else\
                        local obj = {}\
                        for k, v2 in pairs(v) do\
                            if type(k) == \"string\" or type(k) == \"number\" then\
                                local ks = '\"' .. tostring(k):gsub('\"','\\\\\"') .. '\"'\
                                obj[#obj+1] = ks .. \":\" .. _j(v2, d+1)\
                            end\
                        end\
                        r = \"{\" .. table.concat(obj, \",\") .. \"}\"\
                    end\
                    _seen[v] = nil\
                    return r\
                else\
                    return \"null\"\
                end\
            end\
            return _j(val)\
        end,\
        JSONDecode   = function(_, s)\
            s = tostring(s or \"\")\
            local pos = 1\
            local function skip() while pos <= #s and s:sub(pos,pos):match(\"%s\") do pos=pos+1 end end\
            local function parse()\
                skip()\
                if pos > #s then return nil end\
                local c = s:sub(pos,pos)\
                if c == \"{\" then\
                    pos=pos+1; local t={}; skip()\
                    if s:sub(pos,pos)==\"}\" then pos=pos+1; return t end\
                    while true do\
                        skip()\
                        if s:sub(pos,pos)~='\"' then break end\
                        pos=pos+1\
                        local ke=s:find('\"', pos, true)\
                        local key = s:sub(pos, (ke or pos)-1); pos=(ke or pos)+1\
                        skip(); if s:sub(pos,pos)==\":\" then pos=pos+1 end\
                        t[key]=parse(); skip()\
                        if s:sub(pos,pos)==\",\" then pos=pos+1 else break end\
                    end\
                    skip(); if s:sub(pos,pos)==\"}\" then pos=pos+1 end\
                    return t\
                elseif c == \"[\" then\
                    pos=pos+1; local t={}; skip()\
                    if s:sub(pos,pos)==\"]\" then pos=pos+1; return t end\
                    while true do\
                        t[#t+1]=parse(); skip()\
                        if s:sub(pos,pos)==\",\" then pos=pos+1 else break end\
                    end\
                    skip(); if s:sub(pos,pos)==\"]\" then pos=pos+1 end\
                    return t\
                elseif c=='\"' then\
                    pos=pos+1; local r={}\
                    while pos<=#s do\
                        local ch=s:sub(pos,pos)\
                        if ch=='\"' then pos=pos+1; break\
                        elseif ch==\"\\\\\" then\
                            pos=pos+1; local esc=s:sub(pos,pos); pos=pos+1\
                            if esc==\"n\" then r[#r+1]=\"\\n\"\
                            elseif esc==\"t\" then r[#r+1]=\"\\t\"\
                            elseif esc==\"r\" then r[#r+1]=\"\\r\"\
                            elseif esc==\"u\" then\
                                local hex=s:sub(pos,pos+3); pos=pos+4\
                                r[#r+1]=string.char(tonumber(hex,16) or 63)\
                            else r[#r+1]=esc end\
                        else r[#r+1]=ch; pos=pos+1 end\
                    end\
                    return table.concat(r)\
                elseif c==\"-\" or c:match(\"%d\") then\
                    local ns,ne=s:find(\"%-?%d+%.?%d*[eE]?[+-]?%d*\", pos)\
                    if ns then local n=tonumber(s:sub(ns,ne)); pos=ne+1; return n end\
                    return 0\
                elseif s:sub(pos,pos+3)==\"true\"  then pos=pos+4; return true\
                elseif s:sub(pos,pos+4)==\"false\" then pos=pos+5; return false\
                elseif s:sub(pos,pos+3)==\"null\"  then pos=pos+4; return nil\
                end\
                return nil\
            end\
            local ok2, res = pcall(parse)\
            return ok2 and res or {}\
        end,\

    -- DataStoreService — in-memory key-value per store\
    local _ds_stores = {}\
    local function _get_ds(name)\
        if not _ds_stores[name] then\
            local _data = {}\
            _ds_stores[name] = _mk_instance({\
                ClassName      = \"DataStore\",\
                Name           = name,\
                GetAsync        = function(_, key) return _data[tostring(key)] end,\
                SetAsync        = function(_, key, val) _data[tostring(key)] = val; return true end,\
                UpdateAsync     = function(_, key, fn)\
                    local cur = _data[tostring(key)]\
                    local new = fn(cur)\
                    if new ~= nil then _data[tostring(key)] = new end\
                    return new\
                end,\
                IncrementAsync  = function(_, key, delta)\
                    local k = tostring(key)\
                    _data[k] = (tonumber(_data[k]) or 0) + (tonumber(delta) or 1)\
                    return _data[k]\
                end,\
                RemoveAsync     = function(_, key)\
                    local k = tostring(key)\
                    local old = _data[k]; _data[k] = nil; return old\
                end,\
                GetVersionAsync = function(_, key) return _data[tostring(key)], {} end,\
                ListKeysAsync   = function() return _mk_instance({ GetCurrentPage=function() return {} end, IsFinished=true }) end,\
            })\
        end\
        return _ds_stores[name]\
    end\
    local _dss = _mk_instance({\
        ClassName              = \"DataStoreService\",\
        Name                   = \"DataStoreService\",\
        GetDataStore           = function(_, name) return _get_ds(tostring(name or \"default\")) end,\
        GetGlobalDataStore     = function(_) return _get_ds(\"__global\") end,\
