        assert(Type == 'table', `invalid argument #1 to 'rawget' (table expected, got {Type})`)

        if Var then
            if Var == EnvName or Var == "_G" then return (EnvValues[k] or {})[1] end;
            if true then return rawget(GetInternalValue(tbl), k) end
            print("meow?",tbl,k)
            local Var = AppendCall("rawget", tbl, k)

            --return tbl[k]
            --return SafeValue(Var, rawget(GetInternalValue(tbl), k));
            local value = rawget(GetInternalValue(tbl), k)
            return SafeValue(Var, value);
        end
        
        return rawget(tbl, k)
    end

    SecureEnv.rawlen = function(tbl)
        if GetContext(tbl) then
            local Var = AppendCall("rawlen", tbl)
            return SafeValue(Var, 0)
        end

        local Type = Typeof(tbl)
        assert(Type == "table", `invalid argument #1 to 'rawlen', table expected got {Type}`)

        return rawlen(tbl);
    end

    local WrappedUnpack = SafeWrap(unpack, "unpack")
    
    SecureEnv.unpack = function(tab : { any }, i : number?, j : number?)
        if typeof(tab) ~= "table" then return tab end
        if Variables[i] or Variables[j] then
            return WrappedUnpack(tab, i, j)
        end

        return unpack(tab, i, j)
    end

    function GetInfo(i : number | thread) : { [any]: any }?
        local Type = typeof(i)
        if Type ~= "function" and Type ~= "thread" and Type ~= "number" then return {}, true end;
        local Returned = {}

        local s : string, l : number, n : string, params : number, vararg : boolean, f = debuginfo(i, "slnaf");

        Returned.func = i

        local RealC = CClosures[i] or s == "[C]"
        local True = TrueEnv[Variables[i]] -- TrueEnv[getmetatable]

        if True then RealC = RealC or iscclosure(True) end

        if RealC then -- A C Closure
            Returned.what = "C"
            Returned.namewhat = ""
            Returned.source = "=[C]"
            Returned.short_src = "[C]"
            Returned.line, Returned.linedefined, Returned.currentline, Returned.lastlinedefined =
                RealC and -1 or 1, RealC and -1 or 1, RealC and -1 or 1, RealC and -1 or 1
            Returned.numparams, Returned.is_vararg = 0, 1
            Returned.nups = 1;

            local Var = Variables[i] or n
            local name = split(Var, ".")
            name = name[#name]
            Returned.name = name
        else
            if typeof(i) == "number" then
                local CallStackNumbers = {}
                local Traceback = split(debug.traceback(), "\n")
                local String = `[string "{TraceId}"]`--"[string \"luau.load(...)\"]"
                local Len = #String

                for x = 1, #Traceback do
                    local Line = Traceback[x]

                    if Line:sub(1, Len) == String then
                        insert(CallStackNumbers, x)
                    end
                end

                table.sort(CallStackNumbers, function(a, b)
                    return a > b
                end)

                for x, level in next, CallStackNumbers do
                    if x == i then
                        s, l, n, params, vararg, f = debuginfo(level, "slnaf");
                        Returned.line, Returned.linedefined, Returned.currentline = l, l, l;
                        Returned.name = n
                        Returned.is_vararg, Returned.numparams = vararg, params
                        Returned.func = f

                        if n == "" and s == String and vararg then
                            s = TraceId
                        end

                        Returned.source, Returned.short_src = s, s;

                        return Returned;
                    end
                end

                if true then return nil end

                -- Main Env
                Returned.source, Returned.short_src = TraceId, TraceId
                Returned.name = ""
                Returned.func = debuginfo(2, "f")
                Returned.is_vararg, Returned.numparams = true, 0
                Returned.line, Returned.linedefined, Returned.currentline = 1, 1, 1;

                return Returned
            else
                Returned.what = "Lua";
                Returned.line, Returned.linedefined, Returned.currentline = l, l, l;
                Returned.source, Returned.short_src = TraceId, TraceId:sub(1, -2);
                Returned.nups = 0; --> You can do this when getupvalues is implemented
                Returned.is_vararg, Returned.numparams = vararg and 1 or 0, params;
            end
        end

        return Returned
    end

    local function Getupvalues(Func : func | number, Name : string)
        if typeof(Func) == "function" and iscclosure(Func) then
            --error(`{Name} cannot be called on a C closure!`)
        end
    end

    local Debug = GetMetatable("debug", {
        __index = {
            getinfo = Function(function(t, i)
                t, i = GetInternalValue(t), GetInternalValue(i);
                local Type = Typeof(t)
                assert(Type == "function" or Type == "number", "invalid argument #1 to 'getinfo' (function or level expected)")

                if t == 0 then t = Function(function()end,"debug.getinfo",true) end
                if not GetContext(t) then
                    local Info, DoSpy = GetInfo(t)
                    if not DoSpy then return Info end
                    return Spy(AppendCall("debug.getinfo", t, i), Info)
                end

                local Var = AppendCall("debug.getinfo", unpack({t, i}))
                local Info, DoSpy = GetInfo(t)

                if not DoSpy then SetInternalValue(Var, Info) end

                return Spy(Var)
            end, "debug.getinfo", true),
            info = Function(function(...)
                local Raw = pack(...)

                --> Roblox debug.info has a 3-arg thread form: debug.info(thread, level, options).
                --> In that form arg#2 is the numeric level and the options string is arg#3, so the
                --> plain (t, i) shape wrongly rejected the level as "string expected got number".
                local ThreadForm = Raw.n >= 3 and Typeof(Raw[1]) == "thread"
                local t = GetInternalValue(if ThreadForm then Raw[2] else Raw[1]);
                local i = GetInternalValue(if ThreadForm then Raw[3] else Raw[2]);

                assert(typeof(i) == "string", "invalid argument #" .. (if ThreadForm then 3 else 2) .. " to 'info', string expected got " .. typeof(i))

                if t == 0 then t = Function(function()end,"debug.getinfo",true) end

                local Vars = split(string.lower(i), "")
                local Names = { n = "name", a = "params", l = "line", s = "source" }
                local DefinedVars = {}
                local Vararg;

                for _, option in next, Vars do
                    insert(DefinedVars, Ast.Variable(GetCount(Names[option] or option)))

                    if option == "a" then
                        Vararg = GetCount("vararg")
                        insert(DefinedVars, Ast.Variable(Vararg))
                    end
                end

                Ast.addStatement(
                    AST,
                    Ast.Assign(
                        DefinedVars,
                        {Ast.FunctionCall(Ast.Variable("debug.info"), TupleToAST(unpack(Raw, 1, Raw.n)))},
                        false
                    )
                )

                local ToReturn = {}
                local Values = {}

                local Info = GetInfo(t) or {};
                local Skip;

                for x, v in next, Vars do
                    local value;
                    local var = DefinedVars[x + (if Skip then 1 else 0)].data.name
                    Skip = false

                    if v == "s" then
                        value = Info.what == "C" and "[C]" or Info.source
                    elseif v == "n" then
                        value = Info.name or ""
                    elseif v == "a" then
                        value = Info.numparams
                        insert(Values, value)
                        insert(ToReturn, SafeValue(var, value))

                        value = Info.is_vararg == 1

                        insert(Values, value)
                        insert(ToReturn, SafeValue(Vararg, value))
                        Skip = true
                        continue
                    elseif v == "f" then
                        value = Info.func
                        if value then Variables[value] = var end
                    elseif v == "l" then
                        value = Info.line
                    else
                        error("invalid argument #2 to 'info' (invalid option)")
                    end

                    insert(Values, value)
                    insert(ToReturn, SafeValue(var, value))
                end

                OpCountCheck()
            
                return unpack(ToReturn)
            end, "debug.info", true),
            dumpcodesize = Spy("debug.dumpcodesize"),
            traceback = Function(function(a)
                assert(not a or Typeof(a) == "string", "invalid argument #1 to 'traceback' (string expected got " .. Typeof(a) .. ")")

                local trace = debug.traceback(a)
                local lines = split(trace, "\n")
                local out = {}

                for _, v in next, lines do
                    if HideErrors(v) == v then
                        insert(out, v)
                    end
                end --> covering my traces:)

                local value = concat(out, "\n")
                value = gsub(value, ":%d+", ":1"):gsub("%[string [\"'](.-)[\"']%]", "%1")

                local Var = AppendCall("debug.traceback", a)
                Comment(value)

                return SafeValue(Var, value)
            end, "debug.traceback", true),
            getmemorycategory = Function(function()
                return SafeValue(AppendCall("debug.getmemorycategory"), MemoryCategory)
            end, "debug.getmemorycategory", true),
            setmemorycategory = Function(function(Category : string)
                assert(Typeof(Category) == "string", "invalid argument #1 to 'setmemorycategory', string expected got " .. Typeof(Category))
                MemoryCategory = Category
                return SafeValue(AppendCall("debug.getmemorycategory"), MemoryCategory)
            end, "debug.setmemorycategory", true),
            resetmemorycategory = Function(function()
                MemoryCategory = TraceId
            end, "debug.resetmemorycategory", true),
            getlocal = Function(function(func : func, idx : number)
                local Meower = AppendCall("debug.getlocal", func, idx)

                checktype(func, "function", `invalid argument #1 to 'getlocal'`)
                checktype(idx, "number", `invalid argument #2 to 'getlocal'`)

                if iscclosure(func) then
                    return SafeValue(Meower, nil);
                end

                return Spy(Meower, nil, { is_propery = true })
            end, "debug.getlocal", true),
            --[[getupvalues = Function(function(func : func | number)
                AppendCall("debug.getupvalues", func)

                local Type = Typeof(func)
                assert(Type == "function" or Type == "number", `invalid argument #1 to 'getupvalues', function or number expected got {Type}`)
                return Getupvalues(func, "getupvalues")
            end, "debug.getupvalues", true),]]
            getupvalue = Function(function(func : func | number, idx : number)
                local Upvalue = AppendCall("debug.getupvalue", func)

                local Type = Typeof(func)
                assert(Type == "function" or Type == "number", `invalid argument #1 to 'getupvalue', function or number expected got {Type}`)
                
                if iscclosure(func) then error(`'getupvalue' cannot be called on a CClosure!`) end
                if idx <= 0 then error(`invalid argument #2 to 'getupvalue' (invalid index!)`) end

                return Spy(Upvalue, nil, { is_propery = true })--(Getupvalues(func, "getupvalue") or {})[1]
            end, "debug.getupvalue", true)
        }
    })

    SecureEnv.debug = Debug
    SecureEnv.assert = function(condition, message)
        local _c, _m = condition, message

        condition, message = GetInternalValue(condition), GetInternalValue(message)

        if condition ~= _c or _m ~= message then
            AppendCall("assert", _c, _m)
        end

        return assert(condition, message);
    end

        local type = Typeof(Closure)

        local Var = AppendCall("newcclosure", Closure)

        return Function(function(...) return Closure(...) end, Var, true);
    end

    local function CreateEnv(path : string) : { [string]: any }
        local env = Envs[path]
        if env then return env end;
        
        if path == "_G" or path == "shared" then
            --> do it the solara way
            local Meower = CreateEnv("getgenv()")
            local EnvVar = Ast.Variable(path);

            return GetMetatable(path, {
                __index = function(_, Key)
                    if Key == "globalEnv" then return Meower end

                    local Var = DefineVar(
                        Ast.Index(EnvVar, ToAST(Key)),
                        false,
                        true
                    )

                    local ExecType = IsExecutor(Key)

                    -- Hide lune-specific modules from _G to bypass DTC
                    if Key == "process" then
                        return setmetatable({}, {
                            __index = function() return nil end,
                            __newindex = function() end,
                            __tostring = function() return "" end,
                        })
                    end

                    local EnvValue = EnvValues[Key];
                    if EnvValue then
                        return SafeValue(Var, EnvValue[1])
                    elseif not ExecType and not TrueEnv[Key] then
                        return SafeValue(Var, nil);
                    end

                    if (SpyExecOnly and (typeof(Key) == "string" and not ExecType)) or TrueEnv[Key] or Nil[Key] or ForceNil[Key] then
                        return SafeValue(Var, nil);
                    end

                    SetInternalValue(Var, nil);
                    local Meower = Spy(Var);
                    if ExecType then Types[Meower] = ExecType end
                    return Meower
                end
            })
        end

        local Metatable = setmetatable({}, {
            __index = function(Self, Key)
                local Var = DefineVar(
                    Ast.Index(
                        Ast.FunctionCall(Ast.Variable("getgenv"), {}),
                        ToAST(Key)
                    ),
                    false,
                    true
                )

                local Value = EnvValues[Key]
                local Meow = rawget(SecureEnv, Key)
                if Meow then Value = {Meow} end
                
                if Value then
                    local X = Value[1]
                    --if typeof(X) == "function" then return X end;
                    return SafeValue(Var, X)
                end

                local ExecType = IsExecutor(Key)

                if SpyExecOnly then
                    SetInternalValue(Var, nil)
                    return TypeSpy(Var, ExecType)
                end

                if ExecType == "function" then
                    return Function(function(...)
                        local Var = AppendCall(Var, ...)
                        return Spy(Var);
                    end, Var, true)
                end

                local Spied = Spy(Var, rawget(Env, Key));
                if ExecType then
                    Types[Spied] = ExecType
                end

                return Spied;
            end,
            __newindex = function(Self, Key, Value)
                Define(
                    Ast.Index(Ast.FunctionCall(Ast.Variable("getgenv"), {}), ToAST(Key)),
                    ToAST(Value),
                    true,
                    true
                )
                
                EnvValues[Key] = { Value }
            end,
            __metatable = "Protected" -- Solara's implementation
        })
        return Metatable;
    end

    local meowed = {}
    GlobalIndex = function(Self, Key)
        if Settings.debug then print("Indexed",Key,typeof(Key)) end

        local EnvValue = EnvValues[Key]
        local ExecType = IsExecutor(Key)

        if EnvValue then
            return SafeValue(Key, EnvValue[1])
        end

        local Type = typeof(Key)
        local DontDefine, ToUse;

        if Nil[Key] then
            return SafeValue(Key, nil)
        elseif ForceNil[Key] or Type == "nil" then
            return nil;
        end

        if not ExecType and not TrueEnv[Key] then
            ForceNil[Key] = true
            return nil
        end

        if IterFuncs[Key] then
            return Function(function(tbl, k : (any) -> any | nil)
                local Var = Variables[tbl]

                if Key == "next" and Var then
                    if k then
                        if Iterator then Iterator() end
                        Iterator = nil

                        return nil, nil;
                    end

                    Iterator = getmetatable(tbl).__iter(tbl, Key)
                    return Iterator();
                elseif Var then
                    local mt = getmetatable(tbl)
                    if mt then
                        Iterator = mt.__iter(tbl, Key)
                        Iterators[Iterator] = true
                        return Iterator
                    else
                        Ast.addStatement(AST, Ast.PermaComment(Ast.RawText("Unable to get the metatable for '"), Ast.Variable(Var), Ast.RawText(`' so we're unable to log the for loop (which uses {Key}) here.`)))
                    end
                elseif Key == "next" then
                    return next(tbl, k);
                end

                return TrueEnv[Key](tbl, k);
            end, Key, true)
        end

        local IgnoreMar = DoIgnore(Key)
        local Casper = IgnoreMar or -- Detected as junk
            --(Type == "string") or-- and #Key == 2) or -- Moonveil
            (Type == "string" and (#Key == 13 and Key:find("%d"))) or
            Type == "function" or -- fenv[debug.getinfo] or something
            Type == "nil" or -- fenv[nil]
            (SpyExecOnly and not ExecType)

        if Key and not meowed[Key] then
            ToUse = Define(
                if Casper and not IgnoreMar then
                    if typeof(Key) == "string" and not IsWeird(Key) then
                        Ast.Variable(Key:gsub("%W", "_"))
                    else
                        GetVar()
                else
                    GetVar(),
                Ast.Index(Ast.Variable(EnvName), ToAST(Key)),
                false,
                true
            ).data.vars[1].data.name
            DontDefine = true
            ForceNil[Key] = IgnoreMar
            meowed[Key] = ToUse
            Indexes[ToUse] = true
        end

        if
            Casper -- spyexeconly is on & it's not an exec func
        then
            ToUse = ToUse or meowed[Key];
            if not hookOp then
                return nil;
            end
            
            SetInternalValue(ToUse, nil);
            return Spy(ToUse, nil, {
                is_idx = true
            })
        end

        if SharedGlobals.Pristine then
            PristineIdxAmount += 1
            local Saved = SharedGlobals.SavedPristine[Key]
            if Saved then
                rawset(Self, Key, Saved)
                SharedGlobals.SavedPristine[Key] = nil
                return Saved
            end
        end

        ToUse = ToUse or GetVar();
        local True = TrueEnv[Key];
        local Spied;

        if typeof(True) == "function" then
            Spied = Function(function(...)
                local Var = AppendCall(ToUse, ...)
                return Spy(Var)
            end, ToUse, true)
        elseif Type == "string" and Key:find('%W') then
            Spied = Spy(ToUse)
            SetInternalValue(ToUse, nil)
        else
            Spied = Spy(ToUse);
            Types[Spied] = ExecType or typeof(True);
        end

        if not DontDefine then
            Define(
                ToUse,
                Ast.Index(Ast.Variable(EnvName), ToAST(Key)),
                false,
                true
            )
        end

        return Spied
    end

    Env = setmetatable(SecureEnv, getmetatable(GetMetatable(EnvName, {
        __index = GlobalIndex,
        __newindex = function(Self, Key, Value)
            if Key == "_msec" or Key == "heh" then
                return rawset(Self, Key, Value)
            end

            local KeyLen = if typeof(Key) == "string" then #Key else nil;
            local OldVar = Variables[Value]
            local New, ToUse = nil, Ast.Variable(Key);
            local IsFunction = typeof(Value) == "function"
            if IsFunction then
                New = Settings.discord and Function(function(...)
                    local Arg1 = ...
                    if typeof(Arg1) == "string" and DoIgnore(Arg1) then
                        return Value(...)
                    end

                    local Old, Stat = AppendCall(ToUse, ...)
                    local OldLen = VariablesLen
                    local Logged, Values = Explore(Value, {
                        params = {...},
                        bypass_beautify = true
                    })

                    if OldLen ~= VariablesLen then --> New variables added, we don't wanna miss out on them.
                        for _, stat in next, Logged.data.statements do
                            if stat.kind ~= "return" then
                                Ast.addStatement(AST, stat)
                            end
                        end
                    end

                    if Values[1] then
                        Values = table.pack(
                            unpack(Values, 2)
                        )
                        return ToMultiVars(Stat, Values, true)
                    end

                    error(Values[2])
                end, Key, iscclosure(Value)) or Value;
            elseif KeyLen then
                New = Spy(tostring(Key), Value)
            end

            if not New then
                return;
            end

            local Len = if typeof(Value) == "string" then #Value else 0
            
            if Len > 200 or KeyLen == 2 then return rawset(Self, Key, Value) end

            local ToUse = Ast.Index(Ast.Variable(EnvName), ToAST(Key));

            rawset(Self, Key, if IsFunction then New elseif OldVar then SafeValue(AstLib.ExprToCode(ToUse), Value) else Value)

            local Var = Variables[Value]
            if Var and typeof(Value) ~= "table" and not OldVar then Variables[Value] = nil end

            Define( ToUse, ToAST(Value), true, true )

            if Value then Variables[Value] = Var end
        end,
        __tostring = function() return EnvName end,
        __call = function() error("attempt to call a table value") end,
        __add = function(t, v) error(`attempt to perform arithmetic (add) on {Typeof(t)} and {Typeof(v)}`) end,
        __sub = function(t, v) error(`attempt to perform arithmetic (sub) on {Typeof(t)} and {Typeof(v)}`) end,
        __mul = function(t, v) error(`attempt to perform arithmetic (mul) on {Typeof(t)} and {Typeof(v)}`) end,
        __div = function(t, v) error(`attempt to perform arithmetic (div) on {Typeof(t)} and {Typeof(v)}`) end,
        __idiv = function(t, v) error(`attempt to perform arithmetic (idiv) on {Typeof(t)} and {Typeof(v)}`) end,
        __mod = function(t, v) error(`attempt to perform arithmetic (mod) on {Typeof(t)} and {Typeof(v)}`) end,
        __pow = function(t, v) error(`attempt to perform arithmetic (pow) on {Typeof(t)} and {Typeof(v)}`) end,
        __unm = function(t) error(`attempt to perform arithmetic (unm) on {Typeof(t)}`) end,
        __concat = function(t, v) error(`attempt to concatenate {Typeof(t)} and {Typeof(v)}`) end,
    })))

    local Macros = {

        end
    }

    local Beautified = {}

    WHILE_LIMIT /= 2.5
    TotalRepeats, TotalWhiles = 0, 0

    print("Iterating..")

    local PlsSave = Settings.save_before;

    if Settings.runtimelogs or PlsSave then
        local Success, Result = pcall(AstLib.Stringify, AST)
        if Success then
            fs.writeFile(PlsSave and "debug.lua" or Settings.out, Result)
        end
    end

    table.sort(ToExplore, function(a, b) -- a < b
        local DelayA, DelayB = a.args.delay, b.args.delay
        local DeferredA, DeferredB = a.args.deferred, b.args.deferred
    
        -- Handle deferred tasks: deferred items come after non-deferred
        if DeferredA ~= DeferredB then
            return not DeferredA -- non-deferred (false) < deferred (true)
        end
    
        -- Both deferred or both not deferred
        if not DelayA and not DelayB then
            return a.idx < b.idx
        else
            return (DelayA or 0) > (DelayB or 0)
        end
    end)

    local function Iterate()
        yoiterate = true
        for _, Data in next, ToExplore do
            if Beautified[Data] then continue end

            local Function, Id, Node, Args = Data.func, Data.id, Data.node, Data.args

            Args.as_func = true
            Args.bypass_beautify = true

            local Explored = Explore(Function, Args)
            Beautified[Data] = true

            table.clear(Node)

            for i, v in next, Explored do -- Copy everything from the function to here
                Node[i] = v
            end
        end
    end

    Iterate()

    return AST;
end

local LURAPH_MARKER = "does your environment support load/loadstring?"

local function DecompressLuraph(Code : string, Depth : number?) : string?
    --[[
        Luraph's "compressed" output is a small bootstrap that decompresses the
        real VM source into a string, then runs it via loadstring()/load().
        Our env hooks loadstring (it spies instead of really compiling), so the
        decompression corrupts and the script dies with "table overflow".

        Fix (notes.md: "if luraph isn't working, make sure loadstring & setfenv are"
        + "Added automatic luraph decompression"): run the bootstrap in a CLEAN
        sandbox with a real string env, but replace load/loadstring with a capture
        hook. The bootstrap hands us the decompressed source as a plain string; we
        grab the largest valid Luau chunk and hand THAT to EnvLog instead.
    ]]
    Depth = Depth or 0
    if Depth > 4 then return nil end --> guard against pathological nesting

    local Captured = {}
    local function Capture(chunk : any)
        if typeof(chunk) == "string" then insert(Captured, chunk) end
        return function() end --> pretend the load succeeded so the bootstrap continues
    end

    local Sandbox = fenv.setmetatable({
        loadstring = Capture,
        load = Capture,
    }, { __index = TrueEnv })

    local Loaded = loadstring(Code, { debugName = "luraph_decompress" })
    if not Loaded then return nil end

    pcall(fenv.setfenv(Loaded, Sandbox)) --> errors here are fine, we only want the captured payload

    local Best, BestLen = nil, 0
    for _, chunk in next, Captured do
        if #chunk > BestLen then
            local Ok, Compiled = pcall(compile, chunk) --> only keep chunks that are real Luau
            if Ok and Compiled then
                Best, BestLen = chunk, #chunk
            end
        end
    end

    if not Best then return nil end

    --> Luraph can stack compression layers; peel them until we hit real source.
    if Best:find(LURAPH_MARKER, 1, true) then
        return DecompressLuraph(Best, Depth + 1) or Best
    end

    return Best
end

local function TimedDump(File : string, RawContent : boolean?)
    Settings.out = Settings.out or "out.lua"

    local Code : string = RawContent and File or fs.readFile("./" .. File);
    local Source = Code;

    local HookFile = if RawContent then nil else File --> file hookOp reads from; nil = write Code to a temp

    if Code:find(LURAPH_MARKER, 1, true) then
        local Decompressed = DecompressLuraph(Code)
        if Decompressed then
            print(format("Luraph compressed payload detected; decompressed %d -> %d bytes", #Code, #Decompressed))
            Code = Decompressed
            Source = Decompressed
            HookFile = nil --> Code no longer matches File on disk, so hookOp must read our decompressed copy
        else
            warn("Luraph decompression failed; running compressed bootstrap directly")
        end
    end

    local A, B, C, D = Code:byte(1, 4);
    local IsBytecode = false;
    if A == 6 and B == 3 and C == 159 and D == 1 then --> Luau bytecode!
        IsBytecode = true
    end

    if not IsBytecode and not RawContent then
        local StartObf = os.clock()
        local Success, Hooked = UseHookOp(Code, HookFile)
        print("Obfuscated in",os.clock()-StartObf,"seconds.")
        if not Success then
            local Reason = tostring(Hooked)
            local ReasonQuoted = string.format("%q", Reason)
            Code = "print(\"Unable to load hookOp on this file, this file ran as it would without hookOp. Reason: \" .. " .. ReasonQuoted .. ")\n" ..
                Code
        else
            Code = Hooked
        end
    end

    if Settings.version and not RawContent then --> from bot
        fs.removeFile(File);
    end

    AstLib.SetGlobal("outfile", Settings.out)
    AstLib.SetGlobal("envname", EnvName)
    AstLib.SetGlobal("atruntime", Settings.runtimelogs)
    AstLib.SetGlobal("annotations", Settings.type_annotations)
    AstLib.SetGlobal("fromld", Settings.from_ld)
    AstLib.SetGlobal("minifier", Settings.minifier)
    AstLib.SetGlobal("comments", Settings.comments)

    local Start = os.clock()
    --LURAPH_COMPRESSED = Code:find("(does your environment support load/loadstring?", 0, true) and Code:find("Luraph decompression error: ", 0, true)
    local Multiplier = (1 + #Code / (200 * 1024))
    WHILE_LIMIT *= Multiplier
    MAX_OPS_MUL = Multiplier
    
    local Compiled, Loaded;
    if IsBytecode then
        print("yea!")
    end
    local Success, Error = pcall(function()
        Compiled = compile(Code, {
            optimizationLevel = 2
        })
        Loaded = loadstring(Compiled, {
            debugName = TraceId
        })
    end)

    if not Success then
        fs.writeFile(Settings.out, "--err" .. fenv.tostring(Error):match("[^\n]+"))
        process.exit(0)
        return;
    end

    AllowedGetRequests += if Source:find(":HttpGet(", 0, true) then 1 else 0

    local AST, UsedHook
    local OkEnv, EnvErr = pcall(function()
        AST, UsedHook = EnvLog(Loaded, 0), true
    end)
    if not OkEnv then
        warn("decompile runtime error (recovered, partial output may be empty):", EnvErr)
        AST = AST or Ast.new()
        UsedHook = false
    end

    local function AstQuality(ast)
        local total = #ast.data.statements
        if total < 3 then return total end
        local meaningful = 0
        for _, stmt in next, ast.data.statements do
            if stmt.kind ~= "comment" and stmt.kind ~= "nonoptionalcomment" then
                meaningful += 1
            end
        end
        return meaningful
    end

    if AstQuality(AST) < 3 and not IsBytecode and not RawContent then
        local RawCode = Source or Code
        local RawCompiled, RawLoaded
        local RawOk, RawErr = pcall(function()
            RawCompiled = compile(RawCode, { optimizationLevel = 2 })
            RawLoaded = loadstring(RawCompiled, { debugName = TraceId .. "_raw" })
        end)
        if RawOk then
            print("retrying with .r (raw code)")
            local RawAST = EnvLog(RawLoaded, 0)
            if AstQuality(RawAST) > AstQuality(AST) then
                print(format(".r fallback better (%d > %d stmts)", AstQuality(RawAST), AstQuality(AST)))
                AST = RawAST
                UsedHook = false
            end
        end
    end

    if AstQuality(AST) < 3 and not IsBytecode and not RawContent then
        local TempIn = Settings.out .. ".r2_in.lua"
        local TempOut = Settings.out .. ".r2_out.lua"
        local luneBin = process.os == "windows" and "lune.exe" or "lune"
        pcall(fs.writeFile, TempIn, Code)
        local POut = process.exec(luneBin, { "run", "mods/aspect.luau", TempIn, TempOut })
        if POut and POut.exitCode == 0 then
            local OkR2, ResultR2 = pcall(fs.readFile, TempOut)
            if OkR2 and #ResultR2 > 50 then
                print(format(".r2 (aspect) fallback produced %d bytes", #ResultR2))
                local NewAST = Ast.new()
                Ast.addStatement(NewAST, Ast.RawText(ResultR2))
                AST = NewAST
                UsedHook = false
            end
        end
        pcall(fs.removeFile, TempIn)
        pcall(fs.removeFile, TempOut)
    end

    DONE_PROCESSING = true

    Success, Result = pcall(AstLib.Stringify, AstLib.Minify(AST, not Settings.minifier))

    if not Success then
        warn("not success", Result)
    end

    Result = (if Settings.debug then Result else HideErrors(Result, nil, true)):gsub("\n%s*;\n", "\n"):gsub("discord%.gg/[%w_]+", "(discord invite)")

    local TopComment = "-- URLs requested via HTTP:"
    local Meowed;
    for _, v in next, AllowedUrlsInTheEnd do
        TopComment ..= `\n-- URL: {v.Url}\n-- METHOD: {v.Method}`
        Meowed = true
    end

    if Meowed then Result = TopComment .. "\n\n" .. Result end

    print(format("Finished processing in %.8f seconds!", os.clock() - Start))
    fs.writeFile(
        Settings.out,
        (if Settings.version then `-- powered by dsc.gg/6vms\n\n` else "")
        .. Result
    );
    _print("Finished processing")
    process.exit(0);
end

if Settings.ipt then --> Spawned instantly, for beta testing or whatever.
    return TimedDump(Settings.ipt or "input.lua");
end

    TimedDump(Decoded.script, true)
end

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Token:
    kind: str
    value: str
    start: int
    end: int


KEYWORDS = set("and break do else elseif end false for function if in local nil not or repeat return then true until while continue type export typeof self if".split())
BUILTINS = set("assert collectgarbage error getfenv getmetatable ipairs load loadstring next pairs pcall print rawequal rawget rawlen rawset select setfenv setmetatable tonumber tostring type typeof unpack xpcall coroutine debug math string table os utf8 bit32 buffer task game workspace script shared _G Enum Instance Vector2 Vector3 CFrame Color3 UDim UDim2 BrickColor RaycastParams TweenInfo Random Region3 OverlapParams PhysicalProperties NumberRange NumberSequence ColorSequence DateTime CatalogSearchParams Font Faces Axes Region3int16 PathWaypoint PathStatus".split())
LUA_OPERATORS = ("...", "..=", "//=", "<<=", ">>=", "+=", "-=", "*=", "/=", "%=", "^=", "..", "//", "==", "~=", "<=", ">=", "::", "->", "<<", ">>", "+=", "-=", "*=", "/=", "%=", "^=", "=", "+", "-", "*", "/", "%", "^", "#", "&", "~", "|", "<", ">", "(", ")", "{", "}", "[", "]", ";", ":", ",", ".")


def tokenize_lua(source: str, include_comments: bool = False) -> list[Token]:

    out: list[Token] = []
    n, i = len(source), 0
    while i < n:
        c = source[i]
        if c.isspace():
            i += 1
            continue

        if source.startswith("--", i):
            j = i + 2
            m = re.match(r"\[(=*)\[", source[j:])
            if m:
                eq = m.group(1)
                content_start = j + m.end()
                close = "]" + eq + "]"
                k = source.find(close, content_start)
                end = n if k < 0 else k + len(close)
                if include_comments:
                    out.append(Token("comment", source[i:end], i, end))
                i = end
            else:
                k = source.find("\n", j)
                end = n if k < 0 else k
                if include_comments:
                    out.append(Token("comment", source[i:end], i, end))
                i = end
            continue
        long_match = re.match(r"\[(=*)\[", source[i:])
        if long_match:
            eq = long_match.group(1)
            close = "]" + eq + "]"
            content_start = i + long_match.end()
            k = source.find(close, content_start)
            end = n if k < 0 else k + len(close)
            out.append(Token("string", source[i:end], i, end))
            i = end
            continue
        if c in "'\"":
            quote, j = c, i + 1
            while j < n:
                if source[j] == "\\":
                    j += 2
                    continue
                if source[j] == quote:
                    j += 1
                    break
                j += 1
            out.append(Token("string", source[i:min(j, n)], i, min(j, n)))
            i = min(j, n)
            continue
        if c.isalpha() or c == "_":
            j = i + 1
            while j < n and (source[j].isalnum() or source[j] == "_"):
                j += 1
            val = source[i:j]
            out.append(Token("keyword" if val in KEYWORDS else "identifier", val, i, j))
            i = j
            continue
        if c.isdigit() or (c == "." and i + 1 < n and source[i + 1].isdigit()):
            m = re.match(r"(?:0[xX][0-9a-fA-F]+(?:\.[0-9a-fA-F]*)?(?:[pP][+-]?\d+)?|(?:\d+\.?\d*|\.\d+)(?:[eE][+-]?\d+)?)", source[i:])
            if m:
                j = i + len(m.group(0))
                out.append(Token("number", source[i:j], i, j))
                i = j
                continue
        op = next((x for x in LUA_OPERATORS if source.startswith(x, i)), None)
        if op:
            out.append(Token("operator", op, i, i + len(op)))
            i += len(op)
        else:
            out.append(Token("symbol", c, i, i + 1))
            i += 1
    return out


def _long_string_value(value: str) -> str:
    m = re.match(r"^\[(=*)\[(.*)\]\1\]$", value, re.S)
    if not m:
        return value
    body = m.group(2)
    if body.startswith("\r\n"):
        body = body[2:]
    elif body.startswith("\n") or body.startswith("\r"):
        body = body[1:]
    return body


def decode_lua_string(value: str) -> str:

    if value.startswith("["):
        return _long_string_value(value)
    if len(value) < 2 or value[0] not in "'\"":
        return value
    body = value[1:-1] if value[-1] == value[0] else value[1:]
    out: list[str] = []
    i = 0
    simple = {"a": "\a", "b": "\b", "f": "\f", "n": "\n", "r": "\r", "t": "\t", "v": "\v", "\\": "\\", "\"": '"', "'": "'"}
    while i < len(body):
        if body[i] != "\\" or i + 1 >= len(body):
            out.append(body[i]); i += 1; continue
        i += 1
        c = body[i]
        if c in simple:
            out.append(simple[c]); i += 1
        elif c == "z":
            i += 1
            while i < len(body) and body[i].isspace():
                i += 1
        elif c in "\r\n":
            if c == "\r" and i + 1 < len(body) and body[i + 1] == "\n":
                i += 1
            out.append("\n"); i += 1
        elif c == "x" and i + 2 < len(body) and re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-fA-F]{2}", body[i + 1:i + 3]):
            out.append(chr(int(body[i + 1:i + 3], 16))); i += 3
        elif c == "u" and i + 1 < len(body) and body[i + 1] == "{":
            k = body.find("}", i + 2)
            if k >= 0:
                try:
                    out.append(chr(int(body[i + 2:k], 16)))
                    i = k + 1
                except (ValueError, OverflowError):
                    out.append("\\u"); i += 1
            else:
                out.append("\\u"); i += 1
        elif c.isdigit():
            j = i
            while j < min(i + 3, len(body)) and body[j].isdigit():
                j += 1
            out.append(chr(int(body[i:j]) % 256)); i = j
        else:

            out.append(c); i += 1
    return "".join(out)


def lua_quote(text: str) -> str:
    return '"' + text.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace('"', '\\"').replace("\n", "\\n").replace("\r", "\\r").replace("\t", "\\t") + '"'


def shannon_entropy(data: bytes) -> float:
    if not data:
        return 0.0
    counts = Counter(data)
    total = len(data)
    return -sum((n / total) * math.log2(n / total) for n in counts.values())


def printable_ratio(data: bytes) -> float:
    if not data:
        return 1.0
    allowed = set(bytes(string.printable, "ascii"))
    return sum(b in allowed for b in data) / len(data)


def get_text(data: bytes) -> str:
    for enc in ("utf-8-sig", "utf-8", "cp1252", "latin-1"):
        try:
            return data.decode(enc)
        except UnicodeDecodeError:
            pass
    return data.decode("utf-8", "replace")


def _masked_source(source: str) -> str:

    chars = list(source)
    for tok in tokenize_lua(source, include_comments=True):
        if tok.kind in ("string", "comment"):
            for i in range(tok.start, tok.end):
                if chars[i] not in "\r\n":
                    chars[i] = " "
    return "".join(chars)


def _noncode_ranges(source: str) -> list[tuple[int, int]]:
    return [(t.start, t.end) for t in tokenize_lua(source, include_comments=True) if t.kind in ("string", "comment")]


def _is_in_ranges(position: int, ranges: list[tuple[int, int]]) -> bool:
    return any(start <= position < end for start, end in ranges)


def _literal_clean(data: bytes) -> str:
    s = get_text(data).strip().strip("\ufeff")
    s = s.strip().strip("\"'")
    return re.sub(r"\s+", "", s)


def _base64_decode(data: bytes) -> bytes:
    s = _literal_clean(data)
    if not re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9+/=_-]*", s):
        candidates = re.findall(r"[A-Za-z0-9+/_=-]{8,}", s)
        if candidates:
            s = max(candidates, key=len)
    s = s.replace("-", "+").replace("_", "/")
    s += "=" * ((-len(s)) % 4)
    return base64.b64decode(s, validate=True)


def _parse_key(args) -> bytes:
    if getattr(args, "key_hex", None):
        return bytes.fromhex(args.key_hex.replace(" ", ""))
    key = getattr(args, "key", None)
    if key is None:
        raise ValueError("حدّد المفتاح باستخدام --key أو --key-hex")
    return str(key).encode("utf-8")


def _decode_output(data: bytes) -> str:
    try:
        return data.decode("utf-8-sig")
    except UnicodeDecodeError:
        return "تعذّر عرض الناتج كنص UTF-8. أول 512 بايت بصيغة hex:\n" + data[:512].hex(" ") + ("\n..." if len(data) > 512 else "")


def _string_tokens(source: str) -> list[tuple[int, str, str]]:
    return [(t.start, t.value, decode_lua_string(t.value)) for t in tokenize_lua(source) if t.kind == "string"]


def _score_plain(data: bytes) -> float:
    if not data:
        return 0.0
    printable = sum(1 for b in data if b in (9, 10, 13) or 32 <= b <= 126) / len(data)
    letters = sum(1 for b in data if chr(b).lower() in "etaoinshrdlu") / len(data)
    return printable * 0.78 + letters * 0.22


def _file_type(data: bytes) -> str:
    signatures = [
        (b"\x1f\x8b", "gzip"), (b"BZh", "bzip2"), (b"\xfd7zXZ\x00", "xz/lzma"),
        (b"PK\x03\x04", "ZIP"), (b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n", "PNG"), (b"\xff\xd8\xff", "JPEG"),
        (b"GIF87a", "GIF"), (b"GIF89a", "GIF"), (b"%PDF-", "PDF"), (b"MZ", "Windows PE"),
        (b"\x7fELF", "ELF executable"), (b"SQLite format 3\x00", "SQLite database"),
    ]
    for sig, name in signatures:
        if data.startswith(sig): return name
    if data.startswith(b"\x00asm"): return "WebAssembly"
    try:
        text = data[:4096].decode("utf-8")
        if "function" in text or "local " in text or "return " in text:
            return "text / likely Lua-Luau source"
        if text and sum(ch.isprintable() or ch in "\r\n\t" for ch in text) / len(text) > 0.9:
            return "UTF-8 text"
    except UnicodeDecodeError:
        pass
    return "unknown / binary"


def _source(args, data: bytes) -> str:
    return get_text(data)


def _find_matching(tokens: list[Token], start_idx: int) -> int | None:
    depth = 0
    for j in range(start_idx, len(tokens)):
        if tokens[j].value == "(": depth += 1
        elif tokens[j].value == ")":
            depth -= 1
            if depth == 0: return j
    return None


def _replace_constant_calls(source: str, func_names: set[str], mode: str) -> tuple[str, int]:
    tokens = tokenize_lua(source)
    replacements: list[tuple[int, int, str]] = []
    i = 0
    while i < len(tokens) - 3:
        name = None
        if tokens[i].kind == "identifier" and tokens[i].value in {"string", "utf8"} and tokens[i + 1].value == "." and tokens[i + 2].value in func_names and tokens[i + 3].value == "(":
            name = tokens[i].value + "." + tokens[i + 2].value
            op_idx = i + 3
        elif tokens[i].kind == "identifier" and tokens[i].value in func_names and tokens[i + 1].value == "(":
            name = tokens[i].value
            op_idx = i + 1
        else:
            i += 1; continue
        end_idx = _find_matching(tokens, op_idx)
        if end_idx is None:
            i += 1; continue
        args_tokens = tokens[op_idx + 1:end_idx]
        try:
            chunks: list[list[Token]] = [[]]
            depth = 0
            for tk in args_tokens:
                if tk.value == "(" or tk.value == "{" or tk.value == "[": depth += 1
                elif tk.value == ")" or tk.value == "}" or tk.value == "]": depth -= 1
                if tk.value == "," and depth == 0: chunks.append([])
                else: chunks[-1].append(tk)
            if len(chunks) == 1 and not chunks[0]:
                vals: list[int] = []
            else:
                vals = []
                for ch in chunks:
                    raw = "".join(t.value for t in ch).strip()
                    if not re.fullmatch(r"(?:0[xX][0-9a-fA-F]+|\d+)", raw): raise ValueError
                    vals.append(int(raw, 0))
            if mode == "char":
                if any(v < 0 or v > 0x10FFFF for v in vals): raise ValueError
                value = "".join(chr(v) for v in vals)
            else:
                value = "".join(chr(v % 256) for v in vals)
            replacements.append((tokens[i].start, tokens[end_idx].end, lua_quote(value)))
            i = end_idx + 1
        except (ValueError, OverflowError):
            i = end_idx + 1
    for start, end, value in reversed(replacements):
        source = source[:start] + value + source[end:]
    return source, len(replacements)


def _safe_numeric_eval(node: ast.AST):
    if isinstance(node, ast.Constant) and isinstance(node.value, (int, float)) and not isinstance(node.value, bool):
        if abs(node.value) > 1e12: raise ValueError
        return node.value
    if isinstance(node, ast.UnaryOp) and isinstance(node.op, (ast.UAdd, ast.USub)):
        value = _safe_numeric_eval(node.operand)
        return value if isinstance(node.op, ast.UAdd) else -value
    if isinstance(node, ast.BinOp) and isinstance(node.op, (ast.Add, ast.Sub, ast.Mult, ast.Div, ast.FloorDiv, ast.Mod, ast.Pow)):
        left, right = _safe_numeric_eval(node.left), _safe_numeric_eval(node.right)
        if isinstance(node.op, ast.Add): val = left + right
        elif isinstance(node.op, ast.Sub): val = left - right
        elif isinstance(node.op, ast.Mult): val = left * right
        elif isinstance(node.op, ast.Div): val = left / right
        elif isinstance(node.op, ast.FloorDiv): val = left // right
        elif isinstance(node.op, ast.Mod): val = left % right
        else:
            if abs(right) > 12: raise ValueError
            val = left ** right
        if abs(val) > 1e12: raise ValueError
        return val
    raise ValueError


def _json(obj) -> str:
    return json.dumps(obj, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, sort_keys=True)


def _tool_base64_decode(data, args): return _base64_decode(data)
def _tool_base64_encode(data, args): return base64.b64encode(data).decode("ascii")
def _tool_base32_decode(data, args):
    s = _literal_clean(data).upper(); s += "=" * ((-len(s)) % 8); return base64.b32decode(s, casefold=True)
def _tool_hex_decode(data, args):
    s = get_text(data).strip()
    s = re.sub(r"(?i)^0x", "", s)
    s = re.sub(r"\s+|0x", "", s, flags=re.I)
    return bytes.fromhex(s)

    except Exception: return s.encode("utf-8").decode("unicode_escape", "replace")
def _tool_rot13(data, args): return codecs.decode(get_text(data), "rot_13")
def _tool_caesar_bruteforce(data, args):
    s = get_text(data); rows = []
    for shift in range(26):
        out = []
        for ch in s:
            if "a" <= ch <= "z": out.append(chr((ord(ch)-97-shift)%26+97))
            elif "A" <= ch <= "Z": out.append(chr((ord(ch)-65-shift)%26+65))
            else: out.append(ch)
        rows.append(f"shift={shift:02d}: {''.join(out)}")
    return "\n".join(rows)
def _tool_xor_single(data, args):
    key_s = args.key
    if key_s is None: raise ValueError("استخدم --key 0x41 (من 0 إلى 255)")
    key = int(str(key_s), 0)
    if not 0 <= key <= 255: raise ValueError("مفتاح XOR الأحادي يجب أن يكون بين 0 و255")
    return bytes(x ^ key for x in data)
def _tool_xor_repeating(data, args):
    key = _parse_key(args)
    if not key: raise ValueError("المفتاح لا يجوز أن يكون فارغاً")
    return bytes(b ^ key[i % len(key)] for i, b in enumerate(data))
def _tool_xor_bruteforce(data, args):
    top = max(1, min(256, args.top or 12)); rows = []
    for k in range(256):
        out = bytes(b ^ k for b in data)
        rows.append((_score_plain(out), k, out))
    rows.sort(reverse=True, key=lambda x: x[0])
    return "\n".join(f"key=0x{k:02X} score={score:.3f} sample={out[:100]!r}" for score, k, out in rows[:top])
def _tool_xor_key_length(data, args):
    b = data; max_k = min(max(2, args.top or 40), 80, max(2, len(b)//4)); scores = []
    def hd(a, c): return (a ^ c).bit_count()
    for size in range(2, max_k + 1):
        blocks = [b[i:i+size] for i in range(0, min(len(b), size*8), size)]
        pairs = [(blocks[i], blocks[i+1]) for i in range(len(blocks)-1) if len(blocks[i]) == size and len(blocks[i+1]) == size]
        if not pairs: continue
        norm = sum(sum(hd(x, y) for x, y in zip(a, c))/size for a, c in pairs)/len(pairs)
        scores.append((norm, size))
    return "\n".join(f"key_length={size:2d} normalized_hamming={score:.4f}" for score, size in sorted(scores)[:15]) or "بيانات غير كافية لتقدير طول المفتاح."
def _tool_decompress(data, args):

    limit = 50_000_000
    errors = []
    attempts = [
        ("gzip", lambda: zlib.decompressobj(16 + zlib.MAX_WBITS)),
        ("zlib", lambda: zlib.decompressobj(zlib.MAX_WBITS)),
        ("raw-deflate", lambda: zlib.decompressobj(-zlib.MAX_WBITS)),
    ]
    for name, factory in attempts:
        try:
            dec = factory()
            out = dec.decompress(data, limit + 1)
            if len(out) > limit or dec.unconsumed_tail:
                raise ValueError("output exceeds 50MB limit")
            if dec.eof:
                return out
            errors.append(f"{name}: incomplete stream")
        except Exception as exc:
            errors.append(f"{name}: {type(exc).__name__}")
    for name, factory in (("bzip2", bz2.BZ2Decompressor), ("lzma/xz", lzma.LZMADecompressor)):
        try:
            dec = factory()
            out = dec.decompress(data, max_length=limit + 1)
            if len(out) > limit or not dec.eof:
                raise ValueError("output exceeds 50MB limit or stream incomplete")
            return out
        except Exception as exc:
            errors.append(f"{name}: {type(exc).__name__}")
    raise ValueError("لم تنجح خوارزميات الضغط الشائعة؛ " + ", ".join(errors))
def _tool_entropy(data, args): return f"bytes={len(data)}\nentropy_bits_per_byte={shannon_entropy(data):.6f}\nmax_for_byte_data=8.000000"
def _tool_extract_strings(data, args):
    min_len = max(1, args.min_length or 4); rows = []
    for m in re.finditer(rb"[\x20-\x7e\t]{" + str(min_len).encode() + rb",}", data):
        rows.append(f"0x{m.start():08X}  {m.group().decode('ascii', 'replace')}")

    for m in re.finditer(rb"(?:[\x20-\x7e]\x00){" + str(min_len).encode() + rb",}", data):
        try: rows.append(f"0x{m.start():08X}  {m.group().decode('utf-16le')}")
        except UnicodeDecodeError: pass
    return "\n".join(sorted(set(rows))) or "لم تُعثر على سلاسل قابلة للطباعة."
def _tool_hashes(data, args):
    return _json({"size_bytes": len(data), "md5": hashlib.md5(data).hexdigest(), "sha1": hashlib.sha1(data).hexdigest(), "sha256": hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(), "sha512": hashlib.sha512(data).hexdigest(), "blake2b": hashlib.blake2b(data).hexdigest()})
def _tool_file_identify(data, args): return f"type={_file_type(data)}\nsize_bytes={len(data)}\nhead_hex={data[:32].hex(' ')}"
def _tool_encoding_detect(data, args):
    if data.startswith(codecs.BOM_UTF8): enc = "utf-8-sig"
    elif data.startswith(codecs.BOM_UTF16_LE): enc = "utf-16le BOM"
    elif data.startswith(codecs.BOM_UTF16_BE): enc = "utf-16be BOM"
    else:
        try: data.decode("utf-8"); enc = "UTF-8 (valid)"
        except UnicodeDecodeError:
            try: data.decode("cp1252"); enc = "Windows-1252 (likely)"
            except UnicodeDecodeError: enc = "Latin-1 fallback (not uniquely detectable)"
    return f"encoding_guess={enc}\nbytes={len(data)}"
def _tool_printable_ratio(data, args): return f"bytes={len(data)}\nprintable_ratio={printable_ratio(data):.4f}\nprintable_percent={printable_ratio(data)*100:.2f}%"
def _tool_token_count(data, args):

    return _json({"total_tokens": len(t), "by_kind": dict(counts), "keyword_count": sum(x.kind == "keyword" for x in t), "identifier_count": sum(x.kind == "identifier" for x in t), "string_count": sum(x.kind == "string" for x in t), "number_count": sum(x.kind == "number" for x in t)})

def _tool_extract_long_strings(data, args):

    for pos, raw, decoded in _string_tokens(s):
        if len(decoded) >= cutoff: rows.append(f"offset={pos} length={len(decoded)} raw={raw[:100]!r}\n{decoded[:2000]}\n---")

def _tool_decode_string_literals(data, args):
    s = get_text(data); tokens = tokenize_lua(s); reps = 0
    for tok in reversed(tokens):
        if tok.kind == "string":
            dec = lua_quote(decode_lua_string(tok.value))
            s = s[:tok.start] + dec + s[tok.end:]; reps += 1
    return f"-- decoded string literals: {reps}\n" + s
def _tool_extract_numbers(data, args):
    s = get_text(data); t = tokenize_lua(s)
    return "\n".join(f"offset={x.start:8d} literal={x.value} decimal={_number_decimal(x.value)}" for x in t if x.kind == "number") or "لا توجد أرقام."
def _number_decimal(s):
    try: return str(int(s, 0)) if s.lower().startswith("0x") else str(float(s) if any(c in s for c in ".eE") else int(s))
    except ValueError: return "?"
def _tool_check_brackets(data, args):
    s = get_text(data); toks = tokenize_lua(s); pairs = {")": "(", "]": "[", "}": "{"}; stack = []; issues = []
    for tok in toks:
        if tok.kind in ("string", "comment"): continue
        if tok.value in "([{": stack.append(tok)
        elif tok.value in pairs:
            if not stack or stack[-1].value != pairs[tok.value]: issues.append(f"unmatched {tok.value!r} at offset {tok.start}")
            else: stack.pop()
    issues.extend(f"unclosed {x.value!r} at offset {x.start}" for x in stack)
    return "\n".join(issues) if issues else f"OK: all (), [] and {{}} are balanced. tokens={len(toks)}"
def _tool_check_blocks(data, args):
    toks = tokenize_lua(get_text(data)); stack: list[Token] = []; issues=[]
    for i, tok in enumerate(toks):
        if tok.kind == "string": continue
        v = tok.value
        if v in ("function", "if", "do", "repeat"):
            stack.append(tok)
        elif v == "end":
            if not stack: issues.append(f"extra 'end' at offset {tok.start}")
            elif stack[-1].value == "repeat": issues.append(f"'end' cannot close tracked repeat at offset {tok.start}; heuristic check")
            else: stack.pop()
        elif v == "until":
            idx = next((j for j in range(len(stack)-1, -1, -1) if stack[j].value == "repeat"), None)
            if idx is None: issues.append(f"'until' without visible 'repeat' at offset {tok.start}")
            else: stack.pop(idx)
    issues.extend(f"unclosed '{x.value}' near offset {x.start}" for x in stack)
    if issues: return "Heuristic block check (not a full Luau parser):\n" + "\n".join(issues)
    return "No obvious function/if/do/repeat block imbalance detected (heuristic only)."
def _tool_tokenize(data, args):
    s = get_text(data); toks = tokenize_lua(s, include_comments=True)
    return "\n".join(f"{i:05d} {t.kind:10s} [{t.start}:{t.end}] {t.value[:160]!r}" for i,t in enumerate(toks))
def _needs_space(a: Token, b: Token) -> bool:
    if a.kind in ("identifier", "keyword", "number") and b.kind in ("identifier", "keyword", "number"): return True
    joined = a.value + b.value
    multi = ("--", "..", "...", "//", "==", "~=", "<=", ">=", "::", "<<", ">>", "+=", "-=", "*=", "/=", "%=", "^=", "..=")
    return any(joined.endswith(op) and (a.value + b.value).find(op) >= 0 and op not in (a.value, b.value) for op in multi)
def _tool_minify(data, args):
    t = tokenize_lua(get_text(data)); parts=[]; prev=None
    for tok in t:
        if prev and _needs_space(prev, tok): parts.append(" ")
        parts.append(tok.value); prev=tok
    return "".join(parts)
def _tool_pretty_print(data, args):
    source = get_text(data)
    toks = tokenize_lua(source, include_comments=True)

    function_closers = set()
    for i, tok in enumerate(toks):
        if tok.kind == "keyword" and tok.value == "function":
            j = i + 1
            while j < len(toks) and toks[j].value not in ("(", "end", "then", "do", ";"):
                j += 1
            if j < len(toks) and toks[j].value == "(":
                close = _find_matching(toks, j)
                if close is not None:
                    function_closers.add(close)
    out: list[str] = []
    indent = 0
    line = ""
    unit = "    "

    def flush():
        nonlocal line
        if line.strip():
            out.append(unit * max(0, indent) + line.strip())
        line = ""

    def add(value: str):
        nonlocal line
        if not line:
            line = value
        elif value in (".", ":", ")", "]", "}", ",", ";"):
            line = line.rstrip() + value
        elif line.endswith((".", ":", "(", "[", "{", " ")):
            line += value
        elif value in ("(", "["):
            line += value
        elif value in ("=", "+", "-", "*", "/", "%", "^", "==", "~=", "<=", ">=", "..", "and", "or"):
            line = line.rstrip() + " " + value + " "
        else:
            line += " " + value

    for i, tok in enumerate(toks):
        v = tok.value
        next_value = toks[i + 1].value if i + 1 < len(toks) else ""
        if i > 0 and "\n" in source[toks[i - 1].end:tok.start] and line.strip():
            flush()
        if tok.kind == "comment":
            if line:
                line += " " + v
            else:
                line = v
            flush()
            continue
        if v == "end":
            flush()
            indent = max(0, indent - 1)
            line = "end"
            if next_value not in (",", ")", "]", "}", ";"):
                flush()
            continue
        if v in ("else", "elseif"):
            flush()
            indent = max(0, indent - 1)
            line = v
            if v == "else":
                flush()
                indent += 1
            continue
        if v == "until":
            flush()
            indent = max(0, indent - 1)
            line = "until"
            continue
        add(v)
        if v in ("then", "do", "repeat"):
            flush()
            indent += 1
        elif v == ";":
            flush()
        elif i in function_closers:
            flush()
            indent += 1
    flush()
    return "\n".join(out) + "\n"

def _tool_constant_fold(data, args):
    src=get_text(data); count=0

    pattern=re.compile(r"\(\s*((?:0[xX][0-9a-fA-F]+|\d+(?:\.\d+)?(?:[eE][+-]?\d+)?|\.\d+)(?:\s*[+\-*/%()]\s*(?:0[xX][0-9a-fA-F]+|\d+(?:\.\d+)?(?:[eE][+-]?\d+)?|\.\d+))+)\s*\)")
    for _ in range(20):
        changed=False
        blocked = _noncode_ranges(src)
        def repl(m):
            nonlocal count, changed
            if _is_in_ranges(m.start(), blocked):
                return m.group(0)
            exp=m.group(1)
            py= re.sub(r"\b0[xX]([0-9a-fA-F]+)\b", lambda z: str(int(z.group(0),16)), exp)
            try:
                tree=ast.parse(py, mode="eval"); val=_safe_numeric_eval(tree.body)
                result=str(int(val)) if isinstance(val,float) and val.is_integer() else repr(val)
                count += 1; changed=True; return result
            except Exception: return m.group(0)
        newer=pattern.sub(repl, src)
        src=newer
        if not changed: break
    return f"-- constant-folded expressions: {count}\n"+src
def _tool_decode_string_charcodes(data, args):
    src, count=_replace_constant_calls(get_text(data), {"char"}, "char")
    return f"-- decoded string.char/utf8.char calls: {count}\n"+src
def _tool_fold_table_concat(data, args):
    src=get_text(data); pattern=re.compile(r"table\s*\.\s*concat\s*\(\s*\{([^{}]*)\}\s*\)"); count=0
    for _ in range(10):
        blocked = _noncode_ranges(src)
        def repl(m):
            nonlocal count
            if _is_in_ranges(m.start(), blocked): return m.group(0)
            body=m.group(1); toks=tokenize_lua(body); vals=[]; expect_value=True
            for tok in toks:
                if expect_value and tok.kind == "string": vals.append(decode_lua_string(tok.value)); expect_value=False
                elif tok.value == ",": expect_value=True
                else: return m.group(0)
            if not vals and body.strip(): return m.group(0)
            count += 1; return lua_quote("".join(vals))
        newer=pattern.sub(repl, src)
        if newer==src: break
        src=newer
    return f"-- folded table.concat literals: {count}\n"+src
def _tool_reverse_string_fold(data, args):
    src=get_text(data); pattern=re.compile(r"string\s*\.\s*reverse\s*\(\s*((?:\"(?:\\\\.|[^\"\\\\])*\")|(?:'(?:\\\\.|[^'\\\\])*'))\s*\)"); count=0
    blocked = _noncode_ranges(src)
    def repl(m):
        nonlocal count
        if _is_in_ranges(m.start(), blocked): return m.group(0)
        count+=1; return lua_quote(decode_lua_string(m.group(1))[::-1])
    src=pattern.sub(repl, src)
    return f"-- folded string.reverse literals: {count}\n"+src
def _tool_suspicious_api_scan(data, args):

      "dynamic_code":r"\b(loadstring|load)\s*\(", "http_request":r"\b(request|http_request|syn\.request|http\.request)\b",

def _tool_network_indicators(data, args):
    s=get_text(data); found=[]
    for m in re.finditer(r"https?://[^\s\"'<>`]+", s, re.I):
        url=m.group(0).rstrip(",);]}"); redacted=re.sub(r"(?i)(/api/webhooks/\d+/)[^/?#]+", r"\1[REDACTED_TOKEN]", url)
        redacted=re.sub(r"(?i)(/webhooks/\d+/)[^/?#]+", r"\1[REDACTED_TOKEN]", redacted)
        found.append((s.count("\n",0,m.start())+1, redacted))
    for m in re.finditer(r"\b[\w.-]+\.(?:com|net|org|io|gg|dev|app|xyz|ru|co|me|info|site)\b", s, re.I):
        if not any(m.group(0) in u for _,u in found): found.append((s.count("\n",0,m.start())+1,m.group(0)))
    return "\n".join(f"line {ln}: {item}" for ln,item in sorted(set(found))) or "لا توجد روابط أو نطاقات واضحة."

def _tool_complexity_metrics(data, args):
    s=get_text(data); toks=tokenize_lua(s); kw=Counter(t.value for t in toks if t.kind=="keyword")
    lines=s.splitlines(); return _json({"bytes_utf8":len(s.encode()),"characters":len(s),"lines":len(lines),"nonempty_lines":sum(bool(x.strip()) for x in lines),"tokens":len(toks),"identifiers":sum(t.kind=="identifier" for t in toks),"string_literals":sum(t.kind=="string" for t in toks),"numeric_literals":sum(t.kind=="number" for t in toks),"functions":sum(t.value=="function" for t in toks),"branches_if":sum(t.value=="if" for t in toks),"loops_for_while":sum(t.value in ("for","while") for t in toks),"repeat_loops":sum(t.value=="repeat" for t in toks),"cyclomatic_approx":1+sum(t.value in ("if","for","while","repeat","and","or") for t in toks),"keywords":dict(kw)})
def _tool_obfuscation_score(data, args):
    s=get_text(data); toks=tokenize_lua(s); ids=[t.value for t in toks if t.kind=="identifier"]
    avg_id=(sum(len(x) for x in ids)/len(ids)) if ids else 0
    compact=(1.0-len(s.splitlines())/max(1,len(s)))
    short_ids=sum(1 for x in ids if len(x)<=2)/max(1,len(ids))
    string_tokens=[t for t in toks if t.kind=="string"]
    escaped=sum(1 for t in string_tokens if "\\" in t.value)/max(1,len(string_tokens))
    long_strings=sum(1 for t in string_tokens if len(t.value)>200)/max(1,len(string_tokens))
    dynamic=sum(1 for t in toks if t.value in ("loadstring","getfenv","setfenv"))
    score=max(0,min(100,round(22*compact+22*short_ids+18*escaped+18*long_strings+20*min(1,dynamic/2))))
    return _json({"heuristic_obfuscation_score_0_100":score,"interpretation":"heuristic only; not a verdict","characters":len(s),"lines":len(s.splitlines()),"identifier_count":len(ids),"average_identifier_length":round(avg_id,2),"short_identifier_fraction":round(short_ids,3),"escaped_string_fraction":round(escaped,3),"long_string_fraction":round(long_strings,3),"dynamic_loader_tokens":dynamic,"entropy_bits_per_byte":round(shannon_entropy(data),4)})
def _tool_duplicate_lines(data, args):
    s=get_text(data); table={};
    for i,line in enumerate(s.splitlines(),1):
        stripped=line.strip()
        if not stripped: continue
        table.setdefault(stripped,[]).append(i)
    rows=[(v,k) for k,v in table.items() if len(v)>1]
    return "\n".join(f"lines={','.join(map(str,locs))} count={len(locs)} text={text[:180]!r}" for locs,text in sorted(rows,reverse=True)) or "لا توجد أسطر مكررة غير فارغة."
def _tool_repeated_strings(data, args):
    vals=Counter(decoded for _,_,decoded in _string_tokens(get_text(data)))
    return "\n".join(f"count={n:4d} value={v[:250]!r}" for v,n in vals.most_common() if n>1) or "لا توجد string literals متكررة واضحة."
def _tool_dead_branch_hints(data, args):
    s=get_text(data); scan=_masked_source(s); hints=[]
    pats=[(r"\bif\s+false\s+then\b","if false then: branch unreachable unless rewritten dynamically"),(r"\bif\s+true\s+then\b","if true then: constant condition"),(r"\bwhile\s+false\s+do\b","while false do: loop body unreachable"),(r"\bif\s+0\s+then\b","if 0 then: note Luau treats 0 as truthy"),(r"\bif\s+nil\s+then\b","if nil then: branch not taken"),(r"\breturn\b[^\n]*\n\s*\w+\s*=","assignment after return on next line may be unreachable")]
    for pat,msg in pats:
        for m in re.finditer(pat,scan): hints.append(f"line {s.count(chr(10),0,m.start())+1}: {msg}: {m.group(0)[:120]!r}")
    return "\n".join(hints) or "لم تظهر أنماط dead-code البسيطة. هذه مجرد تلميحات ثابتة."
def _tool_vm_classify(data, args):
    s=get_text(data); scan=_masked_source(s); low=scan.lower(); checks={
      "opcode dispatch loop":bool(re.search(r"\bwhile\s+(?:true|\w+)\s+do",scan)) and bool(re.search(r"\b(opcode|op|instruction|dispatch)\b",low)),
      "numeric opcode table":bool(re.search(r"\[\s*\d+\s*\]\s*=\s*(?:function|\w+)",scan)),
      "string/bytecode reader":bool(re.search(r"string\.(?:byte|sub)\s*\(",scan)),
      "bitwise decoder patterns":bool(re.search(r"\bbit32\.|\bbit\.(?:bxor|band|bor|rshift|lshift)",scan)),
      "dynamic code loading":bool(re.search(r"\bloadstring\s*\(",scan)),
      "packed numeric payload":bool(re.search(r"(?:0x[\da-fA-F]{2,}|\\\d{2,}){5,}",scan)),
      "large string payload":any(len(v)>500 for _,_,v in _string_tokens(s)),
      "pc/register-like state":bool(re.search(r"\b(pc|program_counter|registers|stack|top)\b",low)),
      "repeated opcode case clauses":len(re.findall(r"\bcase\s+\d+",scan,re.I))>=3,
    }
    score=sum(checks.values()); return _json({"vm_or_packed_loader_likelihood":"high" if score>=5 else "medium" if score>=3 else "low/unclear","indicator_score":score,"indicators":checks,"note":"Static heuristics only; no code is executed."})
def _tool_vm_extract_opcodes(data, args):
    s=get_text(data); scan=_masked_source(s); patterns=[r"\[\s*(\d+)\s*\]\s*=\s*function\b",r"\[\s*(\d+)\s*\]\s*=\s*([A-Za-z_][\w.]*)",r"\bcase\s+(\d+)\s*:"]
    out=[]
    for pat in patterns:
        for m in re.finditer(pat,scan,re.I): out.append((s.count("\n",0,m.start())+1,m.group(1),m.group(2) if m.lastindex and m.lastindex>1 else "case"))
    return "\n".join(f"line {ln}: opcode/index={op} -> {target}" for ln,op,target in sorted(set(out))) or "لم تُكتشف أنماط جداول opcode الشائعة. جرّب tokenize وvm-classify." 
def _tool_vm_opcode_histogram(data, args):
    s=get_text(data); scan=_masked_source(s); nums=Counter()
    for m in re.finditer(r"\[\s*(\d{1,5})\s*\]\s*=\s*(?:function\b|[A-Za-z_][\w.]*)",scan): nums[m.group(1)]+=1
    if not nums:
        for m in re.finditer(r"\bopcode\s*==\s*(\d{1,5})",scan,re.I): nums[m.group(1)]+=1
    return "\n".join(f"opcode/index {k:>6s}: {v}" for k,v in sorted(nums.items(),key=lambda kv:int(kv[0]))) or "لا توجد مؤشرات opcode منظمة بما يكفي لبناء histogram."
def _tool_vm_dispatch_map(data, args):
    s=get_text(data); scan=_masked_source(s); lines=s.splitlines(); scan_lines=scan.splitlines(); hits=[]
    needles=re.compile(r"\b(while\s+true|while\s+\w+\s+do|opcode|dispatch|instruction|program_counter|registers|stack|case\s+\d+|\[\s*\d+\s*\]\s*=\s*function)\b",re.I)
    for i,line in enumerate(lines):
        if needles.search(scan_lines[i]):
            start=max(0,i-1); end=min(len(lines),i+2)
            hits.append(f"--- around line {i+1} ---\n"+"\n".join(f"{j+1}: {lines[j][:300]}" for j in range(start,end)))

    uniq=[]; seen=set()
    for x in hits:
        if x not in seen: uniq.append(x); seen.add(x)
    return "\n".join(uniq[:60]) or "لم تظهر مناطق dispatch واضحة."
def _tool_analyze(data, args):
    s=get_text(data); scan=_masked_source(s); toks=tokenize_lua(s); strings=_string_tokens(s)
    services=sorted(set(m.group(1) for m in re.finditer(r"(?:GetService|FindService)\s*\(\s*['\"]([^'\"]+)['\"]\s*\)",s)))
    urls=[]
    for m in re.finditer(r"https?://[^\s\"'<>`]+",s,re.I):
        u=m.group(0).rstrip(",);]}"); u=re.sub(r"(?i)(/api/webhooks/\d+/)[^/?#]+",r"\1[REDACTED_TOKEN]",u); u=re.sub(r"(?i)(/webhooks/\d+/)[^/?#]+",r"\1[REDACTED_TOKEN]",u); urls.append(u)
    apis={name:len(re.findall(pat,scan,re.I)) for name,pat in {"loadstring":r"\bloadstring\s*\(","HttpGet/PostAsync":r"\b(?:HttpGet|GetAsync|PostAsync|RequestAsync)\b","filesystem":r"\b(?:readfile|writefile|appendfile|delfile)\b","executor_api":r"\b(?:getgenv|hookfunction|hookmetamethod|newcclosure)\b","websocket":r"\bWebSocket\b"}.items()}
    vm=_tool_vm_classify(data,args)
    return _json({"file":{"size_bytes":len(data),"type_guess":_file_type(data),"lines":len(s.splitlines()),"sha256":hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()},"metrics":{"tokens":len(toks),"identifiers":sum(t.kind=="identifier" for t in toks),"strings":len(strings),"numbers":sum(t.kind=="number" for t in toks),"entropy":round(shannon_entropy(data),5),"printable_ratio":round(printable_ratio(data),5)},"services":services,"api_indicators":apis,"network_indicators":sorted(set(urls)),"long_strings":[{"offset":p,"length":len(v),"preview":v[:120]} for p,_,v in strings if len(v)>100][:30],"vm_heuristics":json.loads(vm),"static_only":True})
