MAX_AUTO_BYTES = 8 * 1024 * 1024


def _arg(args, name, default=None):
    return getattr(args, name, default)


def _source_text(data: bytes) -> str:
    return data.decode("utf-8-sig", errors="replace")


def _luaish_score(data: bytes) -> float:

    if not data:
        return -10.0
    ratio = printable_ratio(data)
    try:
        text = data.decode("utf-8-sig")
    except UnicodeDecodeError:
        text = data.decode("latin-1", errors="replace")
        ratio *= 0.75
    low = text.lower()
    markers = ("local ", "function", "return ", "end", "then", "game:", "getservice", "string.", "table.", "bit32.", "loadstring", "while ", "repeat", "until ")
    marker_score = min(1.0, sum(low.count(m) for m in markers) / max(3.0, len(text) / 350.0))
    entropy_penalty = max(0.0, shannon_entropy(data) - 7.5) / 6.0
    nul_penalty = data.count(b"\x00") / len(data)
    return ratio * 3.0 + marker_score * 1.2 - entropy_penalty - nul_penalty * 4.0


def _try_decode_candidates(data: bytes):


    s = data.decode("ascii", errors="ignore").strip()
    compact = re.sub(r"\s+", "", s)
    if len(compact) >= 8 and re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9+/]*={0,2}", compact) and len(compact) % 4 == 0:
        try:
            decoded = base64.b64decode(compact, validate=True)
            if decoded and decoded != data:
                yield "base64", decoded
        except Exception:
            pass
    if len(compact) >= 8 and re.fullmatch(r"[A-Z2-7]+=*", compact.upper()):
        try:
            padded = compact.upper() + "=" * ((-len(compact)) % 8)
            decoded = base64.b32decode(padded, casefold=True)
            if decoded and decoded != data:
                yield "base32", decoded
        except Exception:
            pass
    if len(compact) >= 8 and re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-fA-F]+", compact) and len(compact) % 2 == 0:
        try:
            decoded = bytes.fromhex(compact)
            if decoded and decoded != data:
                yield "hex", decoded
        except Exception:
            pass
    if len(compact) >= 10 and re.fullmatch(r"[!-u]*", compact):
        try:
            decoded = base64.a85decode(compact.encode("ascii"), adobe=False, ignorechars=b" \t\r\n\v")
            if decoded and decoded != data:
                yield "ascii85", decoded
        except Exception:
            pass
    if len(compact) >= 10 and re.fullmatch(r"[0-9A-Za-z!#$%&()*+\-;<=>?@^_`{|}~]+", compact):
        try:
            decoded = base64.b85decode(compact.encode("ascii"))
            if decoded and decoded != data:
                yield "base85", decoded
        except Exception:
            pass
    if re.search(rb"%[0-9A-Fa-f]{2}", data):
        try:
            decoded = urllib.parse.unquote_to_bytes(data.decode("latin-1"))
            if decoded != data:
                yield "url-percent", decoded
        except Exception:
            pass
    if data.startswith(b"\x1f\x8b"):
        try:
            dec = zlib.decompressobj(zlib.MAX_WBITS | 16)
            decoded = dec.decompress(data, MAX_AUTO_BYTES + 1)
            if len(decoded) <= MAX_AUTO_BYTES and dec.eof:
                yield "gzip", decoded
        except Exception:
            pass

    if len(data) >= 8:
        for wbits, label in ((zlib.MAX_WBITS, "zlib"), (-zlib.MAX_WBITS, "raw-deflate"), (zlib.MAX_WBITS | 16, "gzip-deflate")):
            try:
                dec = zlib.decompressobj(wbits)
                decoded = dec.decompress(data, MAX_AUTO_BYTES + 1)
                if decoded and len(decoded) <= MAX_AUTO_BYTES and dec.eof and decoded != data:
                    yield label, decoded
            except Exception:
                pass
    if data.startswith(b"BZh"):
        try:
            dec = bz2.BZ2Decompressor()
            decoded = dec.decompress(data, max_length=MAX_AUTO_BYTES + 1)
            if len(decoded) <= MAX_AUTO_BYTES and dec.eof:
                yield "bzip2", decoded
        except Exception:
            pass
    if data.startswith(b"\xfd7zXZ\x00"):
        try:
            dec = lzma.LZMADecompressor()
            decoded = dec.decompress(data, max_length=MAX_AUTO_BYTES + 1)
            if len(decoded) <= MAX_AUTO_BYTES and dec.eof:
                yield "lzma-xz", decoded
        except Exception:
            pass

    if re.search(rb"\\(?:x[0-9A-Fa-f]{2}|u[0-9A-Fa-f]{4}|[0-9]{1,3})", data):
        try:
            text = data.decode("utf-8")
            decoded = codecs.decode(text, "unicode_escape").encode("latin-1", errors="replace")
            if decoded != data:
                yield "backslash-escapes", decoded
        except Exception:
            pass

    if data and printable_ratio(data) > 0.88:
        try:
            text = data.decode("utf-8")
            rot = codecs.decode(text, "rot_13").encode("utf-8")
            if rot != data and _luaish_score(rot) > _luaish_score(data) + 0.15:
                yield "rot13", rot
        except Exception:
            pass

    if len(data) >= 8 and printable_ratio(data) < 0.94:
        ranked = []
        probe = data[:min(len(data), 4096)]
        for key in range(256):
            cand = bytes(b ^ key for b in probe)
            sc = _luaish_score(cand)
            if sc >= 2.0:
                ranked.append((sc, key))
        for _, key in sorted(ranked, reverse=True)[:3]:
            yield f"xor-byte-0x{key:02x}", bytes(b ^ key for b in data)


def _auto_decode(data: bytes, max_depth=7, beam=12):

    if len(data) > MAX_AUTO_BYTES:
        raise ValueError(f"input exceeds safe auto-decode limit ({MAX_AUTO_BYTES} bytes)")
    start = (data, [], _luaish_score(data))
    frontier = [start]
    seen = {hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()}
    all_states = [start]
    for _depth in range(max(1, min(max_depth, 12))):
        new = []
        for blob, chain, old_score in frontier:
            if len(blob) > MAX_AUTO_BYTES:
                continue
            for method, decoded in _try_decode_candidates(blob):
                if not decoded or len(decoded) > MAX_AUTO_BYTES:
                    continue
                digest = hashlib.sha256(decoded).hexdigest()
                if digest in seen:
                    continue
                seen.add(digest)
                score = _luaish_score(decoded)


                if score > old_score - 0.12 or len(decoded) < len(blob) * 0.84:
                    state = (decoded, chain + [{"method": method, "input_bytes": len(blob), "output_bytes": len(decoded), "score": round(score, 4)}], score)
                    new.append(state)
        if not new:
            break
        rank = lambda item: (item[2] + min(1.3, len(item[1]) * 0.12), _source_likelihood(item[0]), -len(item[0]))
        new.sort(key=rank, reverse=True)
        frontier = new[:max(2, min(beam, 16))]
        all_states.extend(new[:max(2, min(beam, 16))])

        if len(all_states) > 32:
            all_states.sort(key=rank, reverse=True)
            all_states = all_states[:32]

    all_states.sort(key=lambda item: (item[2] + min(1.25, len(item[1]) * 0.12), _source_likelihood(item[0]), -len(item[0])), reverse=True)
    return all_states[0], all_states


def _source_likelihood(data: bytes) -> float:
    text = data.decode("utf-8", errors="ignore").lower()
    return min(2.0, sum(text.count(m) for m in ("function", "local ", "return", "end", "then", "game:", "getservice")) / 10.0)


def _tool_auto_decode(data, args):
    best, states = _auto_decode(data, _arg(args, "depth", 7), _arg(args, "beam", 12))
    blob, chain, score = best
    if _arg(args, "report", None):
        Path(args.report).write_text(_json({"chain": chain, "candidate_count": len(states), "best_bytes": len(blob), "score": round(score, 4), "sha256": hashlib.sha256(blob).hexdigest()}), encoding="utf-8")
    return blob


def _tool_auto_decode_report(data, args):
    best, states = _auto_decode(data, _arg(args, "depth", 7), _arg(args, "beam", 12))
    blob, chain, score = best
    return _json({"input_bytes": len(data), "candidate_count": len(states), "selected": {"bytes": len(blob), "score": round(score, 4), "sha256": hashlib.sha256(blob).hexdigest(), "detected_type": _file_type(blob), "chain": chain}, "alternatives": [{"bytes": len(b), "score": round(sc, 4), "sha256": hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest(), "chain": ch} for b, ch, sc in states[:20]], "selected_preview_utf8": blob[:2400].decode("utf-8", errors="replace"), "selected_preview_hex": blob[:128].hex(" ")})


def _tool_deobfuscate(data, args):
    src = _source_text(data)
    before = src
    counts = defaultdict(int)
    passes = [
        ("decode-string-literals", _tool_decode_string_literals),
        ("decode-string-charcodes", _tool_decode_string_charcodes),
        ("fold-table-concat", _tool_fold_table_concat),
        ("reverse-string-fold", _tool_reverse_string_fold),
        ("fold-bit32", None),
        ("fold-string-format", None),
        ("constant-fold", _tool_constant_fold),
        ("fold-table-index", None),
    ]
    for round_no in range(1, max(1, min(_arg(args, "depth", 6), 12)) + 1):
        original = src
        for name, fn in passes:
            if fn is not None:
                result = fn(src.encode("utf-8"), args)
                text = result.decode("utf-8", errors="replace") if isinstance(result, bytes) else str(result)


                text = re.sub(r"^-- (?:decoded string|folded |constant-folded|folded string)[^\n]*\n", "", text, count=1)
            elif name == "fold-bit32":
                text = _fold_bit32_source(src)[0]
            else:
                text = _fold_string_format_source(src)[0] if name == "fold-string-format" else _fold_table_index_source(src)[0]
            if text != src:
                counts[name] += 1
                src = text
        if src == original:
            break
    report = {"passes": dict(counts), "rounds_limit": _arg(args, "depth", 6), "input_bytes": len(data), "output_bytes": len(src.encode()), "changed": src != before, "static_only": True, "notes": ["Heuristic source reconstruction only; review changes before execution.", "No supplied Luau code was executed."]}
    report_path = _arg(args, "report", None)
    if report_path:
        Path(report_path).write_text(_json(report), encoding="utf-8")
    return src


def _split_top_level_args(tokens):
    chunks, current, depth = [], [], 0
    for token in tokens:
        if token.value in ("(", "{", "["): depth += 1
        elif token.value in (")", "}", "]"): depth = max(0, depth - 1)
        if token.value == "," and depth == 0:
            chunks.append(current); current = []
        else:
            current.append(token)
    if current or chunks:
        chunks.append(current)
    return chunks


def _constant_number(raw: str):
    raw = raw.strip().replace("_", "")
    if not re.fullmatch(r"(?:0[xX][0-9a-fA-F]+|\d+(?:\.\d*)?(?:[eE][+-]?\d+)?|\.\d+(?:[eE][+-]?\d+)?)", raw):
        raise ValueError("not a numeric literal")
    return float.fromhex(raw) if raw.lower().startswith("0x") and ("p" in raw.lower()) else int(raw, 0) if raw.lower().startswith("0x") else float(raw) if any(c in raw for c in ".eE") else int(raw)


def _fold_bit32_source(src: str):
    tokens = tokenize_lua(src)
    replacements, i = [], 0
    supported = {"band", "bor", "bxor", "bnot", "lshift", "rshift", "arshift", "lrotate", "rrotate", "extract", "replace"}
    while i < len(tokens) - 3:
        if tokens[i].value not in ("bit32", "bit") or tokens[i + 1].value != "." or tokens[i + 2].value not in supported or tokens[i + 3].value != "(":
            i += 1; continue
        end = _find_matching(tokens, i + 3)
        if end is None: i += 1; continue
        chunks = _split_top_level_args(tokens[i + 4:end])
        try:
            vals = [int(_constant_number("".join(t.value for t in ch))) for ch in chunks]
            fn = tokens[i + 2].value
            mask = 0xFFFFFFFF
            if fn == "band": out = mask
            elif fn == "bor" or fn == "bxor": out = 0
            elif fn == "bnot": out = ~vals[0] & mask
            elif fn == "lshift": out = (vals[0] << (vals[1] & 31)) & mask
            elif fn == "rshift": out = (vals[0] & mask) >> (vals[1] & 31)
            elif fn == "arshift": out = ((vals[0] & mask) - (1 << 32) if vals[0] & (1 << 31) else vals[0] & mask) >> (vals[1] & 31); out &= mask
            elif fn == "lrotate":
                n = vals[1] & 31; x = vals[0] & mask; out = ((x << n) | (x >> ((32 - n) & 31))) & mask
            elif fn == "rrotate":
                n = vals[1] & 31; x = vals[0] & mask; out = ((x >> n) | (x << ((32 - n) & 31))) & mask
            elif fn == "extract":
                field = vals[1]; width = vals[2] if len(vals) > 2 else 1; out = ((vals[0] & mask) >> field) & ((1 << width) - 1)
            elif fn == "replace":
                field = vals[2] if len(vals) > 2 else 0; width = vals[3] if len(vals) > 3 else 1; m = ((1 << width) - 1) << field; out = ((vals[0] & ~m) | ((vals[1] << field) & m)) & mask
            if fn == "band":
                for v in vals: out &= v
            elif fn == "bor":
                for v in vals: out |= v
            elif fn == "bxor":
                for v in vals: out ^= v
            out = int(out) & mask
            replacements.append((tokens[i].start, tokens[end].end, str(out)))
            i = end + 1
        except Exception:
            i = end + 1
    for start, end, repl in reversed(replacements):
        src = src[:start] + repl + src[end:]
    return src, len(replacements)


def _tool_fold_bit32(data, args):
    src, count = _fold_bit32_source(_source_text(data))
    return f"-- folded constant bit32 calls: {count}\n" + src


def _fold_string_format_source(src: str):
    tokens = tokenize_lua(src)
    edits = []
    i = 0
    while i + 3 < len(tokens):
        if not (tokens[i].value == "string" and tokens[i+1].value == "." and tokens[i+2].value == "format" and tokens[i+3].value == "("):
            i += 1; continue
        end = _find_matching(tokens, i+3)
        if end is None:
            i += 1; continue
        chunks = _split_top_level_args(tokens[i+4:end])
        try:
            if not chunks or not chunks[0] or chunks[0][0].kind != "string" or len(chunks[0]) != 1:
                raise ValueError("format must be one literal string")
            fmt = decode_lua_string(chunks[0][0].value)
            vals = []
            for chunk in chunks[1:]:
                raw = "".join(t.value for t in chunk).strip()
                if len(chunk) == 1 and chunk[0].kind == "string": vals.append(decode_lua_string(chunk[0].value))
                elif re.fullmatch(r"[-+]?\d+", raw): vals.append(int(raw))
                elif re.fullmatch(r"[-+]?(?:\d+\.\d*|\d*\.\d+)(?:[eE][-+]?\d+)?", raw): vals.append(float(raw))
                else: raise ValueError("non-literal format argument")
            rendered = fmt % (tuple(vals) if len(vals) != 1 else vals[0]) if vals else fmt
            if len(rendered.encode("utf-8")) > 100_000: raise ValueError("result too large")
            edits.append((tokens[i].start, tokens[end].end, lua_quote(rendered)))
            i = end + 1
        except Exception:
            i = end + 1
    for a,b,repl in reversed(edits): src = src[:a] + repl + src[b:]
    return src, len(edits)

def _tool_fold_string_format(data, args):
    src, count = _fold_string_format_source(_source_text(data))
    return f"-- folded constant string.format calls: {count}\n" + src


def _fold_table_index_source(src: str):

    tokens = tokenize_lua(src)
    arrays = {}
    i = 0
    while i + 3 < len(tokens):
        j = i
        if tokens[j].value == "local": j += 1
        if j + 3 >= len(tokens) or tokens[j].kind != "identifier" or tokens[j+1].value != "=":
            i += 1; continue
        name = tokens[j].value
        if tokens[j+2].value != "{": i += 1; continue
        depth = 0; end = None
        for k in range(j+2, len(tokens)):
            if tokens[k].value == "{": depth += 1
            elif tokens[k].value == "}":
                depth -= 1
                if depth == 0: end = k; break
        if end is None: i += 1; continue
        chunks = _split_top_level_args(tokens[j+3:end])
        vals = []
        try:
            for chunk in chunks:
                if not chunk: continue
                if len(chunk) == 1 and chunk[0].kind == "string": vals.append(("string", decode_lua_string(chunk[0].value)))
                elif len(chunk) == 1 and chunk[0].kind == "number":

                    _constant_number(chunk[0].value)
                    vals.append(("number", chunk[0].value))
                else: raise ValueError("not a literal scalar array")
            if vals: arrays[name] = vals
        except ValueError: pass
        i = end + 1
    edits = []
    for i in range(len(tokens)-3):
        if tokens[i].kind == "identifier" and tokens[i].value in arrays and tokens[i+1].value == "[" and tokens[i+2].kind == "number" and tokens[i+3].value == "]":
            try: idx = int(tokens[i+2].value, 0) - 1
            except ValueError: continue
            vals = arrays[tokens[i].value]
            if 0 <= idx < len(vals):
                kind,value=vals[idx]
                edits.append((tokens[i].start,tokens[i+3].end,lua_quote(value) if kind=="string" else value))
    for a,b,repl in reversed(edits): src=src[:a]+repl+src[b:]
    return src, len(edits)

def _tool_fold_table_index(data, args):
    src, count = _fold_table_index_source(_source_text(data))
    return f"-- folded constant table indexes: {count}\n" + src


def _tool_decode_hex_escapes(data, args):
    src = _source_text(data); edits = 0
    for start, raw, decoded in reversed(_string_tokens(src)):
        val = re.sub(r"\\x([0-9A-Fa-f]{2})", lambda m: chr(int(m.group(1), 16)), raw)
        val = re.sub(r"\\([0-9]{1,3})", lambda m: chr(int(m.group(1)) % 256), val)
        if val != raw:
            src = src[:start] + lua_quote(decode_lua_string(val)) + src[start + len(raw):]
            edits += 1
    return f"-- decoded numeric string escapes: {edits}\n" + src


def _tool_decode_unicode_braces(data, args):
    src = _source_text(data); edits = 0
    for start, raw, decoded in reversed(_string_tokens(src)):
        new = re.sub(r"\\u\{([0-9A-Fa-f]{1,6})\}", lambda m: chr(int(m.group(1), 16)) if int(m.group(1), 16) <= 0x10FFFF else m.group(0), raw)
        if new != raw:
            src = src[:start] + lua_quote(decode_lua_string(new)) + src[start + len(raw):]
            edits += 1
    return f"-- decoded Unicode-brace escapes: {edits}\n" + src


def _tool_decode_charcode_variants(data, args):
    src = _source_text(data); total = 0
    src, n = _replace_constant_calls(src, {"char"}, "char"); total += n
    src, n = _replace_constant_calls(src, {"char"}, "byte"); total += n
    src, n = _fold_bit32_source(src); total += n
    return f"-- decoded constant character constructions: {total}\n" + src


def _tool_extract_constant_pool(data, args):
    src = _source_text(data); toks = tokenize_lua(src); constants = []
    for t in toks:
        if t.kind == "string":
            value = decode_lua_string(t.value)
            constants.append({"kind": "string", "line": src.count("\n", 0, t.start) + 1, "offset": t.start, "length": len(value), "value": value[:300]})
        elif t.kind == "number":
            constants.append({"kind": "number", "line": src.count("\n", 0, t.start) + 1, "offset": t.start, "value": t.value})
    return _json({"constant_count": len(constants), "constants": constants[:max(1, min(_arg(args, "top", 250), 5000))]})


def _tool_extract_functions(data, args):
    src = _source_text(data); toks = tokenize_lua(src); out = []
    for i, t in enumerate(toks):
        if t.value == "function":
            name = "<anonymous>"
            if i + 1 < len(toks) and toks[i + 1].kind == "identifier":
                j = i + 1; parts = [toks[j].value]; j += 1
                while j + 1 < len(toks) and toks[j].value in (".", ":") and toks[j + 1].kind == "identifier":
                    parts += [toks[j].value, toks[j + 1].value]; j += 2
                name = "".join(parts)
            line = src.count("\n", 0, t.start) + 1
            out.append({"name": name, "line": line, "offset": t.start, "context": src[t.start:min(len(src), t.start+180)].splitlines()[0][:180]})
    return _json({"function_keywords": len(out), "functions": out[:_arg(args, "top", 500)]})


def _tool_call_graph(data, args):
    src = _source_text(data); toks = tokenize_lua(src); defs = set()
    for i, t in enumerate(toks[:-1]):
        if t.value == "function" and toks[i+1].kind == "identifier": defs.add(toks[i+1].value)
        if t.value == "local" and i+2 < len(toks) and toks[i+1].kind == "identifier" and toks[i+2].value == "=" and any(x.value == "function" for x in toks[i+3:i+7]): defs.add(toks[i+1].value)
    edges = Counter(); calls = Counter()
    for i in range(len(toks)-1):
        if toks[i].kind == "identifier" and toks[i+1].value == "(":
            name = toks[i].value
            if name in defs: calls[name] += 1

            caller = None
            for j in range(i-1, max(-1, i-500), -1):
                if toks[j].value == "function":
                    if j+1 < len(toks) and toks[j+1].kind == "identifier": caller = toks[j+1].value
                    break
            if caller and name in defs: edges[(caller, name)] += 1
    return _json({"definitions": sorted(defs), "calls_to_defined_functions": dict(calls), "edges": [{"from": a, "to": b, "count": n} for (a,b),n in edges.items()], "accuracy_note": "Lexical approximation; closures and scopes may be misattributed."})


def _tool_control_flow_report(data, args):
    src = _source_text(data); toks = tokenize_lua(src); rows = []
    for i, t in enumerate(toks):
        if t.value in ("if", "elseif", "while", "until", "for"):
            end = min(len(toks), i+24)
            j = i+1
            while j < end and toks[j].value not in ("then", "do", "\n"):
                j += 1
            cond = " ".join(x.value for x in toks[i+1:j])[:180]
            rows.append({"line": src.count("\n",0,t.start)+1,"kind":t.value,"condition_guess":cond})
    assign = re.compile(r"\b([A-Za-z_]\w*)\s*(?:\+=|-=|=)\s*([^\n;]{1,160})")
    state_changes = [{"line":src.count("\n",0,m.start())+1,"target":m.group(1),"expression":m.group(2).strip()} for m in assign.finditer(_masked_source(src)) if re.search(r"\b(?:pc|state|opcode|instruction|dispatch|step|i|ip)\b",m.group(1),re.I)]
    return _json({"branch_count":len(rows),"branches":rows[:1000],"state_like_assignments":state_changes[:500],"static_only":True})


def _tool_dispatcher_candidates(data, args):
    src = _source_text(data); scan = _masked_source(src); rows=[]
    for pat, kind in ((r"\bwhile\s+(?:true|1)\s+do", "infinite_loop_dispatch"),(r"\bwhile\s+[^\n]{0,100}\s+do", "loop_dispatch"),(r"\b(?:if|elseif)\s+([A-Za-z_]\w*)\s*==\s*(?:0x[0-9A-Fa-f]+|\d+)", "numeric_opcode_branch"),(r"\b(?:handlers|opcodes|instructions|dispatch)\s*\[", "indexed_dispatch"),(r"\b(?:bit32|bit)\s*\.\s*bxor\s*\(", "bitwise_decode") ):
        for m in re.finditer(pat, scan, re.I): rows.append({"kind":kind,"line":src.count("\n",0,m.start())+1,"offset":m.start(),"preview":src[m.start():min(len(src),m.start()+140)].splitlines()[0]})
    counts=Counter(r["kind"] for r in rows)
    return _json({"candidate_count":len(rows),"counts":dict(counts),"candidates":rows[:1000],"note":"Candidates are evidence for manual analysis, not proof of a VM."})


def _tool_vm_state_map(data, args):
    src = _source_text(data); scan = _masked_source(src); lines=[]
    patterns = [("pc_update",r"\b([A-Za-z_]\w*)\s*(?:=|\+=|-=)\s*[^\n;]{0,120}(?:\+\s*1|\+\s*[A-Za-z_]\w*|\b(?:pc|state|ip)\b)"),("state_compare",r"\b([A-Za-z_]\w*)\s*==\s*(0x[0-9a-fA-F]+|\d+|[A-Za-z_]\w*)"),("dispatch_table",r"\b([A-Za-z_]\w*)\s*\[\s*([A-Za-z_]\w*)\s*\]")]
    for label, pat in patterns:
        for m in re.finditer(pat, scan, re.I): lines.append({"kind":label,"line":src.count("\n",0,m.start())+1,"match":m.group(0)[:180]})
    return _json({"candidates":lines[:1000],"variables_ranked":Counter(re.findall(r"\b(?:pc|state|opcode|instruction|dispatch|ip|step)\w*\b", scan, re.I)),"note":"Heuristic; no instruction semantics are inferred here."})


def _tool_table_shape(data, args):
    src = _source_text(data); tables=[]
    for m in re.finditer(r"\b(?:local\s+)?([A-Za-z_]\w*)\s*=\s*\{([^{}]{0,10000})\}", _masked_source(src), re.S):
        body = src[m.start(2):m.end(2)]; toks = tokenize_lua(body)
        numeric_keys = len(re.findall(r"\[\s*(?:0x[\da-fA-F]+|\d+)\s*\]\s*=", body))
        keyed = len(re.findall(r"\b[A-Za-z_]\w*\s*=", body))
        positional = max(0, sum(1 for t in toks if t.value == ",") + (1 if body.strip() else 0) - numeric_keys - keyed)
        tables.append({"name":m.group(1),"line":src.count("\n",0,m.start())+1,"bytes":len(body),"entries_estimate":body.count(",")+bool(body.strip()),"numeric_keys":numeric_keys,"named_fields":keyed,"positional_estimate":positional,"contains_functions":body.count("function"),"preview":body[:180]})
    return _json({"table_candidates":len(tables),"tables":tables[:_arg(args,"top",400)]})


def _tool_local_constants(data, args):
    src = _source_text(data); scan=_masked_source(src); findings=[]
    pattern = re.compile(r"\blocal\s+([A-Za-z_]\w*)\s*=\s*(\"(?:\\\\.|[^\"\\\\])*\"|'(?:\\\\.|[^'\\\\])*'|0[xX][0-9a-fA-F]+|[-+]?\d+(?:\.\d+)?)")
    for m in pattern.finditer(scan):
        name, lit = m.groups(); rest = scan[m.end():]
        writes = len(re.findall(rf"\b{re.escape(name)}\s*=(?!=)", rest))
        if writes == 0:
            val = decode_lua_string(lit) if lit.startswith(("'",'"')) else lit
            findings.append({"name":name,"line":src.count("\n",0,m.start())+1,"literal":val,"kind":"string" if lit.startswith(("'",'"')) else "number","reassigned_later":bool(writes)})
    return _json({"constant_candidates":len(findings),"constants":findings[:_arg(args,"top",1000)],"note":"Only simple local literals; scopes are not fully parsed."})


def _tool_concat_report(data, args):
    src=_source_text(data); scan=_masked_source(src); findings=[]
    for m in re.finditer(r"[^\n;]{0,200}(?:\.\s*\.\s*)[^\n;]{0,200}", scan):
        frag=src[m.start():m.end()].strip()
        if frag and not frag.startswith("--"):
            findings.append({"line":src.count("\n",0,m.start())+1,"expression":frag[:360],"literal_only":bool(re.fullmatch(r"(?:\s*(?:\"(?:\\\\.|[^\"\\\\])*\"|'(?:\\\\.|[^'\\\\])*'|\d+)\s*\.\s*\.\s*)+\s*(?:\"(?:\\\\.|[^\"\\\\])*\"|'(?:\\\\.|[^'\\\\])*'|\d+)\s*",frag))})
    return _json({"concat_candidates":len(findings),"expressions":findings[:_arg(args,"top",500)]})


def _tool_xor_crib(data, args):
    known = _arg(args,"known_text",None)
    if known is None: raise ValueError("provide --known-text TEXT")
    off = max(0, int(_arg(args,"offset",0)))
    kb = known.encode("utf-8")
    if off + len(kb) > len(data): raise ValueError("known text + offset exceeds ciphertext length")
    inferred = bytes(data[off+i] ^ kb[i] for i in range(len(kb)))
    period = _arg(args,"key_length",0)
    report = {"offset":off,"known_text":known,"derived_key_segment_hex":inferred.hex(),"derived_key_segment_ascii":''.join(chr(b) if 32<=b<127 else '.' for b in inferred)}
    if period:
        period=int(period)
        if period < 1 or period > 4096: raise ValueError("key length must be 1..4096")
        slots={}
        for i,b in enumerate(inferred): slots.setdefault((off+i)%period,set()).add(b)
        report["key_length_guess"]=period
        report["compatible_positions"]={str(k):list(v) for k,v in slots.items()}
        report["consistent_period"] = all(len(v)==1 for v in slots.values())
    return _json(report)


def _tool_xor_ngrams(data, args):
    if len(data)<4: return "input too short"
    texts=[]
    for n in (2,3,4):
        counts=Counter(data[i:i+n] for i in range(len(data)-n+1))
        texts.append({"n":n,"top":[{"hex":k.hex(),"count":v,"ascii":"".join(chr(b) if 32<=b<127 else '.' for b in k)} for k,v in counts.most_common(_arg(args,"top",20))]})
    return _json({"byte_ngrams":texts,"note":"Useful for repeated-block hints; does not itself recover a key."})


def _tool_xor_plaintext_score(data, args):
    rows=[]
    for key in range(256):
        cand=bytes(b^key for b in data)
        rows.append({"key":key,"key_hex":f"0x{key:02x}","score":round(_luaish_score(cand),4),"printable":round(printable_ratio(cand),4),"lua_markers":sum(cand.lower().count(m) for m in (b"local ",b"function",b"return",b"end",b"game:")),"preview":cand[:100].decode("utf-8",errors="replace")})
    rows.sort(key=lambda r:r["score"],reverse=True)
    return _json({"top_candidates":rows[:_arg(args,"top",20)],"note":"Ranking heuristic; verify plaintext before relying on a candidate."})


def _tool_encoding_candidates(data, args):
    best, states = _auto_decode(data, _arg(args,"depth",4), _arg(args,"beam",12))
    out=[]
    for blob, chain, score in states[:max(1,min(_arg(args,"top",50),500))]:
        try: decoded=blob.decode("utf-8-sig")[:240]
        except UnicodeDecodeError: decoded=None
        out.append({"bytes":len(blob),"score":round(score,4),"type":_file_type(blob),"sha256":hashlib.sha256(blob).hexdigest(),"chain":chain,"preview":decoded,"hex_preview":blob[:64].hex(" ")})
    return _json({"candidates":out,"selected_sha256":hashlib.sha256(best[0]).hexdigest()})


def _tool_base64_candidates(data, args):
    src=_source_text(data); results=[]
    for start,raw,val in _string_tokens(src):
        compact=re.sub(r"\s+","",val)
        if len(compact)<8 or not re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9+/]*={0,2}",compact): continue
        try:
            decoded=base64.b64decode(compact+"="*((-len(compact))%4),validate=True)
            if decoded:
                results.append({"line":src.count("\n",0,start)+1,"offset":start,"encoded_length":len(compact),"decoded_length":len(decoded),"sha256":hashlib.sha256(decoded).hexdigest(),"preview":decoded[:240].decode("utf-8",errors="replace"),"hex":decoded[:64].hex(" ")})
        except Exception: pass
    return _json({"base64_literal_candidates":len(results),"results":results[:_arg(args,"top",250)]})


def _tool_hex_candidates(data, args):
    src=_source_text(data); results=[]
    for start,raw,val in _string_tokens(src):
        compact=re.sub(r"\s+","",val)
        if len(compact)<8 or len(compact)%2 or not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-fA-F]+",compact): continue
        try:
            dec=bytes.fromhex(compact)
            results.append({"line":src.count("\n",0,start)+1,"encoded_length":len(compact),"decoded_length":len(dec),"preview":dec[:240].decode("utf-8",errors="replace"),"hex":dec[:96].hex(" ")})
        except Exception: pass
    return _json({"hex_literal_candidates":len(results),"results":results[:_arg(args,"top",250)]})


def _tool_detect_obfuscator(data, args):
    src=_source_text(data); low=src.lower(); scan=_masked_source(src).lower()
    signatures={
      "luau_compiled_bytecode": (data[:1] in (b"\x03",b"\x04",b"\x05",b"\x06",b"\x07",b"\x08",b"\x09") and b"function" not in data[:100]),
      "ironbrew_style_dispatch": ("while true do" in low and ("opcode" in low or "instruction" in low) and "bit32" in low),
      "luraph_markers": any(x in low for x in ("luraph", "lph_encnum", "lph_jit", "lph!")),
      "prometheus_style": any(x in low for x in ("prometheus", "controlflowflattening", "anti_tamper")),
      "generic_vm": (sum(x in scan for x in ("while true do", "bit32.bxor", "opcode", "instruction", "handlers[", "dispatch[")) >= 3),
      "packed_or_encoded_strings": (sum(1 for _,_,v in _string_tokens(src) if len(v)>256) > 0),
      "identifier_minification": (len(re.findall(r"\b[a-zA-Z_$][\w$]*\b", scan))>60 and sum(len(x)<3 for x in re.findall(r"\b[a-zA-Z_$][\w$]*\b", scan))/max(1,len(re.findall(r"\b[a-zA-Z_$][\w$]*\b", scan)))>0.35),
    }
    return _json({"likely_families_or_traits":[k for k,v in signatures.items() if v],"signatures":signatures,"confidence":"low-to-medium heuristic","warning":"Names and snippets are easy to spoof; identify protector families from code structure, not labels alone."})


def _tool_source_fingerprint(data, args):
    src=_source_text(data); scan=_masked_source(src); toks=tokenize_lua(src)
    names=Counter(t.value for t in toks if t.kind=="identifier")
    string_lengths=sorted(len(v) for _,_,v in _string_tokens(src))
    return _json({"sha256":hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),"source_bytes":len(data),"tokens":len(toks),"unique_identifiers":len(names),"top_identifiers":names.most_common(40),"string_count":len(string_lengths),"string_length_quantiles":{"min":min(string_lengths,default=0),"median":string_lengths[len(string_lengths)//2] if string_lengths else 0,"max":max(string_lengths,default=0)},"operator_frequency":Counter(t.value for t in toks if t.kind=="operator").most_common(40),"keyword_frequency":Counter(t.value for t in toks if t.kind=="keyword").most_common(40),"normalized_token_sha256":hashlib.sha256(" ".join(t.kind+":"+t.value for t in toks).encode()).hexdigest()})


def _tool_anti_analysis(data, args):
    src=_source_text(data); scan=_masked_source(src)
    pats={"debug_library":r"\bdebug\s*\.","environment_introspection":r"\b(?:getfenv|setfenv|getgenv|getsenv)\s*\(","integrity_or_hook_checks":r"\b(?:hookfunction|hookmetamethod|checkcaller|iscclosure|isreadonly|setreadonly)\b","timing_checks":r"\b(?:os\.clock|tick|time)\s*\(","executor_probe":r"\b(?:identifyexecutor|getexecutorname|isexecutorclosure)\s*\(","debug_info":r"\bdebug\.(?:info|getinfo|traceback)\s*\(","dynamic_loading":r"\b(?:loadstring|load)\s*\("}
    report={}
    for name,pat in pats.items(): report[name]=[{"line":src.count("\n",0,m.start())+1,"snippet":src[m.start():min(len(src),m.start()+100)].splitlines()[0]} for m in re.finditer(pat,scan,re.I)][:100]
    return _json({"indicators":report,"note":"Indicators can have legitimate uses; this does not prove malicious behavior."})


def _tool_function_call_inventory(data, args):
    src=_source_text(data); toks=tokenize_lua(src); counts=Counter(); loc=defaultdict(list)
    for i in range(len(toks)-1):
        if toks[i].kind in ("identifier","keyword") and toks[i+1].value=="(":
            name=toks[i].value
            if i>=2 and toks[i-1].value=="." and toks[i-2].kind=="identifier": name=toks[i-2].value+"."+name
            counts[name]+=1; loc[name].append(src.count("\n",0,toks[i].start)+1)
    return _json({"call_count":sum(counts.values()),"distinct_names":len(counts),"calls":[{"name":n,"count":c,"lines":loc[n][:30]} for n,c in counts.most_common(_arg(args,"top",300))]})

def _tool_string_entropy(data, args):
    src=_source_text(data); rows=[]
    for start,raw,val in _string_tokens(src):
        b=val.encode("utf-8",errors="replace")
        rows.append({"line":src.count("\n",0,start)+1,"offset":start,"length":len(b),"entropy":round(shannon_entropy(b),4),"printable_ratio":round(printable_ratio(b),4),"preview":val[:100]})
    rows.sort(key=lambda x:(x["entropy"],x["length"]),reverse=True)
    return _json({"strings":len(rows),"highest_entropy_strings":rows[:_arg(args,"top",100)]})


def _tool_literal_duplication(data, args):
    src=_source_text(data); counter=Counter(v for _,_,v in _string_tokens(src)); repeated=[]
    for value,n in counter.most_common():
        if n>1: repeated.append({"count":n,"length":len(value),"value":value[:240]})
    return _json({"unique_string_literals":len(counter),"repeated_literals":repeated[:_arg(args,"top",300)]})


def _tool_dynamic_loader_hints(data, args):
    src=_source_text(data); scan=_masked_source(src); pats={"loadstring":r"\bloadstring\s*\(","load":r"(?<![\w.])load\s*\(","httpget":r"\bHttpGet\s*\(","request_async":r"\bRequestAsync\s*\(","getasync":r"\bGetAsync\s*\(","decode_base64":r"\b(?:base64decode|decode64|fromBase64)\b","dynamic_environment":r"\b(?:getfenv|setfenv|_G|shared)\b"}
    rows=[]
    for kind,pat in pats.items():
        for m in re.finditer(pat,scan,re.I): rows.append({"kind":kind,"line":src.count("\n",0,m.start())+1,"snippet":src[m.start():m.start()+140].splitlines()[0]})
    rows.sort(key=lambda r:(r["line"],r["kind"]))
    return _json({"dynamic_loader_hints":len(rows),"hints":rows[:1000]})


def _tool_remote_event_scan(data, args):
    src=_source_text(data); scan=_masked_source(src); pats={"FireServer":r"\bFireServer\s*\(","InvokeServer":r"\bInvokeServer\s*\(","OnServerEvent":r"\bOnServerEvent\b","OnServerInvoke":r"\bOnServerInvoke\b","RemoteEvent":r"\bRemoteEvent\b","RemoteFunction":r"\bRemoteFunction\b","FireClient":r"\bFireClient\s*\(","FireAllClients":r"\bFireAllClients\s*\("}

def _tool_compressed_payload_hints(data, args):
    src=_source_text(data); rows=[]
    for start,raw,val in _string_tokens(src):
        b=val.encode("latin-1",errors="replace")
        found=[]
        if b.startswith(b"\x1f\x8b"): found.append("gzip")
        if b.startswith(b"BZh"): found.append("bzip2")
        if b.startswith(b"\xfd7zXZ\x00"): found.append("xz")
        if b.startswith(b"PK\x03\x04"): found.append("zip")
        if len(b)>8:
            for wb,n in ((zlib.MAX_WBITS,"zlib"),(-zlib.MAX_WBITS,"raw-deflate")):
                try:
                    out=zlib.decompress(b,wb)
                    if out: found.append(n)
                except Exception: pass
        if found or len(val)>150: rows.append({"line":src.count("\n",0,start)+1,"length":len(val),"signatures":found,"prefix_hex":b[:24].hex(" "),"preview":val[:80]})
    return _json({"candidate_strings":len(rows),"candidates":rows[:_arg(args,"top",250)]})


def _tool_compare_sources(data, args):
    other = _arg(args,"against",None)
    if not other: raise ValueError("provide --against OTHER_SOURCE")
    a=_source_text(data); b=Path(other).read_text(encoding="utf-8",errors="replace")
    ta=[t.kind+":"+t.value for t in tokenize_lua(a)]; tb=[t.kind+":"+t.value for t in tokenize_lua(b)]
    ratio=difflib.SequenceMatcher(a=ta,b=tb,autojunk=False).ratio()
    return _json({"token_similarity":round(ratio,6),"left_tokens":len(ta),"right_tokens":len(tb),"same_token_sequence":ta==tb,"left_sha256":hashlib.sha256(a.encode()).hexdigest(),"right_sha256":hashlib.sha256(b.encode()).hexdigest(),"note":"Similarity is lexical and does not establish semantic equivalence."})


def _tool_normalized_diff(data, args):
    other=_arg(args,"against",None)
    if not other: raise ValueError("provide --against OTHER_SOURCE")
    a=_source_text(data); b=Path(other).read_text(encoding="utf-8",errors="replace")
    na="\n".join(t.kind+":"+t.value for t in tokenize_lua(a))
    nb="\n".join(t.kind+":"+t.value for t in tokenize_lua(b))
    return "\n".join(difflib.unified_diff(na.splitlines(),nb.splitlines(),fromfile="input.tokens",tofile="against.tokens",lineterm="")) or "No normalized token differences."


def _tool_batch_analysis(data, args):
    root=_arg(args,"batch_dir",None)
    if not root: raise ValueError("provide --batch-dir DIRECTORY")
    base=Path(root)
    if not base.is_dir(): raise ValueError(f"not a directory: {root}")
    files=[p for p in base.rglob("*") if p.is_file() and p.suffix.lower() in {".lua",".luau",".txt",".bin",".dat"}][:max(1,min(_arg(args,"limit",500),5000))]
    out=[]
    for p in files:
        try:
            blob=p.read_bytes()
            s=_source_text(blob); scan=_masked_source(s)
            out.append({"path":str(p.relative_to(base)),"bytes":len(blob),"sha256":hashlib.sha256(blob).hexdigest(),"type":_file_type(blob),"entropy":round(shannon_entropy(blob),4),"tokens":len(tokenize_lua(s)),"strings":len(_string_tokens(s)),"vm_hint_score":json.loads(_tool_vm_classify(blob,args)).get("indicator_score",0),"loadstring_count":len(re.findall(r"\bloadstring\s*\(",scan)),"http_count":len(re.findall(r"\b(?:HttpGet|RequestAsync|GetAsync|PostAsync)\b",scan))})
        except Exception as exc: out.append({"path":str(p),"error":str(exc)})
    report={"root":str(base),"file_count":len(out),"results":out}
    rpt=_arg(args,"report",None)
    if rpt: Path(rpt).write_text(_json(report),encoding="utf-8")
    return _json(report)


def _tool_external_tools(data, args):

    import shutil
    candidates={"luau-decompiler":"luau-decompiler","luau-compile":"luau-compile","luau-analyze":"luau-analyze","luau":"luau","unluau":"unluau","lua":"lua","luajit":"luajit","dotnet":"dotnet","cargo":"cargo","rustc":"rustc"}
    result=[]
    for name,cmd in candidates.items():
        path=shutil.which(cmd)
        result.append({"tool":name,"available":bool(path),"path":path,"version_probe":"not run; PATH-only detection avoids executing unknown binaries"})
    return _json({"external_tools":result,"network_used":False,"executables_launched":False})

def _run_external(tool, subcommand, data, args, extra=()):
    import shutil
    path=shutil.which(tool)
    if not path: raise ValueError(f"{tool} is not installed or not present in PATH. See external_tools.txt")
    infile=_arg(args,"input",None)
    if infile in (None,"-") and _arg(args,"literal",None) is None:
        raise ValueError("external tool bridge requires a named input file; save stdin to a file first")
    if subcommand:
        cmd=[path,subcommand]
    else: cmd=[path]
    cmd.extend(extra)
    if infile and infile!="-": cmd.append(infile)
    try:
        proc=subprocess.run(cmd,capture_output=True,timeout=max(2,min(_arg(args,"timeout",60),300)),check=False)
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        raise ValueError(f"{tool} exceeded timeout")
    out=(proc.stdout or b"").decode("utf-8",errors="replace")
    err=(proc.stderr or b"").decode("utf-8",errors="replace")
    return _json({"command":cmd,"returncode":proc.returncode,"stdout":out[:2_000_000],"stderr":err[:200_000]})

def _tool_luau_bytecode_decompile(data, args): return _run_external("luau-decompiler",None,data,args,tuple(["-o",_arg(args,"bridge_output")] if _arg(args,"bridge_output",None) else []))
def _tool_luau_validate(data, args): return _run_external("luau-decompiler","validate",data,args)
def _tool_luau_compile_check(data, args): return _run_external("luau-compile",None,data,args,tuple(["--binary"] if _arg(args,"binary",False) else []))

def _tool_api_dataflow(data, args):
    src=_source_text(data); scan=_masked_source(src)
    pattern=re.compile(r"\b([A-Za-z_]\w*)\s*=\s*([^\n;]{1,200})")
    uses=Counter(re.findall(r"\b[A-Za-z_]\w*\b",scan)); rows=[]
    for m in pattern.finditer(scan):
        name,expr=m.group(1),m.group(2)
        if any(k in expr.lower() for k in ("http", "loadstring", "base64", "xor", "string.char", "bit32", "webhook", "request")):
            rows.append({"line":src.count("\n",0,m.start())+1,"target":name,"expression":src[m.start(2):m.end(2)].strip()[:240],"identifier_use_count":uses[name]})
    return _json({"suspicious_dataflow_assignments":len(rows),"assignments":rows[:_arg(args,"top",500)],"note":"Taint/dataflow hints are lexical and do not track aliases robustly."})


def _tool_json_unwrap(data, args):
    raw=data.strip()
    try: obj=json.loads(raw.decode("utf-8-sig"))
    except Exception as exc: raise ValueError(f"input is not valid JSON: {exc}")
    found=[]
    def walk(x,path="$",depth=0):
        if depth>20: return
        if isinstance(x,dict):
            for k,v in x.items():
                if isinstance(v,(str,int,float,bool)) or v is None:
                    if isinstance(v,str):
                        found.append({"path":path+"."+str(k),"key":str(k),"type":"string","length":len(v),"preview":v[:160]})
                else: walk(v,path+"."+str(k),depth+1)
        elif isinstance(x,list):
            for i,v in enumerate(x[:1000]):
                if isinstance(v,str): found.append({"path":f"{path}[{i}]","type":"string","length":len(v),"preview":v[:160]})
                else: walk(v,f"{path}[{i}]",depth+1)
    walk(obj)
    requested=_arg(args,"json_path",None)
    if requested:
        cur=obj
        try:
            for part in requested.split("."):
                cur=cur[int(part)] if isinstance(cur,list) else cur[part]
            if isinstance(cur,str): return cur
            return _json(cur)
        except Exception as exc: raise ValueError(f"cannot resolve --json-path {requested}: {exc}")
    return _json({"root_type":type(obj).__name__,"string_fields":found,"hint":"Use --json-path path.to.value to extract one field's contents."})

def _byte_character_score(b: int) -> float:
    if b in (9, 10, 13): return 0.35
    if b == 32: return 1.45
    c = chr(b)
    if c in "etaoinshrdluETAOINSHRDLU": return 1.25 if c.islower() else 0.72
    if c.isalpha(): return 0.60 if c.islower() else 0.32
    if c.isdigit(): return 0.18
    if c in "(){}[];=,.+-*/<>_:!?%&|^~#'\"\\@": return 0.22
    if 32 <= b <= 126: return -0.08
    return -3.2


def _break_repeating_xor(data: bytes, max_length=32):
    if len(data) < 4: raise ValueError("ciphertext too short for repeating-XOR analysis")
    if len(data) > MAX_AUTO_BYTES: raise ValueError(f"input exceeds safe limit ({MAX_AUTO_BYTES} bytes)")
    max_length = max(1, min(int(max_length), 64, max(1, len(data)//2)))
    probe = data[:min(len(data), 4096)]
    score_table = [[_byte_character_score(b ^ k) for b in range(256)] for k in range(256)]
    candidates=[]
    for length in range(1, max_length+1):
        key=bytearray()
        for pos in range(length):
            col=probe[pos::length]
            if not col: key.append(0); continue

            best_key=max(range(256), key=lambda k: sum(score_table[k][b] for b in col))
            key.append(best_key)
        clear=bytes(b ^ key[i % length] for i,b in enumerate(data))
        effective=len(key)
        while effective>1 and all(key[i]==key[i% (effective//2)] for i in range(effective)) and effective%2==0:
            effective//=2
        canonical=bytes(key[:effective])
        plain_score=_luaish_score(clear) + _source_likelihood(clear)*0.9 - length*0.012
        candidates.append({"length":length,"key":bytes(key),"canonical_key":canonical,"data":clear,"score":plain_score,"printable":printable_ratio(clear),"lua_score":_source_likelihood(clear)})

    uniq={}
    for item in candidates:
        key=item["canonical_key"]
        previous=uniq.get(key)
        if previous is None or item["score"]>previous["score"]: uniq[key]=item
    result=sorted(uniq.values(),key=lambda x:x["score"],reverse=True)
    return result


def _tool_xor_repeating_crack(data, args):
    maxlen=_arg(args,"max_key_length",32)
    candidates=_break_repeating_xor(data,maxlen)
    best=candidates[0]
    if _arg(args,"report",None):
        report={"selected_key_hex":best["canonical_key"].hex(),"selected_key_ascii":"".join(chr(x) if 32<=x<127 else "." for x in best["canonical_key"]),"score":round(best["score"],5),"candidates":[{"length":x["length"],"canonical_key_hex":x["canonical_key"].hex(),"score":round(x["score"],5),"printable":round(x["printable"],5),"preview":x["data"][:220].decode("utf-8",errors="replace")} for x in candidates[:20]]}
        Path(args.report).write_text(_json(report),encoding="utf-8")
    return best["data"]


def _tool_xor_repeating_crack_report(data, args):
    candidates=_break_repeating_xor(data,_arg(args,"max_key_length",32))
    return _json({"input_bytes":len(data),"max_key_length_tested":min(_arg(args,"max_key_length",32),64,max(1,len(data)//2)),"candidates":[{"tested_length":x["length"],"key_hex":x["canonical_key"].hex(),"key_ascii":"".join(chr(b) if 32<=b<127 else "." for b in x["canonical_key"]),"score":round(x["score"],5),"printable_ratio":round(x["printable"],5),"lua_marker_score":round(x["lua_score"],4),"preview":x["data"][:300].decode("utf-8",errors="replace"),"sha256":hashlib.sha256(x["data"]).hexdigest()} for x in candidates[:max(1,min(_arg(args,"top",20),100))]],"note":"Cryptanalysis ranking is heuristic. Short/random/high-entropy ciphertext may not be recoverable without key or known plaintext."})


def _tool_literal_payload_scan(data, args):
    src=_source_text(data); results=[]; extract_dir=_arg(args,"extract_dir",None)
    dest=Path(extract_dir) if extract_dir else None
    if dest: dest.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    minlen=max(4,int(_arg(args,"min_length",8)))
    attempted = 0
    max_attempts = max(1, min(int(_arg(args, "limit", 100)), 200))
    for index,(start,raw,val) in enumerate(_string_tokens(src),1):
        encoded=val.encode("utf-8",errors="replace")
        if len(encoded)<minlen: continue

        plausible=(re.search(r"(?:%[0-9A-Fa-f]{2}|\\x[0-9A-Fa-f]{2}|\\u[0-9A-Fa-f]{4})",val) is not None or
                   (len(val)>=16 and re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9+/=_-]+",val)) or
                   (len(val)>=16 and re.fullmatch(r"[0-9A-Fa-f]+",val) and len(val)%2==0) or
                   (len(val)>=48 and shannon_entropy(encoded)>4.1))
        if not plausible: continue
        attempted += 1
        if attempted > max_attempts: break
        try: (best,states)=_auto_decode(encoded,_arg(args,"depth",5),_arg(args,"beam",8))
        except Exception: continue
        blob,chain,score=best
        if not chain: continue

        if blob==encoded: continue
        row={"literal_index":index,"line":src.count("\n",0,start)+1,"source_offset":start,"input_length":len(encoded),"output_length":len(blob),"chain":chain,"score":round(score,4),"type":_file_type(blob),"sha256":hashlib.sha256(blob).hexdigest(),"preview":blob[:320].decode("utf-8",errors="replace")}
        if dest:
            suffix=".txt"
            name=f"payload_{len(results)+1:03d}{suffix}"
            path=dest/name; path.write_bytes(blob); row["saved_to"]=str(path)
        results.append(row)
    return _json({"literal_payload_candidates":len(results),"results":results[:_arg(args,"top",200)],"extract_dir":str(dest) if dest else None,"note":"Decoded files are saved only when --extract-dir is explicitly supplied."})


def _fold_string_simple_calls(src: str, funcs):
    toks=tokenize_lua(src); edits=[]; i=0
    while i+3<len(toks):
        if toks[i].value!="string" or toks[i+1].value!="." or toks[i+2].value not in funcs or toks[i+3].value!="(": i+=1; continue
        end=_find_matching(toks,i+3)
        if end is None: i+=1; continue
        chunks=_split_top_level_args(toks[i+4:end])
        try:
            if not chunks or len(chunks[0])!=1 or chunks[0][0].kind!="string": raise ValueError
            value=decode_lua_string(chunks[0][0].value); name=toks[i+2].value
            nums=[]
            for ch in chunks[1:]:
                raw="".join(t.value for t in ch).strip()
                if not re.fullmatch(r"[-+]?\d+",raw): raise ValueError
                nums.append(int(raw))
            if name=="sub":
                first=nums[0] if nums else 1; last=nums[1] if len(nums)>1 else len(value)

                start=first-1 if first>0 else len(value)+first
                stop=last if last>0 else len(value)+last+1
                result=value[max(0,start):max(0,stop)]
                repl=lua_quote(result)
            elif name=="lower" and not nums: repl=lua_quote(value.lower())
            elif name=="upper" and not nums: repl=lua_quote(value.upper())
            elif name=="rep" and len(nums) in (1,2):
                count=nums[0]; sep=str(nums[1]) if len(nums)>1 else ""
                if count<0 or count>10000 or len(value)*count>100000: raise ValueError
                repl=lua_quote(sep.join([value]*count))
            elif name=="byte" and len(nums)<=1:
                pos=nums[0] if nums else 1; ix=pos-1 if pos>0 else len(value)+pos
                if not 0<=ix<len(value): repl="nil"
                else: repl=str(value.encode("utf-8")[ix])
            else: raise ValueError
            edits.append((toks[i].start,toks[end].end,repl)); i=end+1
        except Exception: i=end+1
    for a,b,repl in reversed(edits): src=src[:a]+repl+src[b:]
    return src,len(edits)


def _make_string_fold_tool(funcs):
    def run(data,args):
        src,count=_fold_string_simple_calls(_source_text(data),set(funcs))
        return f"-- folded static string calls ({','.join(funcs)}): {count}\n"+src
    return run


def _tool_fold_math_constants(data, args):
    src=_source_text(data); toks=tokenize_lua(src); edits=[]; i=0
    permitted={"floor":math.floor,"ceil":math.ceil,"abs":abs,"sqrt":math.sqrt,"sin":math.sin,"cos":math.cos,"tan":math.tan,"deg":math.degrees,"rad":math.radians,"log":math.log,"exp":math.exp}
    while i+3<len(toks):
        if toks[i].value!="math" or toks[i+1].value!="." or toks[i+2].value not in permitted or toks[i+3].value!="(": i+=1; continue
        end=_find_matching(toks,i+3)
        if end is None: i+=1; continue
        chunks=_split_top_level_args(toks[i+4:end])
        try:
            vals=[]
            for ch in chunks:
                if len(ch)!=1 or ch[0].kind!="number": raise ValueError
                vals.append(float(_constant_number(ch[0].value)))
            if len(vals)!=1: raise ValueError
            value=permitted[toks[i+2].value](vals[0])
            if not math.isfinite(value) or abs(value)>1e12: raise ValueError
            text=str(int(value)) if float(value).is_integer() else repr(value)
            edits.append((toks[i].start,toks[end].end,text)); i=end+1
        except Exception: i=end+1
    for a,b,repl in reversed(edits): src=src[:a]+repl+src[b:]
    return f"-- folded constant math calls: {len(edits)}\n"+src


def _tool_flattening_report(data, args):
    src=_source_text(data); scan=_masked_source(src)
    eqs=[{"line":src.count("\n",0,m.start())+1,"state":m.group(1),"value":m.group(2)} for m in re.finditer(r"\b(?:if|elseif)\s+([A-Za-z_]\w*)\s*==\s*(0x[0-9A-Fa-f]+|\d+)\s+then",scan)]
    writes=[{"line":src.count("\n",0,m.start())+1,"state":m.group(1),"rhs":m.group(2).strip()[:120]} for m in re.finditer(r"\b([A-Za-z_]\w*)\s*=(?!=)\s*([^\n;]{1,120})",scan) if any(key in m.group(1).lower() for key in ("state","pc","step","opcode","inst","dispatch","index"))]
    state_counts=Counter(x["state"] for x in eqs)
    score=min(100, len(eqs)*4 + len(writes)*2 + sum(c>3 for c in state_counts.values())*10)
    return _json({"flattening_likelihood_score":score,"numeric_state_branches":len(eqs),"state_variables":state_counts.most_common(20),"branch_cases":eqs[:1000],"state_assignments":writes[:1000],"confidence":"heuristic","interpretation":"A high score suggests a state-driven dispatcher shape; ordinary parsers and interpreters can look similar."})


def _tool_global_api_inventory(data, args):
    src=_source_text(data); toks=tokenize_lua(src); known={"game","workspace","script","shared","_G","Instance","Players","HttpService","RunService","UserInputService","ReplicatedStorage","ReplicatedFirst","StarterGui","CoreGui","Players","task","debug","os","io","loadstring","load","require","getfenv","setfenv","getgenv","request","syn","http","readfile","writefile","delfile","appendfile","gethui","hookfunction","hookmetamethod","newcclosure","getrawmetatable","setreadonly","checkcaller","identifyexecutor","WebSocketService","TeleportService","DataStoreService","MarketplaceService"}
    rows=[]
    for i,t in enumerate(toks):
        if t.kind!="identifier" or t.value not in known: continue
        prev=toks[i-1].value if i else ""; nex=toks[i+1].value if i+1<len(toks) else ""
        rows.append({"name":t.value,"line":src.count("\n",0,t.start)+1,"context":prev+" "+t.value+" "+nex})
    count=Counter(r["name"] for r in rows)
    return _json({"known_api_reference_count":len(rows),"by_name":count.most_common(200),"references":rows[:_arg(args,"top",1000)],"note":"Name inventory only; references may be benign, dead code, or text if lexer edge cases apply."})


def _tool_source_diff_summary(data,args):
    other=_arg(args,"against",None)
    if not other: raise ValueError("provide --against OTHER_SOURCE")
    a=_source_text(data); b=Path(other).read_text(encoding="utf-8",errors="replace")
    ta=[t.kind+":"+t.value for t in tokenize_lua(a)]; tb=[t.kind+":"+t.value for t in tokenize_lua(b)]
    sm=difflib.SequenceMatcher(a=ta,b=tb,autojunk=False)
    opcodes=sm.get_opcodes(); rows=[]
    for tag,i1,i2,j1,j2 in opcodes:
        if tag!="equal": rows.append({"operation":tag,"left_tokens":[i1,i2],"right_tokens":[j1,j2],"left_preview":" ".join(ta[i1:i1+12]),"right_preview":" ".join(tb[j1:j1+12])})
    return _json({"similarity":round(sm.ratio(),6),"left_token_count":len(ta),"right_token_count":len(tb),"changed_regions":len(rows),"regions":rows[:200]})


def _tool_table_index_refs(data,args):
    src=_source_text(data); toks=tokenize_lua(src); refs=[]
    for i in range(len(toks)-3):
        if toks[i].kind=="identifier" and toks[i+1].value=="[":
            close=next((j for j in range(i+2,min(len(toks),i+16)) if toks[j].value=="]"),None)
            if close is not None:
                key=" ".join(t.value for t in toks[i+2:close])
                refs.append({"line":src.count("\n",0,toks[i].start)+1,"table":toks[i].value,"key_expression":key,"literal_key":len(toks[i+2:close])==1 and toks[i+2].kind in ("number","string")})
    counts=Counter(r["table"] for r in refs)
    return _json({"index_reference_count":len(refs),"tables_ranked":counts.most_common(100),"references":refs[:_arg(args,"top",1000)]})


def _tool_opcode_byte_candidates(data,args):
    src=_source_text(data); candidates=[]
    for m in re.finditer(r"\{([^{}]{20,20000})\}",_masked_source(src),re.S):
        body=src[m.start(1):m.end(1)]; toks=tokenize_lua(body)
        vals=[]; numeric=True
        for t in toks:
            if t.value==",": continue
            if t.kind=="number":
                try: vals.append(int(_constant_number(t.value)))
                except Exception: numeric=False; break
            else: numeric=False; break
        if numeric and len(vals)>=8:
            hist=Counter(vals); candidates.append({"line":src.count("\n",0,m.start())+1,"length":len(vals),"min":min(vals),"max":max(vals),"distinct":len(hist),"most_common":hist.most_common(20),"preview":vals[:60]})
    candidates.sort(key=lambda x:x["length"],reverse=True)
    return _json({"numeric_sequence_candidates":len(candidates),"candidates":candidates[:_arg(args,"top",100)],"note":"Numeric sequences may be constant tables, serialized data, or instruction bytes; format validation is required."})


def _tool_string_cipher_patterns(data,args):

    pats={"string_char_builder":r"\b(?:string|utf8)\s*\.\s*char\s*\(","string_byte_reader":r"\bstring\s*\.\s*byte\s*\(","reversals":r"\bstring\s*\.\s*reverse\s*\(","base64_names":r"\b(?:base64decode|decode64|fromBase64|b64decode)\b","xor_patterns":r"\b(?:bit32|bit)\s*\.\s*bxor\s*\(","concat_loops":r"\.\s*\.\s*=?","numeric_escape_literals":r"\\(?:x[0-9a-fA-F]{2}|u\{[0-9a-fA-F]+\}|\d{2,3})","string_substitution":r"\bstring\s*\.\s*(?:gsub|sub)\s*\(","compressed_api_names":r"\b(?:inflate|decompress|zlib|gzip|lzma)\b"}
    result={}
    for name,pat in pats.items(): result[name]=[{"line":src.count("\n",0,m.start())+1,"preview":src[m.start():m.start()+130].splitlines()[0]} for m in re.finditer(pat,scan,re.I)][:200]
    return _json({"pattern_groups":result,"note":"Patterns are leads for locating decoder code, not proof that a string is encrypted."})


def _tool_escape_layer_scan(data,args):
    src=_source_text(data); rows=[]
    for pos,raw,val in _string_tokens(src):
        escapes=re.findall(r"\\(?:x[0-9a-fA-F]{2}|u\{[0-9a-fA-F]{1,6}\}|u[0-9a-fA-F]{4}|\d{1,3}|[\\'\"nrt])",raw)
        if escapes: rows.append({"line":src.count("\n",0,pos)+1,"offset":pos,"escape_count":len(escapes),"escape_kinds":Counter("hex" if e.startswith("\\x") else "unicode" if e.startswith("\\u") else "decimal" if len(e)>1 and e[1].isdigit() else "simple" for e in escapes),"value_preview":val[:160],"raw_preview":raw[:180]})
    return _json({"strings_with_escapes":len(rows),"results":rows[:_arg(args,"top",500)]})

def _tool_hash_chain(data,args):
    blob=data; rows=[]
    for step in range(1,9):
        best,states=_auto_decode(blob,3,8)
        candidate,chain,score=best
        rows.append({"step":step,"bytes":len(blob),"sha256":hashlib.sha256(blob).hexdigest(),"type":_file_type(blob),"entropy":round(shannon_entropy(blob),5),"best_chain":chain,"candidate_count":len(states)})
        if not chain or candidate==blob: break
        blob=candidate
    return _json({"chain_depth":len(rows),"steps":rows,"final_bytes":len(blob),"final_sha256":hashlib.sha256(blob).hexdigest(),"final_preview":blob[:1000].decode("utf-8",errors="replace")})

def _adv_line(source, offset):
    return source.count("\n", 0, max(0, offset)) + 1


def _adv_state_variable(source):
    scan = _masked_source(source)
    counts = Counter()
    for m in re.finditer(r"\b(?:if|elseif)\s+([A-Za-z_]\w*)\s*(?:==|~=)\s*(?:0x[0-9a-fA-F]+|\d+)\s+then", scan):
        counts[m.group(1)] += 3
    for m in re.finditer(r"\b([A-Za-z_]\w*)\s*(?:=|\+=|-=)\s*[^\n;]{0,100}", scan):
        name=m.group(1)
        if re.search(r"(?:pc|state|opcode|instruction|dispatch|step|ip|index|cursor|offset|pos)", name, re.I):
            counts[name] += 1
    return counts.most_common(1)[0][0] if counts else None, counts


def _adv_state_cases(source, state=None):
    scan = _masked_source(source)
    if not state:
        state, _ = _adv_state_variable(source)
    if not state:
        return None, []
    pat = re.compile(r"\b(?:if|elseif)\s+" + re.escape(state) + r"\s*(?:==|~=)\s*(0x[0-9a-fA-F]+|\d+)\s+then\b", re.I)
    matches=list(pat.finditer(scan)); lines=source.splitlines(); rows=[]
    for idx,m in enumerate(matches):
        line=_adv_line(source,m.start())
        start_line=max(0,line-1)
        next_line=( _adv_line(source,matches[idx+1].start())-1 if idx+1<len(matches) else min(len(lines),start_line+80))
        body="\n".join(lines[start_line:min(len(lines),max(start_line+1,next_line))])
        writes=[]
        for w in re.finditer(r"\b"+re.escape(state)+r"\s*(?:=|\+=|-=)\s*([^;\n]{1,120})",_masked_source(body)):
            rhs=w.group(1).strip()
            val_match=re.match(r"(0x[0-9a-fA-F]+|\d+)\b",rhs)
            writes.append({"rhs":rhs,"constant_target":val_match.group(1) if val_match else None,"line":start_line+1+body.count("\n",0,w.start())})
        raw=m.group(1)
        try: state_val=int(raw,0)
        except ValueError: state_val=int(raw)
        rows.append({"state_value":state_val,"state_literal":raw,"line":line,"condition_operator":"==" if "==" in m.group(0) else "~=","state_writes":writes,"body_preview":body.strip()[:500]})
    return state,rows


def _adv_assignments(source, symbol=None):
    scan=_masked_source(source); out=[]
    pat=re.compile(r"\b([A-Za-z_]\w*)\s*(=|\+=|-=|\*=|/=|%=)\s*([^\n;]{1,200})")
    for m in pat.finditer(scan):
        name=m.group(1)
        if symbol and name!=symbol: continue
        out.append({"line":_adv_line(source,m.start()),"name":name,"operator":m.group(2),"rhs":source[m.start(3):m.end(3)].strip()[:200],"offset":m.start()})
    return out


def _adv_cfg_dot(source, state=None):
    state,cases=_adv_state_cases(source,state)
    if cases:
        ids={c["state_value"] for c in cases}; rows=["digraph LuauStateMachine {", "  rankdir=LR;", "  node [shape=box];"]
        for c in cases:
            label=f"state {c['state_value']}\\nline {c['line']}"
            rows.append(f'  s{c["state_value"]} [label="{label}"];')
        edges=set()
        for c in cases:
            for w in c["state_writes"]:
                if w["constant_target"] is not None:
                    try: target=int(w["constant_target"],0)
                    except ValueError: target=int(w["constant_target"])
                    if target in ids: edges.add((c["state_value"],target))
        for a,b in sorted(edges): rows.append(f'  s{a} -> s{b} [label="state update"];')
        if not edges: rows.append('  note [shape=note,label="No constant state transitions inferred"];')
        rows.append("}")
        return "\n".join(rows), {"state_variable":state,"cases":len(cases),"edges":len(edges),"heuristic":True}
    scan=_masked_source(source); branches=[]
    for m in re.finditer(r"\b(if|elseif|while|for|repeat)\b",scan):
        branches.append({"kind":m.group(1),"line":_adv_line(source,m.start()),"offset":m.start()})
    rows=["digraph LuauApproxCFG {", "  rankdir=TB;", '  note [shape=note,label="Approximate lexical graph; not a parsed CFG"];']
    for i,b in enumerate(branches):
        rows.append(f'  b{i} [shape=diamond,label="{b["kind"]} line {b["line"]}"];')
        if i: rows.append(f'  b{i-1} -> b{i} [label="next candidate"];')
    rows.append("}")
    return "\n".join(rows), {"branch_candidates":len(branches),"heuristic":True}

def _tool_vm_architecture_score(data,args):
    src=_source_text(data); scan=_masked_source(src); state,cnt=_adv_state_variable(src); _,cases=_adv_state_cases(src,state)
    feats={"numeric_state_branches":len(re.findall(r"\b(?:if|elseif)\s+\w+\s*==\s*(?:0x[\da-fA-F]+|\d+)\s+then",scan)),"infinite_dispatch_loops":len(re.findall(r"\bwhile\s+(?:true|1)\s+do",scan)),"indexed_tables":len(re.findall(r"\b\w+\s*\[\s*\w+\s*\]",scan)),"bitwise_calls":len(re.findall(r"\b(?:bit32|bit)\s*\.\s*\w+\s*\(",scan)),"bulk_numeric_arrays":len(json.loads(_tool_opcode_byte_candidates(data,args))["candidates"]),"state_assignments":len([a for a in _adv_assignments(src) if re.search(r"pc|state|step|opcode|dispatch|ip|cursor",a["name"],re.I)]),"branch_density":len(re.findall(r"\b(?:if|elseif|while|for)\b",scan))}
    score=min(100,feats["numeric_state_branches"]*3+feats["infinite_dispatch_loops"]*12+feats["indexed_tables"]+feats["bitwise_calls"]*3+feats["bulk_numeric_arrays"]*8+feats["state_assignments"]*2)
    return _json({"vm_likelihood_score":score,"features":feats,"state_variable":state,"case_count":len(cases),"interpretation":"Heuristic only. Interpreters, parsers, game state machines and ordinary dispatch code may score highly."})

def _tool_vm_state_transitions(data,args):
    src=_source_text(data); state,cases=_adv_state_cases(src,_arg(args,"symbol",None)); edges=[]
    known={c["state_value"] for c in cases}
    for c in cases:
        for w in c["state_writes"]:
            target=w["constant_target"]
            if target is not None:
                try: ti=int(target,0)
                except ValueError: ti=int(target)
                edges.append({"from":c["state_value"],"to":ti,"line":w["line"],"target_is_case":ti in known,"rhs":w["rhs"]})
            else: edges.append({"from":c["state_value"],"to":None,"line":w["line"],"target_is_case":False,"rhs":w["rhs"]})
    return _json({"state_variable":state,"states":sorted(known),"edges":edges,"case_count":len(cases),"warning":"Only constant writes visible in the selected lexical windows are captured."})

def _tool_vm_handler_callers(data,args):
    src=_source_text(data); funcs=json.loads(_tool_extract_functions(data,args)).get("functions",[]); names={x["name"].split(".")[-1].split(":")[-1] for x in funcs if x["name"]!="<anonymous>"}; refs=Counter(); locations=defaultdict(list); scan=_masked_source(src)

    return _json({"function_definitions":len(funcs),"called_defined_functions":len(refs),"handler_callers":[{"name":n,"calls":c,"lines":locations[n][:100]} for n,c in refs.most_common(_arg(args,"top",300))],"note":"Lexical references only; scoping and method calls are approximate."})


def _tool_vm_register_access_map(data,args):
    src=_source_text(data); scan=_masked_source(src); table_counter=Counter(); reads=Counter(); writes=Counter(); examples=defaultdict(list)
    for m in re.finditer(r"\b([A-Za-z_]\w*)\s*\[\s*([^\]\n]{1,80})\s*\]\s*(=|\+=|-=|\*=|/=)?",scan):
        table,key,op=m.groups(); table_counter[table]+=1; (writes if op else reads)[table]+=1
        examples[table].append({"line":_adv_line(src,m.start()),"key":key.strip(),"mode":"write" if op else "read"})
    ranked=[]
    for table,c in table_counter.most_common(_arg(args,"top",100)):
        ranked.append({"table":table,"references":c,"reads":reads[table],"writes":writes[table],"examples":examples[table][:30]})
    return _json({"indexed_tables":len(table_counter),"tables":ranked,"hint":"In a candidate VM, R/register/stack/constant table access patterns can expose register files or constant pools."})


def _tool_vm_pc_write_audit(data,args):
    src=_source_text(data); sym=_arg(args,"symbol",None); assignments=_adv_assignments(src,sym)
    if not sym: assignments=[a for a in assignments if re.search(r"pc|state|ip|step|instruction|dispatch|cursor|offset",a["name"],re.I)]
    for a in assignments:
        rhs=a["rhs"]; a["transition_kind"]="constant" if re.fullmatch(r"\s*(?:0x[\da-fA-F]+|\d+)\s*",rhs) else "increment" if re.search(r"\b"+re.escape(a["name"])+r"\s*[+-]\s*(?:1|\w+)",rhs) else "expression"
        a.pop("offset",None)
    return _json({"symbol":sym,"writes":len(assignments),"assignments":assignments[:_arg(args,"top",1000)],"recommendation":"Compare each write with the next instruction fetch; note implicit increments and branch-specific PC overrides."})

def _tool_vm_string_decryptor_map(data,args):

def _tool_vm_handler_clusters(data,args):
    src=_source_text(data); toks=tokenize_lua(src); starts=[]
    for i,t in enumerate(toks):
        if t.value=="function": starts.append((i,t.start,toks[i+1].value if i+1<len(toks) and toks[i+1].kind=="identifier" else "<anonymous>"))
    rows=[]
    apis={"arithmetic":set("+ - * / // % ^".split()),"comparison":set("== ~= < > <= >=".split()),"bitwise":set("& | ~ << >>".split()),"table":set("[ ] .".split()),"control":set("if elseif while for repeat break continue return".split()),"call":set({"("})}
    for i,(ti,pos,name) in enumerate(starts[:1000]):
        endpos=starts[i+1][1] if i+1<len(starts) else len(src); region=src[pos:endpos]; masked=_masked_source(region); rt=tokenize_lua(masked); ops=Counter(t.value for t in rt if t.kind=="operator" or t.value in KEYWORDS); apihits=sorted(set(re.findall(r"\b(?:string|table|bit32|buffer|math)\s*\.\s*\w+",masked)))
        rows.append({"name":name,"line":_adv_line(src,pos),"end_line":_adv_line(src,endpos),"length":len(region),"operators":ops.most_common(15),"api_families":apihits,"branch_count":len(re.findall(r"\b(?:if|elseif|while|for|repeat)\b",masked))})
    return _json({"function_region_count":len(rows),"regions":rows[:_arg(args,"top",300)],"caveat":"Regions end at the next lexical function keyword; nested closures may skew boundaries."})

def _tool_control_flow_branch_map(data,args):

    for m in re.finditer(r"\b(if|elseif|else|while|repeat|until|for|break|continue|return)\b",scan):
        line=_adv_line(src,m.start()); frag=src[m.start():src.find("\n",m.start()) if "\n" in src[m.start():] else len(src)].strip()
        rows.append({"line":line,"kind":m.group(1),"fragment":frag[:220],"offset":m.start()})
    for r in rows:r.pop("offset",None)
    return _json({"control_tokens":len(rows),"rows":rows[:_arg(args,"top",1500)],"accuracy":"Lexical inventory, not syntax tree."})


def _tool_control_flow_loop_map(data,args):

        fragment=src[m.start():endline].strip()
        kind=m.group(1); region=scan[m.start():min(len(scan),m.start()+3000)]
        loops.append({"line":_adv_line(src,m.start()),"kind":kind,"header":fragment[:240],"nearby_breaks":len(re.findall(r"\bbreak\b",region[:1000])),"nearby_continues":len(re.findall(r"\bcontinue\b",region[:1000])),"state_writes":re.findall(r"\b([A-Za-z_]\w*)\s*(?:=|\+=|-=)",region[:1000])[:30]})
    return _json({"loop_count":len(loops),"loops":loops[:_arg(args,"top",500)],"caveat":"Nearby metrics use a bounded source window, not exact loop-body parsing."})

def _tool_control_flow_path_hints(data,args):
    src=_source_text(data); scan=_masked_source(src); depth=0; maxdepth=0; rows=[]
    for i,line in enumerate(scan.splitlines(),1):
        opens=len(re.findall(r"\b(?:if|function|while|for|repeat|do)\b",line)); closes=len(re.findall(r"\bend\b",line))+len(re.findall(r"\buntil\b",line)); depth=max(0,depth+opens-closes); maxdepth=max(maxdepth,depth)
        if opens or closes: rows.append({"line":i,"opens":opens,"closes":closes,"approx_nesting_after_line":depth})
    branches=len(re.findall(r"\b(?:if|elseif|while|for|repeat)\b",scan)); return _json({"branch_sites":branches,"estimated_max_nesting":maxdepth,"nesting_trace":rows[:_arg(args,"top",1000)],"limitations":"The lexical count treats do/function/end naively and is intended to identify hot regions, not prove path reachability."})


def _tool_control_flow_flattened_cases(data,args):

def _tool_control_flow_assignment_slices(data,args):
    src=_source_text(data); sym=_arg(args,"symbol",None)
    if not sym: raise ValueError("provide --symbol VARIABLE")
    assigns=_adv_assignments(src,sym); toks=tokenize_lua(src); uses=[]
    for t in toks:
        if t.kind=="identifier" and t.value==sym:
            line=_adv_line(src,t.start); stmt=src.rfind("\n",0,t.start)+1; end=src.find("\n",t.end); end=len(src) if end<0 else end
            uses.append({"line":line,"role":"write" if re.match(r"\s*"+re.escape(sym)+r"\s*(?:=|[+*/%-]=)",_masked_source(src[stmt:end])) else "read-or-condition","context":src[stmt:end].strip()[:220]})
    return _json({"symbol":sym,"writes":assigns,"reads_and_conditions":uses[:_arg(args,"top",1000)],"slice_hint":"Follow each RHS back to prior definitions; follow each read forward to dependent conditions/table indexes."})


def _tool_dataflow_def_use(data,args):
    src=_source_text(data); toks=tokenize_lua(src); keywords=KEYWORDS|{"then","elseif","else","end","do","repeat","until","local","function","return","for","while","if"}; rows=defaultdict(lambda:{"definitions":[],"uses":[]})
    for i,t in enumerate(toks):
        if t.kind!="identifier" or t.value in keywords: continue
        prev=toks[i-1].value if i else ""; nex=toks[i+1].value if i+1<len(toks) else ""
        role="use"
        if prev=="local" or nex in ("=","+=","-=","*=","/="):
            role="definition"
        entry={"line":_adv_line(src,t.start),"offset":t.start}
        rows[t.value]["definitions" if role=="definition" else "uses"].append(entry)
    result=[]
    for n,v in sorted(rows.items(),key=lambda kv:(-(len(kv[1]["definitions"])+len(kv[1]["uses"])),kv[0]))[:_arg(args,"top",500)]: result.append({"name":n,"definition_count":len(v["definitions"]),"use_count":len(v["uses"]),"definitions":v["definitions"][:50],"uses":v["uses"][:100]})
    return _json({"identifier_count":len(rows),"variables":result,"accuracy":"Lexical approximation; tables, scopes, upvalues and property names can create false positives."})


def _tool_dataflow_constant_propagation(data,args):
    src=_source_text(data); scan=_masked_source(src); rows=[]
    pat=r"\blocal\s+([A-Za-z_]\w*)\s*=\s*(\"(?:\\\\.|[^\"\\\\])*\"|'(?:\\\\.|[^'\\\\])*'|0[xX][0-9a-fA-F]+|\d+(?:\.\d+)?)"
    for m in re.finditer(pat,scan):
        name,lit=m.groups(); remainder=scan[m.end():]; writes=len(re.findall(r"\b"+re.escape(name)+r"\s*(?:=(?!=)|\+=|-=|\*=|/=)",remainder)); occurrences=len(re.findall(r"\b"+re.escape(name)+r"\b",scan));
        if writes==0: value=decode_lua_string(lit) if lit.startswith(("'",'"')) else lit; rows.append({"name":name,"literal":value,"literal_kind":"string" if lit.startswith(("'",'"')) else "number","line":_adv_line(src,m.start()),"later_writes":writes,"references_total":occurrences,"safe_to_consider":occurrences<=30})
    return _json({"propagation_candidates":len(rows),"candidates":rows[:_arg(args,"top",1000)],"note":"Analysis report only. Replacing locals requires scope-aware parsing to avoid changing shadowed identifiers."})


def _tool_dataflow_source_sink(data,args):
    src=_source_text(data); scan=_masked_source(src); sources={"network":[r"HttpGet",r"GetAsync",r"PostAsync",r"request\s*\(",r"http_request"],"filesystem":[r"readfile\s*\(",r"readclipboard\s*\(",r"getcustomasset\s*\("],"decoding":[r"base64",r"decode",r"string\.char",r"bit32\.bxor",r"buffer\.read"],"dynamic_exec":[r"loadstring\s*\(",r"load\s*\(",r"require\s*\("]}; hits={}
