def _tool_scope_shadowing_report(data,args):
    src=_source_text(data); toks=tokenize_lua(src); decls=defaultdict(list)
    for i,t in enumerate(toks):
        if t.value=="local" and i+1<len(toks) and toks[i+1].kind=="identifier":
            v=toks[i+1]; decls[v.value].append({"line":_adv_line(src,v.start),"offset":v.start,"kind":"local"})
        elif t.value=="function" and i+1<len(toks) and toks[i+1].kind=="identifier":
            v=toks[i+1]; decls[v.value].append({"line":_adv_line(src,v.start),"offset":v.start,"kind":"function"})
    rows=[]
    for name,items in decls.items():
        if len(items)>1: rows.append({"name":name,"declarations":items,"count":len(items),"risk":"same identifier declared multiple times; could be valid lexical shadowing"})
    return _json({"duplicate_name_count":len(rows),"duplicates":sorted(rows,key=lambda x:x["name"])[:_arg(args,"top",500)],"note":"Full lexical scope resolution is not performed."})


def _tool_unused_local_hints(data,args):
    src=_source_text(data); toks=tokenize_lua(src); names=defaultdict(list)
    for i,t in enumerate(toks[:-1]):
        if t.value=="local" and toks[i+1].kind=="identifier": names[toks[i+1].value].append(_adv_line(src,toks[i+1].start))
    hints=[]
    for n,lines in names.items():
        count=sum(1 for t in toks if t.kind=="identifier" and t.value==n)
        if count<=len(lines): hints.append({"name":n,"decl_lines":lines,"identifier_occurrences":count})
    return _json({"possible_unused_locals":len(hints),"locals":hints[:_arg(args,"top",500)],"note":"Can false-positive on shadowed declarations, destructuring, or parser quirks."})


def _tool_identifier_role_hints(data,args):
    src=_source_text(data); toks=tokenize_lua(src); counts=Counter(); examples=defaultdict(list)
    for i,t in enumerate(toks):
        if t.kind!="identifier":continue
        prev=toks[i-1].value if i else ""; nex=toks[i+1].value if i+1<len(toks) else ""
        role="read" if nex not in ("=","+=","-=","*=","/=") else "write"
        if prev=="." or prev==":" : role="property-or-method"
        elif prev=="local": role="declaration"
        elif nex=="(": role="call-or-function"
        elif nex=="[": role="index-base"
        counts[(t.value,role)]+=1
        if len(examples[(t.value,role)])<5: examples[(t.value,role)].append(_adv_line(src,t.start))
    rows=[{"identifier":n,"role":r,"count":c,"lines":examples[(n,r)]} for (n,r),c in counts.most_common(_arg(args,"top",1000))]
    return _json({"identifier_role_hints":rows,"note":"Roles are inferred from neighboring tokens, not a full symbol table."})


def _tool_expression_complexity_report(data,args):
    src=_source_text(data); scan=_masked_source(src); rows=[]
    for i,line in enumerate(src.splitlines(),1):
        masked=scan.splitlines()[i-1] if i<=len(scan.splitlines()) else line
        if not masked.strip():continue
        ops=re.findall(r"\.\.|==|~=|<=|>=|\+|\-|\*|/|%|\^|&|\||~|<<|>>",masked)
        calls=len(re.findall(r"\b[A-Za-z_]\w*\s*\(",masked)); indexes=len(re.findall(r"\[[^\]]+\]",masked)); depth=0; maxd=0
        for ch in masked:
            if ch in "([{": depth+=1;maxd=max(maxd,depth)
            elif ch in ")]}": depth=max(0,depth-1)
        score=len(ops)+calls*2+indexes+maxd*2
        if score>=3: rows.append({"line":i,"score":score,"operators":len(ops),"calls":calls,"indexes":indexes,"max_delimiter_depth":maxd,"source":line.strip()[:260]})
    return _json({"complex_expression_lines":len(rows),"ranked_lines":sorted(rows,key=lambda x:(-x["score"],x["line"]))[:_arg(args,"top",300)]})


def _tool_string_decode_chain(data,args):
    src=_source_text(data); rows=[]
    patterns=[("base64",r"\b(?:base64decode|decode64|b64decode)\s*\("),("hex",r"\b(?:fromhex|hexdecode|decodehex)\s*\("),("xor",r"\b(?:bit32|bit)\s*\.\s*bxor\s*\("),("reverse",r"string\s*\.\s*reverse\s*\("),("char-builder",r"(?:string|utf8)\s*\.\s*char\s*\("),("substitution",r"string\s*\.\s*(?:gsub|sub)\s*\("),("concat",r"table\s*\.\s*concat\s*\("),("decompress",r"\b(?:inflate|decompress|zlib|gzip|lzma)\b")]
    scan=_masked_source(src)
    for kind,p in patterns:
        for m in re.finditer(p,scan,re.I): rows.append({"line":_adv_line(src,m.start()),"kind":kind,"offset":m.start(),"context":src[max(0,m.start()-80):min(len(src),m.end()+140)].splitlines()[0][:220]})
    rows.sort(key=lambda r:r["offset"])
    groups=[]
    for r in rows:
        if groups and r["line"]-groups[-1]["last_line"]<=8: groups[-1]["items"].append(r);groups[-1]["last_line"]=r["line"]
        else:groups.append({"first_line":r["line"],"last_line":r["line"],"items":[r]})
    return _json({"decoder_stages":len(rows),"ordered_sites":[{k:v for k,v in r.items() if k!="offset"} for r in rows[:_arg(args,"top",1000)]],"nearby_groups":groups[:200],"warning":"Source position does not prove runtime execution order."})


def _tool_string_builder_map(data,args):
    src=_source_text(data); scan=_masked_source(src); patterns={"char_calls":r"\b(?:string|utf8)\s*\.\s*char\s*\(","concat_operator":r"\.\s*\.","table_concat":r"\btable\s*\.\s*concat\s*\(","format":r"\bstring\s*\.\s*format\s*\(","reversal":r"\bstring\s*\.\s*reverse\s*\(","byte_extract":r"\bstring\s*\.\s*byte\s*\("}
    return _json({k:[{"line":_adv_line(src,m.start()),"snippet":src[m.start():m.start()+200].splitlines()[0]} for m in re.finditer(p,scan,re.I)][:300] for k,p in patterns.items()}|{"next_step":"Start at consumers (loadstring, table keys, API names), then trace producers back through these operations."})


def _tool_string_cipher_function_map(data,args):
    src=_source_text(data); funcs=json.loads(_tool_extract_functions(data,args)).get("functions",[]); cipher_terms=re.compile(r"base64|decode|decrypt|cipher|xor|crypt|decode|byte|char|key|secret|payload|loadstring|reverse",re.I); rows=[]
    for f in funcs:
        context=src[f["offset"]:min(len(src),f["offset"]+1200)]; terms=sorted(set(m.group(0) for m in cipher_terms.finditer(context)))
        if terms:rows.append({"function":f["name"],"line":f["line"],"terms":terms,"api_calls":sorted(set(re.findall(r"\b(?:string|table|bit32|buffer)\s*\.\s*\w+",_masked_source(context))))[:50],"preview":context[:230].splitlines()[0]})
    return _json({"candidate_function_count":len(rows),"functions":rows[:_arg(args,"top",500)],"note":"Name/keyword heuristics can miss fully renamed or split decoder logic."})


def _tool_loader_payload_flow(data,args):
    src=_source_text(data); scan=_masked_source(src); loader_hits=list(re.finditer(r"\b(loadstring|load)\s*\(",scan)); producers=list(re.finditer(r"\b(?:HttpGet|GetAsync|readfile|game:HttpGet|base64decode|b64decode|decompress|decode)\b",scan,re.I)); rows=[]
    for m in loader_hits:
        line=_adv_line(src,m.start()); statement_start=max(src.rfind("\n",0,m.start()),src.rfind(";",0,m.start()))+1; statement_end=src.find("\n",m.end()); statement_end=len(src) if statement_end<0 else statement_end
        frag=src[statement_start:statement_end].strip(); near=[{"line":_adv_line(src,p.start()),"operation":p.group(0)} for p in producers if abs(p.start()-m.start())<1200]
        rows.append({"line":line,"loader":m.group(1),"statement":frag[:360],"nearby_producers":near[:30]})
    return _json({"loader_sinks":rows,"sink_count":len(rows),"producer_count":len(producers),"static_only":True,"safe_handling":"Do not evaluate or download an unknown payload as part of static analysis; save and inspect each stage separately."})


def _tool_dynamic_execution_audit(data,args):
    src=_source_text(data); scan=_masked_source(src); patterns={"dynamic_code":[r"\bloadstring\s*\(",r"\bload\s*\("],"environment_mutation":[r"\bgetfenv\s*\(",r"\bsetfenv\s*\(",r"\b_G\s*\[",r"\bshared\s*\["],"runtime_introspection":[r"\bdebug\s*\.",r"\bdebug\.info\s*\(",r"\bgetgc\s*\(",r"\bgetreg\s*\("],"external_fetch":[r"\bHttpGet\s*\(",r"\brequest\s*\(",r"\bhttp_request\s*\("],"filesystem_or_loader":[r"\breadfile\s*\(",r"\bwritefile\s*\(",r"\brequire\s*\("]}; out={}
    for group,pats in patterns.items():
        out[group]=[]
        for p in pats:
            for m in re.finditer(p,scan,re.I): out[group].append({"line":_adv_line(src,m.start()),"pattern":p,"context":src[max(0,m.start()-65):min(len(src),m.end()+100)].splitlines()[0][:180]})
    return _json({"audit":out,"risk_note":"Flags capability surface only; these names are neither proof of malicious behavior nor necessarily available in standard Roblox Luau."})


def _tool_bytecode_input_probe(data,args):
    head=data[:64]; text=get_text(data).strip(); kind="unknown/binary"; decoded_len=None; decoded_head=None
    if head.startswith(b"<roblox") or head.startswith(b"<?xml"): kind="Roblox XML model/source"
    elif head.startswith(b"PK\x03\x04"):kind="ZIP archive"
    elif head.startswith(b"\x1bLua"):kind="Lua-family binary chunk signature (verify runtime/version)"
    elif head.startswith(b"RSB1") :kind="Roblox binary model signature candidate"
    else:
        try:
            candidate=_base64_decode(text.encode())
            if candidate and candidate!=data:kind="base64-text wrapping binary/text payload";decoded_len=len(candidate);decoded_head=candidate[:24].hex(" ")
        except Exception:
            compact=re.sub(r"\s+", "", text.removeprefix("hex:").removeprefix("0x"))
            if len(compact)>=16 and len(compact)%2==0 and re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-fA-F]+",compact):kind="hex-text wrapping binary payload";decoded_len=len(bytes.fromhex(compact));decoded_head=bytes.fromhex(compact[:48]).hex(" ")
            elif re.fullmatch(r"\s*\[\s*(?:\d+\s*,?\s*)+\]\s*",text):kind="Python-style decimal byte array candidate"
    return _json({"input_bytes":len(data),"sha256":hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),"kind_guess":kind,"head_hex":head.hex(" "),"decoded_candidate_length":decoded_len,"decoded_candidate_head_hex":decoded_head,"raw_input_retained":True,"caveat":"Luau bytecode does not use the standard Lua signature in all tool/runtime formats; prefer a matching Luau decompiler's info/disassemble commands."})


def _tool_bytecode_normalize_input(data,args):
    raw=data; text=get_text(data).strip(); mode="raw bytes preserved"
    if _arg(args,"literal",None) is not None: text=str(_arg(args,"literal")); raw=text.encode()
    try:
        if text.lower().startswith("base64:"): raw=base64.b64decode(re.sub(r"\s+","",text[7:]),validate=True); mode="base64 prefix"
        elif text.lower().startswith("hex:"): raw=bytes.fromhex(text[4:]); mode="hex prefix"
        elif text.startswith("0x") and re.fullmatch(r"0x[\da-fA-F]+",text): raw=bytes.fromhex(text[2:]); mode="0x-prefixed hex"
        elif re.fullmatch(r"(?:[0-9a-fA-F]{2}[\s,]*){4,}",text) and len(re.sub(r"[\s,]","",text))%2==0: raw=bytes.fromhex(re.sub(r"[\s,]","",text)); mode="spaced hex bytes"
        elif re.fullmatch(r"\s*\[\s*(?:\d+\s*,?\s*)+\]\s*",text):
            vals=ast.literal_eval(text)
            if not isinstance(vals,list) or any(not isinstance(x,int) or x<0 or x>255 for x in vals): raise ValueError("byte list values must be integers 0..255")
            raw=bytes(vals); mode="decimal byte list"
        elif text.lower().startswith("base64:") is False and re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9+/]{16,}={0,2}",text) and len(text)%4==0:
            candidate=base64.b64decode(text,validate=True)
            if candidate: raw=candidate; mode="detected base64 text"
    except (ValueError, binascii.Error) as exc:
        raise ValueError(f"Could not normalize byte representation: {exc}")
    return raw


def _tool_bytecode_header_report(data,args):
    return _tool_bytecode_input_probe(data,args)


def _tool_bytecode_toolchain_diagnose(data,args):
    import shutil
    tools={"luau-decompiler":"Luau bytecode decompile/disassemble/info","unluau":"alternative Luau bytecode decompiler","luau-compile":"official Luau compiler (if separate CLI installed)","luau-analyze":"official Luau static analyzer","luau":"official Luau CLI (do not run untrusted source)","tree-sitter":"generic parser CLI; grammar/plugin required","dot":"Graphviz DOT renderer","cargo":"Rust build tooling","dotnet":".NET runtime/build tooling"}; rows=[]
    for cmd,purpose in tools.items(): rows.append({"command":cmd,"available":bool(shutil.which(cmd)),"path":shutil.which(cmd),"purpose":purpose})
    return _json({"tools":rows,"network_used":False,"executables_launched":False,"recommendation":"Prefer PumbaaDev/luau-decompiler for a locally built bytecode decompiler, official luau-compile/analyze for compiler-grade checks, and tree-sitter-luau for syntax-tree analysis."})


def _tool_bytecode_decompile_matrix(data,args):
    import shutil
    path=shutil.which("luau-decompiler")
    target=_arg(args,"input",None)
    if not path:return _json({"status":"optional tool missing","required":"luau-decompiler","commands":["luau-decompiler FILE -o OUT.txt","luau-decompiler disassemble FILE --debug-info","luau-decompiler info FILE --json"],"note":"Install/build upstream tool separately; no bytecode was executed."})
    if not target or target=="-": raise ValueError("provide a named bytecode file, not stdin")
    results=[]
    commands=[[path,target,"-o",str(Path(target).with_suffix(".decompiled.txt"))],[path,"disassemble",target,"--debug-info"],[path,"info",target,"--json"]]
    for cmd in commands:
        try:
            p=subprocess.run(cmd,capture_output=True,timeout=max(2,min(_arg(args,"timeout",90),300)),check=False)
            results.append({"command":cmd,"returncode":p.returncode,"stdout":p.stdout.decode("utf-8",errors="replace")[:300000],"stderr":p.stderr.decode("utf-8",errors="replace")[:60000]})
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired: results.append({"command":cmd,"error":"timeout"})
    return _json({"results":results,"note":"Runs only external analysis/decompile subcommands on the named file; never runs recovered source."})


def _tool_rbxmx_source_extract(data,args):
    import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
    raw=get_text(data)
    try: root=ET.fromstring(raw)
    except ET.ParseError as exc: raise ValueError(f"Input is not parseable XML (.rbxmx/.xml): {exc}")
    rows=[]
    for item in root.iter():
        cls=item.attrib.get("class","")
        if cls not in ("Script","LocalScript","ModuleScript"): continue
        props=next((ch for ch in list(item) if ch.tag=="Properties"),None)
        name=next((ch.text for ch in list(props or []) if ch.attrib.get("name")=="Name"),"<unnamed>")
        srcnode=next((ch for ch in list(props or []) if ch.attrib.get("name")=="Source"),None)
        if srcnode is not None: rows.append({"class":cls,"name":name,"source":srcnode.text or ""})
    textout="\n\n".join(f"-- extracted {r['class']}: {r['name']}\n{r['source']}" for r in rows)
    if _arg(args,"report",None): Path(args.report).write_text(_json([{k:v for k,v in r.items() if k!="source"}|{"source_bytes":len(r["source"].encode())} for r in rows]),encoding="utf-8")
    if not rows:return _json({"scripts_found":0,"note":"No Script/LocalScript/ModuleScript Source properties were found in this XML model."})
    return textout


def _tool_roundtrip_validation_plan(data,args):
    src=_source_text(data); checks=[{"step":1,"tool":"luau-analyze","purpose":"type/syntax diagnostics","command":"luau-analyze input.lua"},{"step":2,"tool":"luau-compile","purpose":"compiler acceptance / emit canonical bytecode","command":"luau-compile --binary input.lua > output.bin"},{"step":3,"tool":"luau-decompiler","purpose":"decompile and inspect bytecode metadata/disassembly","command":"luau-decompiler input.bin -o roundtrip.txt"},{"step":4,"tool":"token comparison","purpose":"compare identifiers/constants/control-flow indicators without executing script","command":"python run.txt source-mutual-similarity input.lua --against roundtrip.txt"}]
    return _json({"input_bytes":len(data),"sha256":hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),"validation_plan":checks,"notes":["Do not run unknown Roblox/executor code as a validation step.","Bytecode compiler/decompiler round trips are not byte-identical source recovery.","Run tests only in an isolated, non-networked Luau environment for code you are authorized to inspect."]})


def _tool_full_static_pipeline(data,args):
    src=_source_text(data); transformed=_tool_deobfuscate(data,args); b=transformed.encode("utf-8"); report={"tool":"LuauLab Advanced full static pipeline","version":"3.3","input":{"bytes":len(data),"sha256":hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()},"transformed":{"bytes":len(b),"sha256":hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest(),"changed":b!=data,"passes":json.loads(_tool_multi_stage_scan(data,args))},"vm_architecture":json.loads(_tool_vm_architecture_report(b,args)),"control_flow":json.loads(_tool_control_flow_state_machine(b,args)),"dataflow":json.loads(_tool_dataflow_source_sink(b,args)),"strings":json.loads(_tool_string_decode_chain(b,args)),"static_only":True,"next_steps":["Inspect decoder candidates and rerun pipeline on each recovered stage.","For binary Luau bytecode, use an external decompiler matching that bytecode version.","Verify decompiled output with a parser/compiler, then review semantics manually."]}

def _tool_source_mutual_similarity(data,args):
    path=_arg(args,"against",None)
    if not path:raise ValueError("provide --against SECOND_SOURCE")
    a=_source_text(data); b=Path(path).read_text(encoding="utf-8",errors="replace"); ta=[t.kind+":"+t.value for t in tokenize_lua(a)];tb=[t.kind+":"+t.value for t in tokenize_lua(b)]; sm=difflib.SequenceMatcher(a=ta,b=tb,autojunk=False); ratio=sm.ratio(); blocks=sm.get_matching_blocks()
    return _json({"token_similarity":round(ratio,6),"left_tokens":len(ta),"right_tokens":len(tb),"matching_blocks":[{"left_start":x.a,"right_start":x.b,"length":x.size} for x in blocks if x.size>=4][:500],"interpretation":"Useful for checking whether a transformation preserved structure; obfuscation can lower similarity even when behavior is preserved."})

def _tool_control_flow_token_graph(data,args):
    src=_source_text(data); toks=tokenize_lua(_masked_source(src)); nodes=[]
    wanted={"if","elseif","else","while","for","repeat","until","break","continue","return","function","end","do"}
    for t in toks:
        if t.value in wanted:nodes.append({"token":t.value,"line":_adv_line(src,t.start),"offset":t.start})
    edges=[]
    for a,b in zip(nodes,nodes[1:]):edges.append({"from":{"token":a["token"],"line":a["line"]},"to":{"token":b["token"],"line":b["line"]},"type":"next_control_token"})
    dot=["digraph LuauControlTokens {","  rankdir=TB;","  node [shape=box];"]
    for i,n in enumerate(nodes):dot.append(f'  n{i} [label="{n["token"]} line {n["line"]}"];')
    for i in range(1,len(nodes)):dot.append(f"  n{i-1} -> n{i};")
    dot.append("}")
    return _json({"nodes":nodes[:_arg(args,"top",2000)],"edges":edges[:_arg(args,"top",2000)],"graphviz_dot":"\n".join(dot),"note":"Sequential control-token graph, not a true semantic CFG."})


def _tool_vm_state_correlation(data,args):
    src=_source_text(data); scan=_masked_source(src); state,counts=_adv_state_variable(src); corr=[]
    branches=Counter(re.findall(r"\b(?:if|elseif)\s+([A-Za-z_]\w*)\s*==\s*(?:0x[\da-fA-F]+|\d+)\s+then",scan)); indexes=Counter(re.findall(r"\b([A-Za-z_]\w*)\s*\[\s*([A-Za-z_]\w*)\s*\]",scan)); writes=Counter(a["name"] for a in _adv_assignments(src))
    for var,n in branches.items():
        tabrefs=[{"table":tab,"index":idx,"count":c} for (tab,idx),c in indexes.items() if idx==var]
        corr.append({"variable":var,"numeric_branch_count":n,"assignment_count":writes[var],"used_as_table_index":sum(x["count"] for x in tabrefs)>0,"indexed_tables":tabrefs})
    return _json({"primary_state_guess":state,"state_rank":counts.most_common(20),"correlations":sorted(corr,key=lambda x:(-(x["numeric_branch_count"]+x["assignment_count"]),x["variable"]))[:_arg(args,"top",300)],"note":"The best candidate is often a state/PC/opcode variable, but not guaranteed."})


def _tool_vm_handler_semantic_hints(data,args):

        rows.append({"line":_adv_line(src,m.start()),"selector":m.group(1),"opcode":int(m.group(2),0),"operator_profile":ops.most_common(20),"api_calls":apis,"assignment_targets":Counter(a for a,_ in assigns).most_common(30),"assignments_preview":[f"{a} = {b.strip()}" for a,b in assigns[:30]]})
    return _json({"semantic_handler_candidates":len(rows),"handlers":rows[:_arg(args,"top",500)],"caveat":"Handler bodies are bounded lexical regions; nested if/end structures are not parsed perfectly."})


def _tool_vm_dataflow_tables(data,args):

def _tool_vm_constant_transform_chain(data,args):
    src=_source_text(data); scan=_masked_source(src); stages=[]
    patterns={"xor":r"\b(?:bit32|bit)\s*\.\s*bxor\s*\(","arithmetic_mask":r"(?:%\s*256|&\s*0x[\da-fA-F]+|\band\s+255\b)","string_from_numbers":r"\b(?:string|utf8)\s*\.\s*char\s*\(","reverse":r"\bstring\s*\.\s*reverse\s*\(","base64_decode":r"\b(?:base64decode|b64decode|decode64)\s*\(","substitution":r"\bstring\s*\.\s*(?:gsub|sub)\s*\(","format":r"\bstring\s*\.\s*format\s*\(","loader":r"\b(?:loadstring|load)\s*\("}
    for name,p in patterns.items():
        hits=[{"line":_adv_line(src,m.start()),"preview":src[m.start():m.start()+150].splitlines()[0]} for m in re.finditer(p,scan,re.I)]
        if hits:stages.append({"stage_type":name,"count":len(hits),"sites":hits[:100]})
    return _json({"candidate_transforms_in_source_order":sorted([x for x in stages],key=lambda x:min((h["line"] for h in x["sites"]),default=0)),"static_only":True,"note":"The lexical source order is not guaranteed to be execution order. Trace values explicitly."})


def _tool_vm_opcode_remap_analysis(data,args):
    src=_source_text(data); scan=_masked_source(src); arrays=json.loads(_tool_opcode_byte_candidates(data,args))["candidates"]; assignment_hist=Counter()
    for m in re.finditer(r"\b([A-Za-z_]\w*)\s*\[\s*(0x[\da-fA-F]+|\d+)\s*\]\s*=\s*(0x[\da-fA-F]+|\d+)",scan):
        assignment_hist[m.group(1)]+=1
    branch_counts=Counter(re.findall(r"\b(?:if|elseif)\s+([A-Za-z_]\w*)\s*==\s*(?:0x[\da-fA-F]+|\d+)\s+then",scan))
    return _json({"numeric_array_candidates":arrays[:100],"numeric_key_tables":assignment_hist.most_common(100),"opcode_selector_candidates":branch_counts.most_common(100),"permutation_evidence":["Search for a map array that turns observed opcode bytes into small instruction IDs.","Check for duplicate/missing values and whether the mapping is bijective.","Compare the inferred mapping against known instruction semantics, not raw frequency."],"automatic_permutation_recovery":False})


def _tool_bytecode_corpus_manifest(data,args):
    folder=_arg(args,"batch_dir",None)
    if not folder: return _json({"status":"missing --batch-dir","example":"python run.txt bytecode-corpus-manifest . --batch-dir samples"})
    root=Path(folder); items=[]; limit=max(1,min(_arg(args,"limit",500),10000))
    if not root.exists() or not root.is_dir(): raise ValueError("--batch-dir must point to an existing directory")
    for p in sorted(root.rglob("*")):
        if len(items)>=limit:break
        if not p.is_file():continue
        try: b=p.read_bytes(); items.append({"path":str(p.relative_to(root)),"bytes":len(b),"sha256":hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest(),"entropy":round(shannon_entropy(b),5),"type":_file_type(b),"head_hex":b[:16].hex(" ")})
        except OSError as exc:items.append({"path":str(p),"error":str(exc)})
    return _json({"root":str(root),"files":len(items),"manifest":items,"manifest_sha256":hashlib.sha256(_json(items).encode()).hexdigest()})

def _tool_vm_reconstruction_checklist(data,args):

    steps=[{"priority":1,"task":"Find the instruction fetch and determine whether PC increments before or after the fetch.","evidence":"vm-byte-reader-hints + vm-pc-write-audit"},{"priority":2,"task":"Map raw opcode -> normalized opcode transformations and identify the complete mapping domain.","evidence":"vm-opcode-remap-analysis + vm-opcode-correlation"},{"priority":3,"task":"Recover handler boundaries and read/write effects on registers, stack, constants, upvalues and PC.","evidence":"vm-opcode-handler-index + vm-handler-semantic-hints + vm-register-access-map"},{"priority":4,"task":"Build state transition graph and label conditional/unconditional edges.","evidence":"vm-state-transition-dot + control-flow-state-machine"},{"priority":5,"task":"Lift handlers to an intermediate representation before generating readable Luau.","evidence":"External decompiler / AST tool; not inferable from patterns alone"},{"priority":6,"task":"Compare recovered semantics using compiler diagnostics and non-executing structure checks.","evidence":"roundtrip-validation-plan"}]
    return _json({"evidence_summary":summary,"recommended_reconstruction_steps":steps,"confidence":"Plan based on static indicators; not a decompiler result."})


def _tool_source_api_dataflow(data,args):

    src=_source_text(data); scan=_masked_source(src); patterns={"sources":r"\b(?:HttpGet|GetAsync|readfile|readclipboard|request|http_request)\s*(?:\.|\()", "transforms":r"\b(?:base64decode|decode64|decompress|gsub|reverse|bxor|char|concat)\b", "sinks":r"\b(?:loadstring|load|require|writefile|FireServer|InvokeServer)\s*\("}; found={}
    for k,p in patterns.items():found[k]=[{"line":_adv_line(src,m.start()),"api":m.group(0),"context":src[max(0,m.start()-80):min(len(src),m.end()+100)].splitlines()[0][:220]} for m in re.finditer(p,scan,re.I)][:500]
    source_lines=[x["line"] for x in found["sources"]]; transform_lines=[x["line"] for x in found["transforms"]]; sink_lines=[x["line"] for x in found["sinks"]]
    correlations=[]
    for s in source_lines:
        nearby=[t for t in transform_lines if abs(t-s)<=80]; ends=[e for e in sink_lines if abs(e-s)<=120]
        if nearby or ends:correlations.append({"source_line":s,"nearby_transform_lines":nearby[:30],"nearby_sink_lines":ends[:30]})
    return _json({"indicators":found,"proximity_correlations":correlations,"note":"Line-distance is only a triage heuristic, not a dataflow proof."})

def _tool_luraph_profile_scan(data,args):
    src=_source_text(data); scan=_masked_source(src); raw=get_text(data)
    patterns={
      "explicit_luraph_header":r"Luraph\s+Obfuscator\s+v?\d+(?:\.\d+)?",
      "setmetatable_vm_object":r"return\s+setmetatable\s*\(\s*\{",
      "bit32_dispatch_shape":r"\bbit32\s*\.\s*(?:bxor|band|bor|rshift|lshift)\s*\(",
      "numeric_state_dispatch":r"\b(?:if|elseif)\s+\w+\s*==\s*(?:0x[\da-fA-F]+|\d+)\s+then",
      "large_slot_table":r"\{\s*\[[^]]+\]\s*=",
      "nested_prototype_terms":r"\b(?:proto|prototypes|upvalues|constants|closure)\b",
    }
    hits={k:[{"line":_adv_line(src,m.start()),"preview":raw[m.start():m.start()+180].splitlines()[0]} for m in re.finditer(p,raw if k=="explicit_luraph_header" else scan,re.I)][:200] for k,p in patterns.items()}
    score=(40 if hits["explicit_luraph_header"] else 0)+min(20,len(hits["setmetatable_vm_object"])*10)+min(15,len(hits["bit32_dispatch_shape"])*3)+min(15,len(hits["numeric_state_dispatch"])*2)+min(5,len(hits["large_slot_table"])*2)+min(5,len(hits["nested_prototype_terms"]))
    return _json({"profile":"Luraph-like static fingerprint","score":min(100,score),"evidence":hits,"classification":"strong header evidence" if hits["explicit_luraph_header"] else "shape-compatible only" if score>=35 else "insufficient Luraph-specific evidence","note":"Fingerprint is not proof of protector/version. Upstream tools target specific Luraph releases; see UPSTREAM_TOOLS.txt."})


def _tool_ironbrew_profile_scan(data,args):
    src=_source_text(data); scan=_masked_source(src)
    patterns={"explicit_ironbrew_word":r"\bIronBrew(?:\s*1|\s*2)?\b","dispatch_loop":r"\bwhile\s+(?:true|1)\s+do","numeric_opcode_cases":r"\b(?:if|elseif)\s+\w+\s*==\s*(?:0x[\da-fA-F]+|\d+)\s+then","bitwise_transform":r"\b(?:bit32|bit)\s*\.\s*(?:bxor|band|bor|rshift|lshift)\s*\(","function_table_dispatch":r"\b\w+\s*\[\s*\w+\s*\]\s*\(","serialized_numeric_tables":r"\{\s*(?:0x[\da-fA-F]+|\d+)\s*(?:,\s*(?:0x[\da-fA-F]+|\d+)\s*){7,}\}"}
    hits={k:[{"line":_adv_line(src,m.start()),"preview":src[m.start():m.start()+160].splitlines()[0]} for m in re.finditer(p,src if k=="explicit_ironbrew_word" else scan,re.I)][:250] for k,p in patterns.items()}
    score=(45 if hits["explicit_ironbrew_word"] else 0)+min(20,len(hits["dispatch_loop"])*10)+min(15,len(hits["numeric_opcode_cases"])*2)+min(10,len(hits["bitwise_transform"])*2)+min(5,len(hits["function_table_dispatch"])*2)+min(5,len(hits["serialized_numeric_tables"])*3)
    return _json({"profile":"IronBrew-like VM fingerprint","score":min(100,score),"evidence":hits,"classification":"explicit string present" if hits["explicit_ironbrew_word"] else "generic VM-shape match" if score>=35 else "insufficient family-specific evidence","note":"VM-shape features are generic and can occur in ordinary interpreters; compare against known-version samples."})


def _tool_obfuscator_family_diff(data,args):

    candidates=[{"family":"Luraph-like","score":lur["score"],"evidence":"version header or VM-object/bit32/slot-table shape"},{"family":"IronBrew-like","score":iron["score"],"evidence":"dispatch loop, opcode comparisons, bitwise transforms, numeric tables"},{"family":"Generic VM/flattening","score":generic["vm_likelihood_score"],"evidence":"state branches, index tables, loops and numeric arrays"},{"family":"String-layer obfuscation","score":min(100,len(string["ordered_sites"])*8),"evidence":"text decoder/builder transforms"}]
    return _json({"ranked_hypotheses":sorted(candidates,key=lambda x:x["score"],reverse=True),"profiles":{"luraph":lur,"ironbrew":iron},"important":"Scores are unrelated heuristics calibrated for triage, not probabilities. Do not infer exact protector version without independent markers."})

def _tool_vm_handler_invariant_check(data,args):
    src=_source_text(data); scan=_masked_source(src); matches=list(re.finditer(r"\b(?:if|elseif)\s+([A-Za-z_]\w*)\s*==\s*(0x[\da-fA-F]+|\d+)\s+then",scan)); groups=defaultdict(list)
    for i,m in enumerate(matches):
        end=matches[i+1].start() if i+1<len(matches) else min(len(src),m.end()+1200); reg=_masked_source(src[m.end():end]); ops=tuple(sorted(Counter(re.findall(r"\+\+|--|==|~=|<=|>=|\.\.|//|<<|>>|[+*/%&|^~-]",reg)).items())); writes=tuple(sorted(Counter(re.findall(r"\b([A-Za-z_]\w*)\s*(?:=|\+=|-=|\*=|/=)",reg)).items())); calls=tuple(sorted(set(re.findall(r"\b(?:string|table|math|bit32|buffer)\s*\.\s*\w+",reg))))
        sig=hashlib.sha1(repr((ops,writes,calls)).encode()).hexdigest()[:10]
        groups[sig].append({"line":_adv_line(src,m.start()),"selector":m.group(1),"opcode":int(m.group(2),0),"operators":ops,"writes":writes,"calls":calls})
    clusters=[{"signature":sig,"count":len(rows),"potentially_similar_handlers":rows} for sig,rows in groups.items() if len(rows)>1]
    return _json({"handlers":len(matches),"signature_clusters":sorted(clusters,key=lambda x:-x["count"]),"unique_signatures":len(groups),"note":"Similarity is lexical; handlers can look alike but differ semantically, and bounded regions can include nested cases."})


def _tool_bytecode_disassembly_audit(data,args):
    src=_source_text(data); lines=src.splitlines(); op_rows=[]; branches=[]; regs=Counter(); counts=Counter()

    for i,line in enumerate(lines,1):
        m=re.match(r"\s*(?:(\d+)\s*[:| ]\s*)?(\w{2,24})(?:\s+|$)(.*)",line)
        if not m:continue
        op=m.group(2).upper(); tail=m.group(3); counts[op]+=1
        regs.update(re.findall(r"\bR(\d+)\b",tail))
        if any(k in op for k in ("JUMP","BRANCH","FORGLOOP","FORGPREP","LOADB")) or re.search(r"\b(?:jump|branch|target)\b",tail,re.I): branches.append({"line":i,"opcode":op,"operands":tail[:200]})
        op_rows.append({"line":i,"instruction_index":m.group(1),"opcode":op,"operands":tail[:200]})
    return _json({"input_lines":len(lines),"parsed_instruction_candidates":len(op_rows),"opcode_histogram":counts.most_common(200),"branch_instruction_candidates":branches[:_arg(args,"top",1000)],"register_mentions":regs.most_common(200),"first_instructions":op_rows[:min(200,_arg(args,"top",200))],"note":"Feed actual disassembly text, not raw bytecode. Unknown disassembler syntaxes may not match this line parser."})


def _tool_vm_loop_recoverability(data,args):
    src=_source_text(data); scan=_masked_source(src); state,cases=_adv_state_cases(src,_arg(args,"symbol",None)); trans=json.loads(_tool_vm_state_transitions(data,args)).get("edges",[]); flags={"explicit_pc_state":bool(state),"numeric_state_cases":len(cases),"constant_transitions":sum(1 for e in trans if e.get("to") is not None),"pc_increment_patterns":len(re.findall(r"\b(?:pc|ip|pos|cursor|offset)\s*(?:\+=\s*\d+|=\s*(?:pc|ip|pos|cursor|offset)\s*\+\s*\d+)",scan,re.I)),"byte_reader_patterns":len(re.findall(r"\b(?:string\s*\.\s*byte|buffer\s*\.\s*read\w*)\s*\(",scan,re.I)),"indexed_tables":len(re.findall(r"\b\w+\s*\[\s*\w+\s*\]",scan)),"branch_sites":len(re.findall(r"\b(?:if|elseif|while|for)\b",scan))}
    score=min(100,flags["numeric_state_cases"]*4+flags["constant_transitions"]*4+flags["pc_increment_patterns"]*3+flags["byte_reader_patterns"]*4+min(20,flags["indexed_tables"])+flags["explicit_pc_state"]*10)
    return _json({"static_lifting_readiness_score":score,"indicators":flags,"most_useful_next_steps":["Identify fetch/decode/execute loop and separate it from loader/setup code.","Recover raw-opcode normalization before interpreting handler IDs.","Model register/stack/constants/upvalues explicitly in an intermediate representation.","Build branch edges from PC writes and only then reconstruct if/loop structure."],"not_a_success_probability":True})

def _tool_unluau_decompile(data,args):
    import shutil
    exe=shutil.which("unluau")
    if not exe: raise ValueError("unluau is not installed or not present in PATH; see UPSTREAM_TOOLS.txt")
    inp=_arg(args,"input",None)
    if not inp or inp=="-": raise ValueError("unluau-decompile requires a named bytecode file")
    try: p=subprocess.run([exe,inp],capture_output=True,timeout=max(2,min(_arg(args,"timeout",90),300)),check=False)
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired: raise ValueError("unluau exceeded timeout")
    stdout=p.stdout.decode("utf-8",errors="replace")
    if p.returncode!=0: raise ValueError("unluau failed (exit %s): %s"%(p.returncode,p.stderr.decode("utf-8",errors="replace")[:3000]))
    return stdout


def _tool_unluau_disassemble(data,args):
    import shutil
    exe=shutil.which("unluau")
    if not exe: raise ValueError("unluau is not installed or not present in PATH; see UPSTREAM_TOOLS.txt")
    inp=_arg(args,"input",None)
    if not inp or inp=="-": raise ValueError("unluau-disassemble requires a named bytecode file")
    try: p=subprocess.run([exe,inp,"-d"],capture_output=True,timeout=max(2,min(_arg(args,"timeout",90),300)),check=False)
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired: raise ValueError("unluau exceeded timeout")
    stdout=p.stdout.decode("utf-8",errors="replace"); stderr=p.stderr.decode("utf-8",errors="replace")
    if p.returncode!=0: raise ValueError("unluau disassembly failed (exit %s): %s"%(p.returncode,stderr[:3000]))
    return stdout

def _tool_external_decompiler_compare(data,args):
    import shutil
    inp=_arg(args,"input",None)
    if not inp or inp=="-": raise ValueError("provide a named Luau bytecode file")
    tools={"pumbaa":shutil.which("luau-decompiler"),"unluau":shutil.which("unluau")}; results={}
    for name,exe in tools.items():
        if not exe: results[name]={"available":False,"reason":"CLI not found in PATH"}; continue
        cmd=[exe,inp]
        try: p=subprocess.run(cmd,capture_output=True,timeout=max(2,min(_arg(args,"timeout",90),300)),check=False)
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired: results[name]={"available":True,"command":cmd,"error":"timeout"}; continue
        out=p.stdout.decode("utf-8",errors="replace"); err=p.stderr.decode("utf-8",errors="replace")
        results[name]={"available":True,"command":cmd,"returncode":p.returncode,"output_bytes":len(p.stdout),"output_sha256":hashlib.sha256(p.stdout).hexdigest(),"output_preview":out[:1200],"stderr_preview":err[:1000]}
    valid=[(n,r) for n,r in results.items() if r.get("available") and r.get("returncode")==0 and r.get("output_bytes",0)>0]
    similarity=None
    if len(valid)>=2:
        toks=[[t.kind+":"+t.value for t in tokenize_lua(r["output_preview"])] for _,r in valid]
        similarity=round(difflib.SequenceMatcher(a=toks[0],b=toks[1],autojunk=False).ratio(),6)
    return _json({"input_path":inp,"tools":results,"token_similarity_on_previews":similarity,"comparison_note":"Preview similarity is only triage; results are truncated and must be compared as full files. Neither command executes recovered source."})

def _tool_vm_handler_feature_vectors(data,args):
    src=_source_text(data); scan=_masked_source(src); rows=[]
    pat=re.compile(r"\b(?:if|elseif)\s+([A-Za-z_]\w*)\s*==\s*(0x[\da-fA-F]+|\d+)\s+then")
    for m in pat.finditer(scan):
        tail=scan[m.end():]
        stop=re.search(r"\b(?:elseif|else|end)\b",tail)
        end=m.end()+(stop.start() if stop else min(len(tail),1200))
        body=scan[m.end():end]
        nums=[]
        try: opcode=int(m.group(2),0)
        except ValueError: opcode=int(m.group(2))
        rows.append({"opcode_selector":m.group(1),"opcode":opcode,"line":_adv_line(src,m.start()),"body_bytes":len(body),"register_reads":sorted(set(re.findall(r"\bR\s*\[\s*([^\]]+)\s*\]",body))),"tables_touched":sorted(set(re.findall(r"\b([A-Za-z_]\w*)\s*\[",body))),"calls":sorted(set(re.findall(r"\b([A-Za-z_]\w*(?:\.[A-Za-z_]\w*)*)\s*\(",body))),"operators":sorted(set(re.findall(r"==|~=|<=|>=|<<|>>|\.\.|[+*/%&|~^-]",body))),"pc_or_state_writes":re.findall(r"\b([A-Za-z_]\w*(?:pc|state|ip|step|cursor|offset)[A-Za-z_\w]*)\s*=(?!=)",body,re.I),"return_count":len(re.findall(r"\breturn\b",body)),"branch_count":len(re.findall(r"\b(?:if|elseif)\b",body))})
    return _json({"handler_feature_vectors":len(rows),"handlers":rows[:_arg(args,"top",500)],"method":"Lexical feature extraction; handler boundaries are approximate until parsed from an AST."})


def _tool_vm_handler_clone_candidates(data,args):
    rows=json.loads(_tool_vm_handler_feature_vectors(data,args)).get("handlers",[]); groups=defaultdict(list)
    for r in rows:
        signature=(tuple(r["tables_touched"]),tuple(r["operators"]),tuple(r["calls"]),r["return_count"],r["branch_count"])
        groups[signature].append({"opcode":r["opcode"],"line":r["line"]})
    clones=[{"signature":{"tables":list(k[0]),"operators":list(k[1]),"calls":list(k[2]),"returns":k[3],"branches":k[4]},"handlers":v} for k,v in groups.items() if len(v)>1]
    clones.sort(key=lambda x:-len(x["handlers"]))
    return _json({"candidate_clone_groups":len(clones),"groups":clones[:_arg(args,"top",200)],"note":"Same coarse feature signature does not prove semantic equivalence; inspect full handler bodies."})


def _tool_vm_state_transition_matrix(data,args):
    obj=json.loads(_tool_vm_state_transitions(data,args)); states=sorted(set(obj.get("states",[]))|{e["to"] for e in obj.get("edges",[]) if e.get("to") is not None}); matrix=[]
    for src in states:
        targets=[e.get("to") for e in obj.get("edges",[]) if e.get("from")==src]
        matrix.append({"state":src,"targets":targets,"target_counts":dict(Counter(str(x) for x in targets)),"unknown_target_count":sum(x is None for x in targets)})
    return _json({"state_variable":obj.get("state_variable"),"states":states,"adjacency_matrix":matrix,"edges":obj.get("edges",[]),"note":"Only explicit constant transitions visible to the existing lexical extractor are included."})


def _tool_vm_state_reachability(data,args):
    obj=json.loads(_tool_vm_state_transitions(data,args)); states=set(obj.get("states",[])); graph=defaultdict(set)
    for e in obj.get("edges",[]):
        if e.get("to") is not None: graph[e["from"]].add(e["to"]); states.add(e["to"]); states.add(e["from"])
    report=[]
    for start in sorted(states):
        seen=set(); todo=[start]
        while todo:
            n=todo.pop()
            if n in seen: continue
            seen.add(n); todo.extend(graph.get(n,set())-seen)
        report.append({"start_state":start,"reachable_states":sorted(seen),"reachable_count":len(seen),"dead_end":not graph.get(start)})
    return _json({"state_count":len(states),"reachability":report,"unreachable_from_each_other":sorted(s for s in states if not any(s in set(r["reachable_states"]) for r in report if r["start_state"]==min(states,default=s))),"note":"The first listed state is not guaranteed to be the actual VM entry state."})


def _tool_vm_state_scc(data,args):
    obj=json.loads(_tool_vm_state_transitions(data,args)); graph=defaultdict(set); vertices=set(obj.get("states",[]))
    for e in obj.get("edges",[]):
        if e.get("to") is not None: graph[e["from"]].add(e["to"]); vertices.update((e["from"],e["to"]))
    index=0; stack=[]; on=set(); idx={}; low={}; comps=[]
    def visit(v):
        nonlocal index
        idx[v]=low[v]=index; index+=1; stack.append(v); on.add(v)
        for w in graph.get(v,set()):
            if w not in idx: visit(w); low[v]=min(low[v],low[w])
            elif w in on: low[v]=min(low[v],idx[w])
        if low[v]==idx[v]:
            comp=[]
            while stack:
                w=stack.pop(); on.remove(w); comp.append(w)
                if w==v: break
            comps.append(sorted(comp))
    for v in sorted(vertices):
        if v not in idx: visit(v)
    return _json({"strongly_connected_components":comps,"component_count":len(comps),"cyclic_components":[c for c in comps if len(c)>1 or (c and c[0] in graph.get(c[0],set()))],"note":"SCC results apply only to extracted constant state edges, not a proven complete CFG."})


def _tool_vm_state_unknown_writes(data,args):

    for a in rows:
        n=a.get("name","")
        if sym or re.search(r"pc|state|ip|step|dispatch|cursor|offset|opcode",n,re.I):
            rhs=a.get("rhs",""); kind="constant" if re.fullmatch(r"\s*(?:0x[\da-fA-F]+|\d+)\s*",rhs) else "self_increment" if re.search(r"\b"+re.escape(n)+r"\s*[+-]\s*\d+",rhs) else "conditional_or_computed" if re.search(r"\b(?:if|and|or)\b|\?",rhs) else "computed"
            selected.append({"line":a.get("line"),"symbol":n,"rhs":rhs[:220],"kind":kind,"is_constant_target":kind=="constant"})
    return _json({"requested_symbol":sym,"writes":selected[:_arg(args,"top",1000)],"counts":dict(Counter(x["kind"] for x in selected)),"note":"Use the write map to find PC updates not covered by constant state edges."})


def _tool_vm_operand_equation_map(data,args):
    src=_source_text(data); scan=_masked_source(src); patterns={"byte_pack":r"[^\n;]{0,100}(?:\*\s*256|\*\s*65536|<<\s*8|<<\s*16)[^\n;]{0,100}","byte_unpack":r"[^\n;]{0,100}(?://\s*256|%\s*256|>>\s*8|>>\s*16|&\s*255)[^\n;]{0,100}","xor_mask":r"[^\n;]{0,100}(?:bxor|\^)[^\n;]{0,100}","rotate_or_combine":r"[^\n;]{0,100}(?:lrotate|rrotate|bor|band|bit32\.[A-Za-z_]+)[^\n;]{0,100}","signed_adjust":r"[^\n;]{0,100}(?:>=\s*128|>=\s*32768|[-+]\s*256|[-+]\s*65536)[^\n;]{0,100}"}; out={}
    for name,p in patterns.items(): out[name]=[{"line":_adv_line(src,m.start()),"expression":m.group(0).strip()[:240]} for m in re.finditer(p,scan,re.I)][:200]
    return _json({"equation_groups":out,"next_steps":["Record source byte offsets and widths.","Determine endianness and signedness from all reads.","Compare the same equation against known plaintext/bytecode samples.","Do not infer a format from one multiplication or mask alone."],"static_only":True})


def _tool_vm_fetch_decode_execute_map(data,args):
    src=_source_text(data); scan=_masked_source(src); groups={"fetch_bytes":r"\b(?:string\s*\.\s*byte|buffer\s*\.\s*read\w*|readu\w*|readbyte)\s*\(","advance_pc":r"\b(?:pc|ip|cursor|pos|offset)\s*(?:\+=\s*\d+|=\s*(?:pc|ip|cursor|pos|offset)\s*\+\s*\d+)","decode_ops":r"(?:\bbit32\s*\.\s*(?:band|bor|bxor|lshift|rshift)|%\s*256|//\s*256|>>\s*8|&\s*255)", "dispatch":r"\b(?:if|elseif)\s+[A-Za-z_]\w*\s*==\s*(?:0x[\da-fA-F]+|\d+)\s+then", "handler_tables":r"\b[A-Za-z_]\w*\s*\[\s*(?:opcode|op|pc|ip|state|[A-Za-z_]\w*)\s*\]"}; results=[]
    for group,p in groups.items():
        for m in re.finditer(p,scan,re.I): results.append({"phase":group,"line":_adv_line(src,m.start()),"offset":m.start(),"snippet":src[m.start():min(len(src),m.end()+100)].splitlines()[0][:180]})
    return _json({"candidate_sites":sorted(results,key=lambda x:x["offset"]),"phase_counts":dict(Counter(x["phase"] for x in results)),"note":"Offsets are source order, not proof of runtime order. Follow aliases and closures for an accurate fetch/decode/execute graph."})


def _tool_vm_handler_write_summary(data,args):
    rows=json.loads(_tool_vm_handler_feature_vectors(data,args)).get("handlers",[]); src=_source_text(data); scan=_masked_source(src); pat=re.compile(r"\b(?:if|elseif)\s+[A-Za-z_]\w*\s*==\s*(0x[\da-fA-F]+|\d+)\s+then"); out=[]
    for i,m in enumerate(pat.finditer(scan)):
        end=pat.search(scan,m.end()); tail=scan[m.end():end.start() if end else len(scan)]; first_end=re.search(r"\bend\b",tail); tail=tail[:first_end.start()] if first_end else tail[:1200]
        writes=re.findall(r"(?:\b([A-Za-z_]\w*)\s*(?:\[[^\]\n]+\])?\s*(?:=|\+=|-=|\*=|/=)|\b([A-Za-z_]\w*)\s*\[\s*([^\]]+)\s*\]\s*=(?!=))",tail)
        norm=[]
        for tup in writes:
            a,b,c=tup; norm.append((a or b, c.strip() if c else None))
        out.append({"opcode":int(m.group(1),0),"line":_adv_line(src,m.start()),"writes":sorted({(x,y) for x,y in norm if x}),"read_registers":sorted(set(re.findall(r"\bR\s*\[\s*([^\]]+)\s*\]",tail)))})
    return _json({"handlers":out[:_arg(args,"top",500)],"handler_count":len(out),"note":"Regex-based write set; property/index aliases and nested blocks can cause misses."})


def _tool_vm_register_liveness_hints(data,args):
    src=_source_text(data); scan=_masked_source(src); lines=src.splitlines(); rows=[]
    for i,(orig,clean) in enumerate(zip(lines,scan.splitlines()),1):
        if not re.search(r"\b(?:R|reg|registers|stack|S)\s*\[",clean): continue
        reads=[]; writes=[]
        for m in re.finditer(r"\b([A-Za-z_]\w*)\s*\[\s*([^\]\n]+)\s*\]\s*(=|\+=|-=|\*=|/=)?",clean):
            item={"table":m.group(1),"index":m.group(2).strip()}; (writes if m.group(3) else reads).append(item)
        rows.append({"line":i,"reads":reads,"writes":writes,"source":orig.strip()[:200]})
    return _json({"register_liveness_candidates":rows[:_arg(args,"top",1000)],"count":len(rows),"note":"Statement-level reads/writes; not backward dataflow liveness and not scope aware."})


def _tool_vm_array_remap_candidates(data,args):
    src=_source_text(data); scan=_masked_source(src); rows=[]

    pat=re.compile(r"\b(?:local\s+)?([A-Za-z_]\w*)\s*=\s*\{([^{}\n]{5,2000})\}")
    for m in pat.finditer(scan):
        fields=[x.strip() for x in m.group(2).split(",") if x.strip()]
        if len(fields)<6 or not all(re.fullmatch(r"(?:0x[\da-fA-F]+|\d+)",x) for x in fields): continue
        vals=[int(x,16) if x.lower().startswith("0x") else int(x,10) for x in fields]; lookups=[{"line":_adv_line(src,h.start()),"index":h.group(1)} for h in re.finditer(r"\b"+re.escape(m.group(1))+r"\s*\[\s*([^\]\n]+)\]",scan)]
        rows.append({"table":m.group(1),"line":_adv_line(src,m.start()),"length":len(vals),"unique_values":len(set(vals)),"is_bijective_0_n_minus_1":set(vals)==set(range(len(vals))),"min":min(vals),"max":max(vals),"lookups":lookups[:50],"first_values":vals[:100]})
    return _json({"numeric_array_candidates":rows[:_arg(args,"top",300)],"note":"A bijection can be a remap table but may also be ordinary data. Check indexing base and the raw opcode domain."})


def _tool_vm_basic_block_candidates(data,args):
    src=_source_text(data); lines=src.splitlines(); start=1; rows=[]; markers=[]
    for i,line in enumerate(lines,1):
        stripped=line.strip()
        if re.match(r"^(?:if\b|elseif\b|else\b|while\b|repeat\b|for\b|return\b|break\b|continue\b|until\b)",stripped): markers.append({"line":i,"kind":re.match(r"\w+",stripped).group(0),"text":stripped[:160]})
    boundaries=sorted({1,len(lines)+1}|{x["line"] for x in markers})
    for a,b in zip(boundaries,boundaries[1:]):
        chunk=lines[a-1:b-1]
        if any(x.strip() for x in chunk): rows.append({"start_line":a,"end_line":b-1,"line_count":len(chunk),"preview":" ".join(x.strip() for x in chunk[:4])[:240]})
    return _json({"candidate_blocks":rows[:_arg(args,"top",1000)],"control_markers":markers[:_arg(args,"top",1000)],"note":"Line-based basic-block candidates only; proper blocks require AST/bytecode branch targets."})


def _tool_control_flow_region_index(data,args):
    src=_source_text(data); toks=tokenize_lua(src); stack=[]; regions=[]; opener={"function":"function","if":"if","repeat":"repeat","do":"do"};

    for i,t in enumerate(toks):
        if t.value in ("function","if","repeat"): stack.append({"kind":t.value,"line":_adv_line(src,t.start),"offset":t.start,"depth":len(stack)+1})
        elif t.value=="do":
            prev=toks[i-1].value if i else ""
            if prev not in ("then","else","elseif","do"): stack.append({"kind":"do","line":_adv_line(src,t.start),"offset":t.start,"depth":len(stack)+1})
        elif t.value=="until":
            idx=next((j for j in range(len(stack)-1,-1,-1) if stack[j]["kind"]=="repeat"),None)
            if idx is not None:
                st=stack.pop(idx); regions.append({**st,"end_line":_adv_line(src,t.start),"end_offset":t.end,"closed_by":"until","balanced":True})
        elif t.value=="end":
            if stack:
                st=stack.pop(); regions.append({**st,"end_line":_adv_line(src,t.start),"end_offset":t.end,"closed_by":"end","balanced":True})
    for st in stack: regions.append({**st,"end_line":None,"end_offset":None,"closed_by":None,"balanced":False})
    return _json({"regions":sorted(regions,key=lambda x:x["offset"]),"region_count":len(regions),"unclosed_count":sum(not x["balanced"] for x in regions),"note":"Heuristic region pairing, not a full Luau parser; compound type syntax can affect results."})


def _tool_control_flow_exit_analysis(data,args):
    src=_source_text(data); scan=_masked_source(src); patterns={"return":r"\breturn\b","break":r"\bbreak\b","continue":r"\bcontinue\b","error_calls":r"\berror\s*\(","assert_calls":r"\bassert\s*\(","infinite_loops":r"\bwhile\s+(?:true|1)\s+do"}; out={}
    for kind,p in patterns.items(): out[kind]=[{"line":_adv_line(src,m.start()),"context":src[max(0,m.start()-90):min(len(src),m.end()+100)].splitlines()[0][:220]} for m in re.finditer(p,scan)][:300]
    return _json({"exit_and_termination_sites":out,"counts":{k:len(v) for k,v in out.items()},"note":"Return/error sites and literal infinite loops are indications, not proof that a path is reachable."})


def _tool_control_flow_condition_truth_table(data,args):
    src=_source_text(data); scan=_masked_source(src); rows=[]; pat=re.compile(r"\b(?:if|elseif)\s+(not\s+)?(nil|false|true|0[xX][0-9a-fA-F]+|\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s+then")
    for m in pat.finditer(scan):
        raw=m.group(2); base=False if raw in ("nil","false") else True; truth=not base if m.group(1) else base
        rows.append({"line":_adv_line(src,m.start()),"literal":raw,"negated":bool(m.group(1)),"luau_truthy":base,"condition_truth":truth,"note":"0 is truthy in Lua/Luau"})
    return _json({"literal_condition_sites":rows[:_arg(args,"top",1000)],"count":len(rows),"note":"Only simple literal conditions are evaluated; compound expressions are left alone."})


def _tool_dataflow_taint_paths(data,args):
    src=_source_text(data); lines=src.splitlines(); masked=_masked_source(src).splitlines(); sources=re.compile(r"\b(?:HttpGet|GetAsync|PostAsync|request|http_request|readfile|readclipboard|downloadstring)\s*(?:\.|\()",re.I); sinks=re.compile(r"\b(?:loadstring|load|require|writefile|FireServer|InvokeServer)\s*\(",re.I); deps=defaultdict(set); tainted=set(); rows=[]
    for i,(line,clean) in enumerate(zip(lines,masked),1):
        ass=re.match(r"\s*(?:local\s+)?([A-Za-z_]\w*)\s*=(?!=)\s*(.*)",clean)
        if ass:
            lhs,rhs=ass.groups(); deps[lhs].update(re.findall(r"\b[A-Za-z_]\w*\b",rhs))
            if sources.search(rhs): tainted.add(lhs); rows.append({"line":i,"event":"source_assignment","variable":lhs,"expression":line.strip()[:200]})
    changed=True
    while changed:
        changed=False
        for lhs,refs in deps.items():
            if lhs not in tainted and refs & tainted: tainted.add(lhs); changed=True
    for i,(line,clean) in enumerate(zip(lines,masked),1):
        if sinks.search(clean):
            refs=sorted(set(re.findall(r"\b[A-Za-z_]\w*\b",clean)) & tainted)
            rows.append({"line":i,"event":"sink_call","tainted_identifiers":refs,"possible_tainted_flow":bool(refs),"expression":line.strip()[:220]})
    return _json({"tainted_variable_candidates":sorted(tainted),"source_sink_events":rows[:_arg(args,"top",500)],"method":"Conservative line-local identifier propagation. This is a triage aid, not proof of a semantic dataflow path."})


def _tool_decompiler_output_audit(data,args):
    src=_source_text(data); clean=_masked_source(src); toks=tokenize_lua(src); bracket=_tool_check_brackets(data,args) if "_tool_check_brackets" in globals() else "unavailable"; blocks=_tool_check_blocks(data,args) if "_tool_check_blocks" in globals() else "unavailable"; patterns={"placeholder_names":r"\b(?:L_[0-9]+|v[0-9]+|var_[0-9]+|UNKNOWN_[A-Z0-9_]*)\b","unknown_intrinsics":r"\b(?:DECOMPILER_ERROR|UNRESOLVED_OPCODE|UNKNOWN_OPCODE|TODO_DECOMPILER)\b","large_numeric_literals":r"\b\d{8,}\b","suspicious_goto_labels":r"\b(?:goto|::[A-Za-z_]\w*::)\b"}; findings={k:[{"line":_adv_line(src,m.start()),"text":m.group(0)} for m in re.finditer(p,clean,re.I)][:300] for k,p in patterns.items()}
    return _json({"bytes":len(data),"lines":len(src.splitlines()),"tokens":len(toks),"identifier_count":sum(t.kind=="identifier" for t in toks),"string_count":sum(t.kind=="string" for t in toks),"findings":findings,"bracket_check":bracket,"block_check":blocks,"quality_score_not_probability":max(0,100-min(100,sum(len(v) for v in findings.values())*3+(0 if str(bracket).startswith("OK:") else 10)+(0 if str(blocks).startswith("OK:") else 10))),"note":"A heuristic quality audit; use luau-compile/luau-analyze or a parser to verify syntax and semantics. It does not run the recovered source."})


def _tool_luau_symbol_reference_index(data,args):
    src=_source_text(data); toks=tokenize_lua(src); uses=defaultdict(list); defs=defaultdict(list); decl_words={"local","function","for","type","export"}
    for i,t in enumerate(toks):
        if t.kind!="identifier": continue
        line=_adv_line(src,t.start); prev=toks[i-1].value if i else ""; nxt=toks[i+1].value if i+1<len(toks) else ""
        row={"line":line,"offset":t.start,"next_token":nxt,"previous_token":prev}
        if prev in decl_words or (nxt=="=" and prev in ("local",)) : defs[t.value].append(row)
        else: uses[t.value].append(row)
    names=set(uses)|set(defs); out=[]
    for name in sorted(names,key=lambda n:(-(len(uses[n])+len(defs[n])),n))[:_arg(args,"top",1000)]:
        out.append({"name":name,"definition_sites":defs[name][:30],"reference_sites":uses[name][:100],"definitions":len(defs[name]),"references":len(uses[name]),"possible_unbound_reference":len(defs[name])==0 and bool(uses[name])})
    return _json({"symbol_count":len(names),"symbols":out,"note":"Lexical reference index only; identifier reuse, nested scopes and member fields need AST-aware resolution."})


def _tool_luau_token_anomaly_report(data,args):
    src=_source_text(data); toks=tokenize_lua(src,include_comments=True); issues=[]; stack=[]; pairs={")":"(","]":"[","}":"{"}
    for t in toks:
        if t.kind=="string":
            s=t.value
            if s.startswith(("'''","\"\"\"")): continue
            if s.startswith("["):
                m=re.match(r"\[(=*)\[",s)
                if m and not s.endswith("]"+m.group(1)+"]"): issues.append({"kind":"unterminated_long_string","line":_adv_line(src,t.start),"offset":t.start})
            elif len(s)<2 or s[-1]!=s[0]: issues.append({"kind":"unterminated_quoted_string","line":_adv_line(src,t.start),"offset":t.start})
        if t.kind!="comment" and t.value in ("(","[","{"): stack.append(t)
        elif t.kind!="comment" and t.value in pairs:
            if not stack or stack[-1].value!=pairs[t.value]: issues.append({"kind":"mismatched_closer","token":t.value,"line":_adv_line(src,t.start),"offset":t.start})
            else: stack.pop()
    issues.extend({"kind":"unclosed_opener","token":t.value,"line":_adv_line(src,t.start),"offset":t.start} for t in stack)
    return _json({"token_count":len(toks),"anomalies":issues,"anomaly_count":len(issues),"note":"Lexical checks; long comments/strings and type syntax can create false positives. Use a grammar parser for final validation."})


def _tool_vm_binary_word_histogram(data,args):
    words=[]
    for endian in ("little","big"):
        vals=[]
        for i in range(0,len(data)-3,4): vals.append(int.from_bytes(data[i:i+4],endian))
        opcode=Counter(v&255 for v in vals); top=Counter(v>>24 for v in vals)
        words.append({"endianness_hypothesis":endian,"complete_u32_words":len(vals),"low_byte_histogram":opcode.most_common(64),"high_byte_histogram":top.most_common(32),"unique_words":len(set(vals)),"unique_low_bytes":len(opcode),"most_common_words":[{"word":f"0x{k:08X}","count":v} for k,v in Counter(vals).most_common(30)]})
    return _json({"input_bytes":len(data),"sha256":hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),"hypotheses":words,"caution":"This is an exploratory histogram, not a Luau bytecode parser; serialized chunk version and AUX instruction layout matter."})


def _tool_compare_disassembly_similarity(data,args):
    other=_arg(args,"against",None)
    if not other: raise ValueError("provide second disassembly path with --against")
    b=Path(other).read_bytes(); a_text=get_text(data); b_text=get_text(b)
    def opcodes(s): return re.findall(r"(?im)^\s*(?:\d+\s*[:.]?\s*)?([A-Z][A-Z0-9_]{1,40})\b",s)
    aa=opcodes(a_text); bb=opcodes(b_text); ratio=difflib.SequenceMatcher(a=aa,b=bb,autojunk=False).ratio(); ca=Counter(aa); cb=Counter(bb)
    return _json({"left_bytes":len(data),"right_bytes":len(b),"opcode_candidates_left":len(aa),"opcode_candidates_right":len(bb),"sequence_similarity":round(ratio,6),"only_left":dict((ca-cb).most_common(100)),"only_right":dict((cb-ca).most_common(100)),"left_sha256":hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),"right_sha256":hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest(),"note":"Requires text disassemblies; mnemonic extraction is heuristic and equal opcode sequences do not establish semantic equivalence."})

def _tool_vm_data_structure_rank(data,args):
    candidates=json.loads(_tool_opcode_byte_candidates(data,args)).get("candidates",[]); tables=json.loads(_tool_vm_register_access_map(data,args)).get("tables",[]); src=_source_text(data); scan=_masked_source(src); ranked=[]
    for t in tables:
        name=t.get("table",""); refs=len(re.findall(r"\b"+re.escape(name)+r"\s*\[",scan)); nums=len(re.findall(r"\b"+re.escape(name)+r"\s*=\s*\{[^{}]*\d+",scan)); score=min(100,refs*4+t.get("reads",0)*3+t.get("writes",0)*5+nums*10)
        ranked.append({"name":name,"score":score,"indexed_refs":refs,"reads":t.get("reads",0),"writes":t.get("writes",0),"numeric_initializer_hint":bool(nums)})
    ranked.sort(key=lambda x:(-x["score"],x["name"]))
    return _json({"likely_vm_tables":ranked[:_arg(args,"top",200)],"numeric_array_candidates":candidates[:100],"heuristic":"Rank used for triage only. A high score does not distinguish VM registers from game-state or ordinary application tables."})


def _tool_upstream_tool_recommendation(data,args):
    src=_source_text(data); probe=json.loads(_tool_bytecode_input_probe(data,args)); profile=json.loads(_tool_obfuscator_family_diff(data,args)); arch=json.loads(_tool_vm_architecture_report(data,args)); binary=printable_ratio(data)<0.72 or probe.get("kind_guess","") in ("base64-text wrapping binary/text payload","hex-text wrapping binary payload","Lua-family binary chunk signature (verify runtime/version)","Roblox binary model signature candidate")
    if binary: plan=["Probe and normalize the input without modifying the original.","Try PumbaaDev info/disassembly/decompile; check its documented bytecode-version support.","Compare with Unluau or luauDec when installed.","Run official luau-analyze/luau-compile on recovered source as static validation."]
    elif profile.get("profiles",{}).get("luraph",{}).get("score",0)>=35: plan=["Compare static evidence against the exact Luraph version profile.","Review a version-specific research project and its license/dependencies.","Use static lifting first; do not assume generic regex detects the version.","Compare recovered strings, constants and CFG evidence across intermediate stages."]
    elif arch.get("likely_state_variable"): plan=["Run vm-fetch-decode-execute-map and vm-state-transition-matrix.","Index handler features; cluster duplicate candidates without merging them automatically.","Derive operand widths, signedness and opcode remapping from evidence.","Build and annotate a StaticVMIR skeleton before implementing a lifter."]
    else: plan=["Run full-static-pipeline and auto-decode on copies.","Extract literals, tables, calls and dynamic loader dataflow.","If results remain ordinary source, use parser/compiler diagnostics before VM-specific analysis."]
    return _json({"input_kind":"binary_or_nontext" if binary else "source_like","family_hypotheses":profile.get("ranked_hypotheses",[])[:4],"likely_state_variable":arch.get("likely_state_variable"),"recommended_sequence":plan,"note":"Recommendation is evidence-driven triage, not a prediction that decompilation will succeed."})

def _tool_external_decompiler_full_diff(data,args):
    import shutil
    inp=_arg(args,"input",None)
    if not inp or inp=="-": raise ValueError("provide a named Luau bytecode file")
    tools={"pumbaa":(shutil.which("luau-decompiler"),["{exe}",inp]),"unluau":(shutil.which("unluau"),["{exe}",inp])}; reports={}; full={}
    for name,(exe,tmpl) in tools.items():
        if not exe: reports[name]={"available":False,"reason":"CLI not found in PATH"}; continue
        cmd=[exe,*tmpl[1:]]
        try: proc=subprocess.run(cmd,capture_output=True,timeout=max(2,min(_arg(args,"timeout",90),300)),check=False)
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired: reports[name]={"available":True,"command":cmd,"error":"timeout"}; continue
        output=proc.stdout.decode("utf-8",errors="replace")
        if proc.returncode==0 and output.strip(): full[name]=output
        reports[name]={"available":True,"command":cmd,"returncode":proc.returncode,"stdout_bytes":len(proc.stdout),"stdout_sha256":hashlib.sha256(proc.stdout).hexdigest(),"output_preview":output[:1000],"stderr_preview":proc.stderr.decode("utf-8",errors="replace")[:1500]}
    diffs=None; similarity=None
    if "pumbaa" in full and "unluau" in full:
        a=tokenize_lua(full["pumbaa"]); b=tokenize_lua(full["unluau"]); aa=[x.kind+":"+x.value for x in a]; bb=[x.kind+":"+x.value for x in b]; similarity=round(difflib.SequenceMatcher(a=aa,b=bb,autojunk=False).ratio(),6)
        diffs=list(difflib.unified_diff(full["pumbaa"].splitlines(),full["unluau"].splitlines(),fromfile="pumbaa",tofile="unluau",lineterm=""))[:max(20,min(_arg(args,"top",300),2000))]
    return _json({"input_path":inp,"engines":reports,"full_output_token_similarity":similarity,"unified_diff_limited":diffs,"comparison_note":"Similarity uses full stdout when both tools succeeded in producing text. A diff is diagnostic only; neither decompiler's output is guaranteed semantically correct."})


def _tool_vm_opcode_remap_reconstructor(data,args):
    src=_source_text(data); scan=_masked_source(src); rows=[]
    pat=re.compile(r"\b(?:local\s+)?([A-Za-z_]\w*)\s*=\s*\{([^{}\n]{5,5000})\}")
    for m in pat.finditer(scan):
        raw=[x.strip() for x in m.group(2).split(",") if x.strip()]
        if len(raw)<5 or not all(re.fullmatch(r"(?:0x[\da-fA-F]+|\d+)",x) for x in raw): continue
        vals=[int(x,16) if x.lower().startswith("0x") else int(x,10) for x in raw]
        lo,hi=min(vals),max(vals); isperm=len(set(vals))==len(vals) and (set(vals)==set(range(len(vals))) or set(vals)==set(range(lo,hi+1)))
        if not isperm and len(set(vals))<len(vals)*0.75: continue
        forward=[{"table_index_1based":i+1,"table_index_0based":i,"mapped_value":v} for i,v in enumerate(vals)]
        inverse={str(v):i for i,v in enumerate(vals)} if len(set(vals))==len(vals) else None
        rows.append({"table":m.group(1),"line":_adv_line(src,m.start()),"length":len(vals),"min_value":lo,"max_value":hi,"unique":len(set(vals)),"candidate_permutation":isperm,"forward_map":forward[:_arg(args,"top",256)],"inverse_map":inverse,"uses":len(re.findall(r"\b"+re.escape(m.group(1))+r"\s*\[",scan))})
    rows.sort(key=lambda x:(not x["candidate_permutation"],-x["length"],-x["uses"]))
    return _json({"candidate_opcode_maps":rows[:_arg(args,"top",100)],"count":len(rows),"note":"Map direction depends on how the table is indexed and consumed. Inverse map is a hypothesis until verified against decoder use sites."})


def _tool_vm_control_flow_paths(data,args):
    obj=json.loads(_tool_vm_state_transitions(data,args)); graph=defaultdict(list); states=set(obj.get("states",[]))
    for e in obj.get("edges",[]):
        if e.get("to") is not None: graph[e["from"]].append(e["to"]); states.update((e["from"],e["to"]))
    max_depth=max(1,min(_arg(args,"depth",6),12)); max_paths=max(1,min(_arg(args,"top",100),1000)); paths=[]; truncated=False
    for start in sorted(states):
        stack=[(start,[start])]
        while stack:
            node,path=stack.pop()
            nxt=graph.get(node,[])
            if not nxt or len(path)>=max_depth:
                paths.append({"start":start,"path":path,"terminal":"dead_end" if not nxt else "depth_limit"})
                if len(paths)>=max_paths: truncated=True; break
                continue
            for target in reversed(nxt):
                if target in path:
                    paths.append({"start":start,"path":path+[target],"terminal":"cycle"})
                    if len(paths)>=max_paths: truncated=True; break
                else: stack.append((target,path+[target]))
            if len(paths)>=max_paths: break
        if len(paths)>=max_paths: break
    return _json({"max_depth":max_depth,"path_count":len(paths),"paths":paths,"truncated":truncated,"note":"Enumerates only statically visible constant state edges. Dynamic state writes and conditions may add or remove paths."})


def _tool_vm_dispatch_pseudocode(data,args):
    handlers=json.loads(_tool_vm_handler_feature_vectors(data,args)).get("handlers",[]); trans=json.loads(_tool_vm_state_transitions(data,args)); state=trans.get("state_variable") or "state"; lines=["-- Candidate outline only: verify before treating it as recovered Luau.","while true do",f"    local instruction = fetch_decode_step() -- TODO: recover PC update and operands",f"    local opcode = normalize_opcode(instruction) -- TODO: verify any remap", "    if false then -- placeholder branch anchor; handlers below are evidence summaries"]
    for h in handlers[:_arg(args,"top",200)]: lines.append(f"    elseif opcode == {h['opcode']} then -- source line {h['line']}; tables={','.join(h['tables_touched'][:4])}; ops={''.join(h['operators'][:8])}; calls={','.join(h['calls'][:4])}")
    lines.extend(["    else", "        -- Unknown opcode: do not guess its semantics", "    end",f"    -- State candidate: {state}; inspect transitions separately", "end"])
    return "\n".join(lines)+"\n"


def _tool_string_decoder_dependency_graph(data,args):
    src=_source_text(data); scan=_masked_source(src); funcs=json.loads(_tool_extract_functions(data,args)).get("functions",[]); rows=[]
    decode=re.compile(r"(?:decode|decrypt|unpack|decode64|base64|xor|cipher|unscramble|inflate)",re.I)
    for f in funcs:
        name=f.get("name","<anonymous>"); start=f.get("offset",0); body=src[start:start+max(0,f.get("end_offset",start)-start)]
        calls=sorted(set(re.findall(r"\b([A-Za-z_]\w*(?:\.[A-Za-z_]\w*)*)\s*\(",_masked_source(body))))
        rows.append({"function":name,"line":f.get("line"),"looks_decoder_related":bool(decode.search(name+" "+body[:300])),"calls":calls[:80],"returns_string_builder":bool(re.search(r"string\s*\.\s*(?:char|reverse|sub|gsub|format)|table\s*\.\s*concat|buffer\s*\.\s*read",body,re.I))})
    edges=[]; names={r["function"] for r in rows}
    for r in rows:
        for called in r["calls"]:
            if called in names: edges.append({"caller":r["function"],"callee":called})
    return _json({"functions":rows[:_arg(args,"top",500)],"call_edges":edges[:_arg(args,"top",1000)],"decoder_name_candidates":[r["function"] for r in rows if r["looks_decoder_related"]],"note":"Function body extraction inherits lexical parser limitations; anonymous functions and scoped names can be misattributed."})


def _tool_control_flow_opaque_predicate_candidates(data,args):
    src=_source_text(data); scan=_masked_source(src); patterns={"always_true_numeric":r"\b(?:if|elseif)\s*\(?\s*(?:1\s*==\s*1|0\s*==\s*0|\d+\s*~=\s*\d+)\s*\)?\s*then","always_false_numeric":r"\b(?:if|elseif)\s*\(?\s*(?:1\s*==\s*0|0\s*==\s*1|2\s*==\s*3|3\s*==\s*4)\s*\)?\s*then","self_canceling":r"\b(?:if|elseif)\s+\(?\s*([A-Za-z_]\w*)\s*-\s*\1\s*==\s*0\s*\)?\s*then","modulo_zero_or_one":r"\b(?:if|elseif)\s+[^\n;]{0,80}%\s*1\s*==\s*0\s+then"}; out={}
    for kind,pat in patterns.items():
        try: out[kind]=[{"line":_adv_line(src,m.start()),"expression":src[m.start():min(len(src),m.end()+100)].splitlines()[0][:180]} for m in re.finditer(pat,scan,re.I)][:200]
        except re.error: out[kind]=[]
    return _json({"opaque_predicate_candidates":out,"note":"These patterns are candidates only; side effects, coercions and Luau semantics can invalidate simplification. Nothing is rewritten by this command."})

def _v4_redact(s):
    s=str(s)
    s=re.sub(r'(?i)(https?://(?:canary\.)?discord(?:app)?\.com/api/webhooks/\d+/)[^\s"\'<>`?#]+', r'\1[REDACTED_TOKEN]', s)
    s=re.sub(r'(?i)(https?://(?:canary\.)?discord(?:app)?\.com/api/v\d+/webhooks/\d+/)[^\s"\'<>`?#]+', r'\1[REDACTED_TOKEN]', s)
    s=re.sub(r'(?i)(https?://[^\s"\'<>`]*webhook[^\s"\'<>`]*/)[^\s"\'<>`?#]+', r'\1[REDACTED]', s)
    s=re.sub(r'(?i)(authorization\s*[:=]\s*)(?:bearer\s+)?[^\s,;"\']+', r'\1[REDACTED]', s)
    s=re.sub(r'(?i)([?&](?:token|key|secret|auth|api_key|apikey)=)[^&\s"\']+', r'\1[REDACTED]', s)
    return s


def _v4_pattern_hits(src, scan, patterns, raw_patterns=()):
    hits={}
    for name, pat in patterns.items():
        out=[]
        target=src if name in raw_patterns else scan
        try:
            for m in re.finditer(pat,target,re.I|re.M):
                line=_adv_line(src,m.start())
                preview=src[m.start():min(len(src),m.start()+180)].splitlines()[0][:180]
                out.append({"line":line,"preview":_v4_redact(preview)})
                if len(out)>=150: break
        except re.error as exc:
            out=[{"error":str(exc)}]
        hits[name]=out
    return hits


def _tool_luraph_version_fingerprint(data,args):
    src=_source_text(data); scan=_masked_source(src); raw=get_text(data)
    patterns={
      "explicit_version":r"(?:Luraph|LPH)\s*(?:Obfuscator)?\s*(?:v|version\s*)?(\d{1,2}\.\d+(?:\.\d+)?)",
      "lph_macro_family":r"\bLPH_(?:ENCSTR|ENCFUNC|CRASH|NO_VIRTUALIZE|JIT|VM|OBFUSCATED|PROTECT)[A-Z0-9_]*\b",
      "vm_state_dispatch":r"\b(?:if|elseif)\s+[A-Za-z_]\w*\s*==\s*(?:0x[\da-f]+|\d+)\s+then",
      "bitwise_decode_ops":r"\b(?:bit32|bit)\s*\.\s*(?:bxor|band|bor|rshift|lshift|extract|replace)\s*\(",
      "prototype_layout_terms":r"\b(?:prototype|prototypes|upvalues|constants|closure|deserialize|instruction)\b",
      "anti_tamper_terms":r"\b(?:anti.?tamper|integrity.?check|crash.?trap|tamper|debug\.info)\b",
      "large_numeric_tables":r"\{\s*(?:\[\s*[^]]+\s*\]\s*=|(?:0x[\da-f]+|\d+)\s*,\s*(?:0x[\da-f]+|\d+)\s*,)",
    }
    hits=_v4_pattern_hits(src,scan,patterns,raw_patterns=("explicit_version",))
    explicit=[]
    for h in hits.get("explicit_version",[]):
        m=re.search(r"(\d{1,2}\.\d+(?:\.\d+)?)",h.get("preview",""))
        if m: explicit.append(m.group(1))
    n=sum(len(v) for k,v in hits.items() if k!="explicit_version")
    score=min(100,35*bool(explicit)+10*bool(hits["lph_macro_family"])+min(20,len(hits["vm_state_dispatch"])*2)+min(12,len(hits["bitwise_decode_ops"])*2)+min(8,len(hits["prototype_layout_terms"]))+min(10,len(hits["anti_tamper_terms"])*2)+min(5,len(hits["large_numeric_tables"])))
    return _json({"profile":"Luraph version fingerprint","sha256":hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),"explicit_version_candidates":sorted(set(explicit)),"heuristic_score":score,"evidence":hits,"classification":"explicit version marker present; independently verify" if explicit else "Luraph-like structure only" if score>=30 else "insufficient specific evidence","important":"A source fingerprint cannot prove a release. v15.1 needs a version-specific decoder; use UPSTREAM_TOOL_CATALOG.txt for current research links."})

    return _json({"profile":"WeAreDevs/Prometheus candidate scan","heuristic_score":score,"evidence":hits,"classification":"explicit label" if hits["explicit_name"] else "compatible loader/string patterns" if score>=30 else "not enough evidence","upstream":["https://github.com/hutaoshusband/WeAreDevs-Deobfuscator","https://github.com/rconsoIe/wearedevs-deobfuscate"],"safe_route":"Prefer static string extraction.
