def _tool_http_spy_static(data,args):
    src=_source_text(data); scan=_masked_source(src)
    patterns={"roblox_http":r"\b(?:HttpGet|HttpPost|GetAsync|PostAsync|RequestAsync)\s*\(","executor_http":r"\b(?:http_request|request|syn\s*\.\s*request|http\s*\.\s*request)\s*\(","websocket":r"\b(?:WebSocket|WebSocketService|connectAsync|ConnectAsync)\b","url_literals":r"https?://[^\s\"'<>`]+","dynamic_loader_near_network":r"\b(?:loadstring|load)\s*\("}
    hits=_v4_pattern_hits(src,scan,patterns,raw_patterns=("url_literals",))
    urls=[]
    for m in re.finditer(patterns["url_literals"],src,re.I):
        u=_v4_redact(m.group(0).rstrip(",);]}"))
        item={"line":_adv_line(src,m.start()),"url_redacted":u}
        if item not in urls: urls.append(item)
    callsites=[]
    for name,pat in list(patterns.items())[:3]+[("dynamic_loader_near_network",patterns["dynamic_loader_near_network"])]:
        for m in re.finditer(pat,scan,re.I):
            line=_adv_line(src,m.start()); snippet=_v4_redact(src[max(0,src.rfind('\n',0,m.start())+1):src.find('\n',m.start()) if src.find('\n',m.start())>=0 else len(src)].strip()[:220])
            callsites.append({"kind":name,"line":line,"source_preview":snippet})
    return _json({"analysis_mode":"static source scan only; no live interception, networking, or source execution","http_callsite_count":len(callsites),"callsites":callsites[:_arg(args,"top",500)],"urls_redacted":urls[:_arg(args,"top",500)],"url_count":len(urls),"note":"Dynamic URL construction and aliases may not be recovered by lexical scanning."})


def _tool_webhook_spy_static(data,args):
    src=_source_text(data); scan=_masked_source(src); rows=[]
    patterns=[("discord_webhook",r"https?://(?:canary\.)?discord(?:app)?\.com/api/webhooks/\d+/[^\s\"'<>`?#]+"),("discord_webhook_v",r"https?://(?:canary\.)?discord(?:app)?\.com/api/v\d+/webhooks/\d+/[^\s\"'<>`?#]+"),("slack_webhook",r"https?://hooks\.slack\.com/services/[^\s\"'<>`?#]+"),("generic_webhook",r"https?://[^\s\"'<>`]*webhook[^\s\"'<>`]*")]
    for kind,pat in patterns:
        for m in re.finditer(pat,src,re.I):
            rows.append({"kind":kind,"line":_adv_line(src,m.start()),"indicator":_v4_redact(m.group(0)),"secret_material_returned":False})
    for m in re.finditer(r"(?i)\b(?:webhook|discordWebhook|hookUrl)\b",scan):
        rows.append({"kind":"webhook_symbol","line":_adv_line(src,m.start()),"indicator":"symbol/reference; value not displayed","secret_material_returned":False})
    rows.sort(key=lambda x:(x["line"],x["kind"]))
    unique=[]; seen=set()
    for x in rows:
        k=(x["kind"],x["line"],x["indicator"])
        if k not in seen: seen.add(k); unique.append(x)
    return _json({"analysis_mode":"static; token values are always redacted","indicators":unique[:_arg(args,"top",500)],"count":len(unique),"remediation":"If a real webhook token was exposed, rotate/delete it at the provider. Do not send requests to unknown webhooks during analysis."})


def _tool_env_api_map(data,args):
    src=_source_text(data); scan=_masked_source(src)
    apis={"environment_read":r"\b(?:getgenv|getfenv|_G|shared|_ENV)\b","environment_write":r"\b(?:setfenv|rawset)\s*\(|\b(?:_G|shared|_ENV)\s*\[[^]]+\]\s*=","debug_introspection":r"\bdebug\s*\.\s*(?:info|getinfo|traceback|getregistry)\s*\(|\bgetreg\s*\(","executor_identity":r"\b(?:identifyexecutor|checkcaller|isexecutorclosure|isourclosure)\s*\(","garbage_collector_introspection":r"\b(?:getgc|getinstances|getnilinstances|getloadedmodules)\s*\(","metatable_hooks":r"\b(?:hookfunction|hookmetamethod|newcclosure|getrawmetatable|setreadonly)\s*\(","environment_mutation":r"\b(?:setfenv|setmetatable|rawset)\s*\("}
    results={}
    for name,pat in apis.items():
        rows=[]
        for m in re.finditer(pat,scan,re.I):
            line=_adv_line(src,m.start()); line_text=src[max(0,src.rfind('\n',0,m.start())+1):src.find('\n',m.start()) if src.find('\n',m.start())>=0 else len(src)].strip()
            rows.append({"line":line,"preview":_v4_redact(line_text[:200])})
        results[name]=rows[:_arg(args,"top",500)]
    return _json({"analysis_mode":"static reference inventory only; no environment values are collected","api_groups":results,"total_sites":sum(len(v) for v in results.values()),"note":"Some names can be shadowed by local variables or comments/macros; this report does not invoke APIs."})


def _tool_env_log_plan(data,args):
    inv=json.loads(_tool_env_api_map(data,args)); net=json.loads(_tool_http_spy_static(data,args)); dyn=json.loads(_tool_runtime_side_effect_audit(data,args))
    recommendations=[]
    for group,rows in inv["api_groups"].items():
        if rows: recommendations.append({"category":group,"sites":len(rows),"lines":sorted(set(r["line"] for r in rows))[:100],"safe_logging_point":"record symbol name, argument types and source line only; avoid serializing environment values or secrets"})
    return _json({"mode":"static logger design plan; no logger code is injected","environment_points":recommendations,"network_calls":net["http_callsite_count"],"side_effect_flags":dyn["summary"],"safe_trace_schema":{"timestamp":"monotonic/UTC if added by a separate approved harness","event":"API name","source_line":"integer","argument_kinds":"types/count only","secret_values":"always redacted/not logged"},"recommendation":"Instrument only a local test harness with deny-by-default network and filesystem stubs. This command does not create a runtime spy or access a live executor."})


def _tool_network_callsite_map(data,args):
    http=json.loads(_tool_http_spy_static(data,args)); src=_source_text(data); scan=_masked_source(src)
    rows=[]
    for line in range(1,len(src.splitlines())+1):
        lo=sum(len(x)+1 for x in src.splitlines()[:line-1]); hi=lo+len(src.splitlines()[line-1])
        ln=scan[lo:hi]
        if re.search(r"\b(?:HttpGet|HttpPost|GetAsync|PostAsync|RequestAsync|http_request|request|loadstring|load)\s*\(",ln,re.I):
            rows.append({"line":line,"network":bool(re.search(r"\b(?:HttpGet|HttpPost|GetAsync|PostAsync|RequestAsync|http_request|request)\s*\(",ln,re.I)),"dynamic_sink":bool(re.search(r"\b(?:loadstring|load)\s*\(",ln,re.I)),"source_preview":_v4_redact(src[lo:hi].strip()[:180])})
    return _json({"rows":rows[:_arg(args,"top",500)],"rows_count":len(rows),"static_urls":http["urls_redacted"],"limitations":"Line-local correlation misses multi-line expressions, aliases and runtime-created URLs."})

    return _json({"webhook_indicators":h["count"],"http_callsite_count":n["http_callsite_count"],"redacted_webhook_rows":h["indicators"],"source_sink_candidates":d.get("paths",d.get("candidate_paths",[])),"no_requests_sent":True,"note":"Association is static and approximate; proximity in source does not prove the webhook receives a given value."})


def _tool_decoder_function_candidates(data,args):
    dep=json.loads(_tool_string_decoder_dependency_graph(data,args)); src=_source_text(data); scan=_masked_source(src)
    words=re.compile(r"(?:decode|decrypt|decipher|unpack|inflate|decompress|decode64|base64|xor|unscramble|unescape|fromhex|bytesTo|crypt)",re.I)
    hits=[]
    for f in dep.get("functions",[]):
        name=f.get("function","<anonymous>")
        if words.search(name) or f.get("looks_decoder_related") or f.get("returns_string_builder"):
            hits.append({"name":name,"line":f.get("line"),"calls":f.get("calls",[])[:30],"looks_decoder_related":f.get("looks_decoder_related"),"returns_string_builder":f.get("returns_string_builder")})
    ops={"bitwise":len(re.findall(r"\b(?:bit32|bit)\s*\.\s*(?:bxor|band|bor|bnot|lshift|rshift)\s*\(",scan,re.I)),"byte_reads":len(re.findall(r"(?:string\s*\.\s*byte|buffer\s*\.\s*read\w*)\s*\(",scan,re.I)),"byte_writes":len(re.findall(r"(?:string\s*\.\s*char|buffer\s*\.\s*write\w*)\s*\(",scan,re.I)),"compression_terms":len(re.findall(r"gzip|zlib|inflate|deflate|decompress|compress",scan,re.I))}
    return _json({"decoder_candidates":hits[:_arg(args,"top",500)],"operation_counts":ops,"dependencies":dep.get("call_edges",[])[:_arg(args,"top",1000)],"note":"Lexical candidate ranking only; validate function boundaries and data semantics before treating a candidate as the actual decoder."})


def _tool_custom_cipher_analyzer(data,args):
    src=_source_text(data); scan=_masked_source(src)
    pats={"xor":r"\b(?:bit32|bit)\s*\.\s*bxor\s*\(|\bxor\b|\^","and_mask":r"\b(?:bit32|bit)\s*\.\s*band\s*\(|&\s*(?:0x[\da-f]+|\d+)","shifts":r"\b(?:bit32|bit)\s*\.\s*(?:lshift|rshift)\s*\(|(?:<<|>>)\s*\d+","modulo_byte":r"%\s*256\b|%\s*0x100\b","byte_read":r"(?:string\s*\.\s*byte|buffer\s*\.\s*read\w*)\s*\(","byte_emit":r"(?:string\s*\.\s*char|buffer\s*\.\s*write\w*)\s*\(","arithmetic_mixer":r"\b(?:seed|key|state|acc|byte|value)\s*=\s*[^\n;]{0,120}(?:\*|\+|-|%)"}
    hits=_v4_pattern_hits(src,scan,pats)
    n=sum(len(x) for x in hits.values()); rank=[]
    if hits["xor"]: rank.append({"hypothesis":"XOR-based byte transform","evidence_count":len(hits["xor"])})
    if hits["shifts"] or hits["and_mask"]: rank.append({"hypothesis":"bitwise/masked arithmetic transform","evidence_count":len(hits["shifts"])+len(hits["and_mask"])})
    if hits["byte_read"] and hits["byte_emit"]: rank.append({"hypothesis":"byte-wise decoder/encoder","evidence_count":len(hits["byte_read"])+len(hits["byte_emit"])})
    if hits["arithmetic_mixer"]: rank.append({"hypothesis":"stateful arithmetic/multiplicative transform","evidence_count":len(hits["arithmetic_mixer"])})
    return _json({"transform_hypotheses":rank,"evidence":hits,"input_sha256":hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),"not_a_cipher_breaker":True,"next_steps":["Identify exact input/output variable for each transformation.","Record width, signedness, endianness, modulo and operation order.","Derive a test vector from a known plaintext/ciphertext pair if available.","Do not assume bit32 operations are equivalent across Lua versions without checking integer semantics."]})


def _tool_bytecode_container_detect(data,args):
    signatures=[("Lua 5.1 binary chunk",b"\x1bLua"),("gzip",b"\x1f\x8b"),("ZIP",b"PK\x03\x04"),("BZip2",b"BZh"),("XZ",b"\xfd7zXZ\x00"),("ELF",b"\x7fELF"),("PE/MZ",b"MZ"),("Mach-O BE",b"\xfe\xed\xfa\xce"),("Mach-O LE",b"\xce\xfa\xed\xfe"),("Mach-O 64 BE",b"\xfe\xed\xfa\xcf"),("Mach-O 64 LE",b"\xcf\xfa\xed\xfe")]
    matched=[{"format":name,"signature_hex":sig.hex(),"offset":data.find(sig)} for name,sig in signatures if data.find(sig)>=0 and data.find(sig)<64]
    zlib_guess=bool(data and (data[0]&0x0f)==8 and (data[0]>>4)<=7 and len(data)>2 and ((data[0]<<8)|data[1])%31==0)
    if zlib_guess: matched.append({"format":"zlib header candidate","signature_hex":data[:2].hex(),"offset":0})
    if not matched:
        matched=[{"format":"unknown/proprietary/raw bytecode candidate","signature_hex":data[:16].hex(),"offset":0}]
    return _json({"length":len(data),"sha256":hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),"signatures":matched,"first_64_bytes_hex":data[:64].hex(" "),"text_ratio":round(printable_ratio(data),4),"entropy":round(shannon_entropy(data),4),"note":"Luau/Roblox bytecode may be version-dependent and not have a universally recognizable standalone magic header. Use a format-aware decompiler's info command to validate."})


def _tool_bytecode_string_region_scan(data,args):
    ascii_hits=[]
    for m in re.finditer(rb"[\x20-\x7e]{%d,}" % max(3,_arg(args,"min_length",4)),data):
        val=m.group().decode("ascii","replace")
        ascii_hits.append({"offset":m.start(),"length":len(m.group()),"text_redacted":_v4_redact(val[:500]),"base64_like":bool(re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9+/]{16,}={0,2}",val)),"hex_like":bool(re.fullmatch(r"(?:[0-9a-fA-F]{2}){8,}",val))})
    utf16=[]
    for endian,pat in (("LE",rb"(?:[\x20-\x7e]\x00){%d,}" % max(3,_arg(args,"min_length",4))),("BE",rb"(?:\x00[\x20-\x7e]){%d,}" % max(3,_arg(args,"min_length",4)))):
        for m in re.finditer(pat,data):
            try: text=m.group().decode("utf-16"+endian.lower(),"replace")
            except Exception: continue
            utf16.append({"offset":m.start(),"length_bytes":len(m.group()),"endianness":endian,"text_redacted":_v4_redact(text[:300])})
    return _json({"sha256":hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),"ascii_regions":ascii_hits[:_arg(args,"top",1000)],"utf16_regions":utf16[:_arg(args,"top",500)],"counts":{"ascii":len(ascii_hits),"utf16":len(utf16)},"secrets":"known webhook/authorization patterns are redacted"})


def _tool_external_tool_matrix(data,args):
    import shutil
    commands={"luau-decompiler":"PumbaaDev offline Luau bytecode decompiler","unluau":"alternative Luau bytecode decompiler","luau-analyze":"official Luau static analyzer","luau-compile":"official Luau compiler","luau":"Luau VM CLI; do not use to execute unknown code","tree-sitter":"parser CLI; Luau grammar must be installed","luauDec":"C++ Luau bytecode decompiler, exact CLI may vary","dotnet":"runtime required by some IronBrew2 tools","lua5.1":"runtime used by some WeAreDevs mock dumper projects","node":"runtime used by some Luraph v15 research projects","cargo":"Rust build tool for PumbaaDev CLI"}
    out=[]
    for name,desc in commands.items(): out.append({"command":name,"available":bool(shutil.which(name)),"path":shutil.which(name),"purpose":desc})
    return _json({"commands":out,"checked":"PATH lookup only; nothing installed or launched","notes":["Some upstream repositories include their own binaries; inspect licenses and hashes.","Android/Termux support varies, especially .NET/C++/Rust builds.","Use offline samples and do not execute recovered source to validate it."]})


def _v4_require_explicit_external(args):
    if not _arg(args,"allow_external_execution",False):
        raise ValueError("This adapter launches a local upstream program. Review its source first, then pass --allow-external-execution explicitly.")


def _v4_named_input(args):
    inp=_arg(args,"input",None)
    if not inp or inp=="-": raise ValueError("provide a named input file, not stdin")
    p=Path(inp).expanduser().resolve()
    if not p.is_file(): raise ValueError(f"input file not found: {p}")
    return p


def _v4_pick_tool_path(args, candidates):
    val=_arg(args,"tool_path",None)
    if not val: raise ValueError("set --tool-path to an already-installed upstream CLI/script or repository root")
    p=Path(val).expanduser()
    if p.is_file(): return p.resolve()
    if p.is_dir():
        for rel in candidates:
            q=p/rel
            if q.is_file(): return q.resolve()
    raise ValueError("could not find expected CLI under --tool-path; pass the exact script/executable path")


def _v4_run_local(cmd, args, cwd=None, output_path=None):
    timeout=max(2,min(int(_arg(args,"timeout",60)),300))
    try: p=subprocess.run([str(x) for x in cmd],capture_output=True,timeout=timeout,check=False,cwd=str(cwd) if cwd else None)
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired: return {"launched":True,"command":list(map(str,cmd)),"timeout_seconds":timeout,"timed_out":True,"note":"Upstream timeout; partial output was not written."}
    stdout=p.stdout.decode("utf-8","replace"); stderr=p.stderr.decode("utf-8","replace")
    result={"launched":True,"command":list(map(str,cmd)),"returncode":p.returncode,"stdout_bytes":len(p.stdout),"stderr_bytes":len(p.stderr),"stdout_sha256":hashlib.sha256(p.stdout).hexdigest(),"stdout_preview_redacted":_v4_redact(stdout[:1800]),"stderr_preview_redacted":_v4_redact(stderr[:1800]),"input_execution_warning":"An upstream harness may execute/interpret the sample. Use a disposable offline VM/container with no secrets."}
    if output_path and Path(output_path).exists():
        q=Path(output_path); blob=q.read_bytes(); result["output_file"]={"path":str(q),"bytes":len(blob),"sha256":hashlib.sha256(blob).hexdigest()}
    return result


def _tool_luraph_cli_bridge(data,args):
    _v4_require_explicit_external(args); inp=_v4_named_input(args)
    cli=_v4_pick_tool_path(args,["Deobfuscator/deobf/cli.py","deobf/cli.py","cli.py"])
    out=_arg(args,"bridge_output",None)
    if not out: raise ValueError("set --bridge-output to the output source path; -o remains the LuauLab JSON report")
    import sys
    cmd=[sys.executable,str(cli),str(inp),"-o",str(Path(out).expanduser().resolve())]
    engine=_arg(args,"engine",None)
    if engine: cmd.extend(["--engine",str(engine)])
    res=_v4_run_local(cmd,args,cwd=cli.parent,output_path=out)
    return _json({"adapter":"Luraph research CLI","input":str(inp),"requested_engine":engine,"result":res,"caution":"Current public version-specific support is not equivalent to universal Luraph support. Runtime instrumentation can execute sample-controlled code."})


def _tool_ironbrew2_cli_bridge(data,args):
    _v4_require_explicit_external(args); inp=_v4_named_input(args)
    tool=_v4_pick_tool_path(args,["deobf.exe","IronbrewDeobfuscator.exe","deobf.dll","IronbrewDeobfuscator.dll","deobf"])
    out=_arg(args,"bridge_output",None)
    if not out: raise ValueError("set --bridge-output to the output file; -o remains the LuauLab JSON report")
    if tool.suffix.lower()==".dll": cmd=["dotnet",str(tool)]
    else: cmd=[str(tool)]
    cmd.extend(["-t","ib2","-f",str(inp),"-o",str(Path(out).expanduser().resolve())])
    res=_v4_run_local(cmd,args,cwd=tool.parent,output_path=out)
    return _json({"adapter":"IronBrew2 deobfuscator CLI","input":str(inp),"result":res,"upstream":"https://github.com/Lethal-Luka/IronbrewDeobfuscator","caution":"Upstream README says it targets latest IB2, and --enable-maxcflow is unstable. This adapter does not assume every build is supported."})


def _tool_wearedevs_static_extract(data,args):
    _v4_require_explicit_external(args); inp=_v4_named_input(args)
    tool=_v4_pick_tool_path(args,["src/extract_strings.py","tools/extract_strings.py","extract_strings.py"])
    import sys
    res=_v4_run_local([sys.executable,str(tool),str(inp)],args,cwd=tool.parent)
    return _json({"adapter":"WeAreDevs static string extractor","input":str(inp),"result":res,"mode":"static extractor selected; dynamic dumper is not launched","upstream":"https://github.com/hutaoshusband/WeAreDevs-Deobfuscator","note":"Repository may not declare a license; audit its exact contents before using or redistributing it."})


def _tool_luau_bytecode_cross_compare(data,args):
    _v4_require_explicit_external(args); inp=_v4_named_input(args)
    import shutil
    tools={"pumbaa":shutil.which("luau-decompiler"),"unluau":shutil.which("unluau")}
    outdir=_arg(args,"bridge_output",None)
    if not outdir: raise ValueError("set --bridge-output to an output directory for per-decompiler .txt outputs")
    od=Path(outdir).expanduser().resolve(); od.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True); rows={}; texts={}
    timeout=max(2,min(int(_arg(args,"timeout",60)),300))
    for name,exe in tools.items():
        if not exe: rows[name]={"available":False,"reason":"not found in PATH"}; continue
        cmd=[exe,str(inp)]
        try: p=subprocess.run(cmd,capture_output=True,timeout=timeout,check=False)
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired: rows[name]={"available":True,"timed_out":True}; continue
        txt=p.stdout.decode("utf-8","replace"); target=od/(name+"_decompiled.txt")
        if p.returncode==0 and txt.strip():
            target.write_text(txt,encoding="utf-8"); texts[name]=txt
        rows[name]={"available":True,"returncode":p.returncode,"output_path":str(target) if name in texts else None,"stdout_bytes":len(p.stdout),"stdout_sha256":hashlib.sha256(p.stdout).hexdigest(),"stderr_preview":_v4_redact(p.stderr.decode("utf-8","replace")[:1200])}
    similarity=None; diff=[]
    if len(texts)==2:
        a=[t.kind+":"+t.value for t in tokenize_lua(texts["pumbaa"])]; b=[t.kind+":"+t.value for t in tokenize_lua(texts["unluau"])]; similarity=round(difflib.SequenceMatcher(a=a,b=b,autojunk=False).ratio(),5)
        diff=list(difflib.unified_diff(texts["pumbaa"].splitlines(),texts["unluau"].splitlines(),fromfile="pumbaa",tofile="unluau",lineterm=""))[:max(20,min(_arg(args,"top",500),1500))]
    return _json({"input":str(inp),"tools":rows,"token_similarity":similarity,"diff_excerpt":diff,"note":"This is output comparison, not semantic equivalence. Official Luau compiler/analyzer checks should follow; no output source is executed."})


def _tool_obfuscator_profile_ensemble(data,args):
    funcs={"luraph":_tool_luraph_version_fingerprint,"ironbrew":_tool_ironbrew_profile_scan,"ironbrew2":_tool_ironbrew2_profile_scan,"wearedevs":_tool_wearedevs_profile_scan,"moonsec":_tool_moonsec_profile_scan,"prometheus":_tool_prometheus_profile_scan,"luarmor":_tool_luarmor_profile_scan,"veil":_tool_veil_profile_scan,"synapse_xen":_tool_synapse_xen_profile_scan}
    rows=[]
    for name,fn in funcs.items():
        try:
            obj=json.loads(fn(data,args)); score=obj.get("score",obj.get("heuristic_score",0)); rows.append({"family":name,"score":score,"explicit_markers":sum(1 for vals in obj.get("evidence",{}).values() if vals and any(any(k in str(v).lower() for k in [name.replace('_',' '),name.replace('_',''),"luraph","ironbrew","wearedevs","moonsec","prometheus","luarmor","veil","synapse"]) for v in vals))})
        except Exception as exc: rows.append({"family":name,"error":str(exc)})
    return _json({"ranked_profiles":sorted(rows,key=lambda x:x.get("score",0),reverse=True),"interpretation":"Scores are per-detector heuristics and are not directly comparable probabilities. Explicit names are much stronger than generic VM-shape indicators."})


def _tool_lua_format_signatures(data,args):
    obj=json.loads(_tool_bytecode_container_detect(data,args)); src=get_text(data); text_candidate=printable_ratio(data)>0.82
    indicators={"luau_keywords":len(re.findall(r"\b(?:local|function|return|elseif|continue|type|export)\b",src)),"binary_control_bytes":sum(1 for b in data[:4096] if b<9 or 13<b<32),"likely_base64_text":bool(re.fullmatch(rb"\s*[A-Za-z0-9+/\r\n]+={0,2}\s*",data)) and len(data)>24,"likely_hex_text":bool(re.fullmatch(rb"\s*(?:[0-9a-fA-F]{2}\s*){16,}",data))}
    return _json({"container_probe":obj,"text_like":text_candidate,"indicators":indicators,"next_recommendations":["For readable source: run detect-obfuscator and full-static-pipeline.","For raw bytecode: query an installed version-aware decompiler's info and disassemble commands.","For base64/hex text: decode to a separate stage file, hash it, then re-probe."]})


def _tool_runtime_side_effect_audit(data,args):
    src=_source_text(data); scan=_masked_source(src)
    pats={"network":r"\b(?:HttpGet|HttpPost|GetAsync|PostAsync|RequestAsync|http_request|request|WebSocketService)\b","filesystem_read":r"\b(?:readfile|readclipboard|isfile|isfolder|listfiles|readfolder)\s*\(","filesystem_write_delete":r"\b(?:writefile|appendfile|delfile|makefolder|delfolder)\s*\(","dynamic_code":r"\b(?:loadstring|load)\s*\(","module_load":r"\brequire\s*\(","executor_hooking":r"\b(?:hookfunction|hookmetamethod|newcclosure|setreadonly|getrawmetatable)\s*\(","environment_introspection":r"\b(?:getgenv|getfenv|setfenv|getgc|getreg|getinstances|debug\.info)\b","remote_side_effect":r"\b(?:FireServer|InvokeServer|Teleport|Kick|SetCore)\s*\("}
    h=_v4_pattern_hits(src,scan,pats); counts={k:len(v) for k,v in h.items()}; flags=[]
    for k,n in counts.items():
        if n: flags.append({"category":k,"sites":n,"severity":"high" if k in ("network","filesystem_write_delete","dynamic_code","executor_hooking") else "medium"})
    return _json({"summary":counts,"flags":flags,"analysis_mode":"static only; the source is not imported or executed","limitations":"Aliases, dynamically-built calls, metamethod dispatch, and encoded payloads may hide effects until later stages are recovered."})


def _tool_loader_path_map(data,args):
    src=_source_text(data); scan=_masked_source(src); rows=[]
    pats=[("network_source",r"\b(?:HttpGet|GetAsync|PostAsync|RequestAsync|http_request|request)\s*\("),("decode_transform",r"\b(?:base64decode|decode64|fromBase64|bxor|char|concat|reverse|decompress|inflate|gsub)\b"),("dynamic_sink",r"\b(?:loadstring|load|require)\s*\(")]
    for kind,pat in pats:
        for m in re.finditer(pat,scan,re.I): rows.append({"kind":kind,"line":_adv_line(src,m.start()),"preview":_v4_redact(src[m.start():min(len(src),m.start()+180)].splitlines()[0])})
    rows.sort(key=lambda x:x["line"])
    edges=[]
    for i,item in enumerate(rows):
        if item["kind"]=="dynamic_sink":
            prior=[x for x in rows[max(0,i-8):i] if x["kind"] in ("network_source","decode_transform")]
            edges.append({"sink_line":item["line"],"candidate_predecessors":prior[-5:],"confidence":"low-to-medium lexical proximity"})
    return _json({"sites":rows[:_arg(args,"top",1000)],"load_sinks":edges,"note":"This is a source-order dependency hint, not a verified def-use/taint analysis. Multi-line expressions and aliases require AST-based analysis."})


def _tool_string_layer_classifier(data,args):
    src=_source_text(data); strings=_string_tokens(src); rows=[]
    for offset, raw_value, val in strings[:_arg(args,"top",1000)]:
        stripped=val.strip(); kinds=[]
        if re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9+/\r\n]+={0,2}",stripped) and len(stripped)>=16: kinds.append("base64_candidate")
        if re.fullmatch(r"(?:[0-9a-fA-F]{2}){6,}",stripped): kinds.append("hex_candidate")
        if re.fullmatch(r"[0-9A-Za-z!#$%&()*+\-;<=>?@^_`{|}~]+",stripped) and len(stripped)>=20 and ("~" in stripped or "z" in stripped): kinds.append("base85/ascii85_candidate")
        if re.search(r"\\(?:x[0-9a-fA-F]{2}|u\{[0-9a-fA-F]+\}|\d{2,3})",raw_value): kinds.append("escaped_text")
        if re.search(r"(?:gzip|zlib|inflate|deflate|lzma|bz2|decompress)",val,re.I): kinds.append("compression_marker")
        if val and all(ch in string.hexdigits for ch in stripped) and len(stripped)>=16 and len(stripped)%2==0: kinds.append("hex_candidate")
        if kinds: rows.append({"line":_adv_line(src,offset),"length":len(val),"candidates":sorted(set(kinds)),"preview_redacted":_v4_redact(val[:120])})
    return _json({"candidate_strings":rows,"candidate_count":len(rows),"note":"Encoding labels are hypotheses. Random identifiers can resemble base-N, and compression cannot always be inferred from text alone."})


def _tool_cryptographic_transform_candidates(data,args):
    obj=json.loads(_tool_custom_cipher_analyzer(data,args)); hits=obj.get("evidence",{}); choices=[]
    for key,label in (("xor","single/repeating XOR; compare known plaintexts"),("shifts","bit-shifts and masks; record exact width and signedness"),("modulo_byte","byte normalization modulo 256"),("arithmetic_mixer","rolling arithmetic/key state; derive recurrence"),("byte_read","byte-oriented input transform"),("byte_emit","byte-oriented output transform")):
        if hits.get(key): choices.append({"transform":label,"evidence_count":len(hits[key])})
    return _json({"candidate_transforms":choices,"evidence":hits,"sha256":hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),"limits":"This is for custom obfuscation transforms and weak encodings. It does not break AES/ChaCha or other secure encryption without keys or a cryptographic flaw."})

    else: steps.extend(["Run bytecode-container-detect and record SHA-256.","Use a version-aware decompiler's info mode, then disassemble the input.","Compare two decompiler outputs when tools exist; manually verify branch targets and constants."])
    return _json({"input_guess":"source-like" if looks_text else "binary/encoded/unknown","tool_paths":avail,"recommended_steps":steps,"note":"Availability lookup only; this command runs no external tools."})

def _tool_crypto_algorithm_fingerprint(data, args):
    src = _source_text(data)
    scan = _masked_source(src)
    patterns = [
      ("base64/base32/base85", r"\b(?:base64|base32|base85|ascii85|b64decode|b32decode|fromBase64|decode64|decodeBase64)\b", "encoding; not encryption"),
      ("hex/percent/unicode escapes", r"\b(?:fromhex|hex2bin|urlunescape|unquote|gsub)\b|%x%x|\\x[0-9a-fA-F]{2}|\\u\{", "representation transform"),
      ("XOR / bitwise stream transform", r"\b(?:bxor|bit32|bit\.bxor|xor)\b|\b(?:band|bor|lshift|rshift|arshift|rotate)\b", "inspect operands, key schedule, and byte loop"),
      ("byte-wise arithmetic", r"\b(?:string\.byte|string\.char|buffer\.readu?8|readbyte|writeu?8)\b|%\s*256|//\s*256", "likely byte packing/unpacking or custom transform"),
      ("LCG / modular PRNG", r"(?:\*\s*(?:1103515245|1664525|214013|48271|16807|0x[0-9a-fA-F]+)\s*\+|\+\s*(?:12345|1013904223|2531011))|\b(?:lcg|seed|keystream|randomstate)\b", "possible PRNG/keystream; constants alone are not proof"),
      ("XXHash/Murmur-style avalanche constants", r"\b(?:xxhash|murmur|avalanche)\b|0x(?:85ebca6b|c2b2ae35|27d4eb2f|165667b1|9e3779b1)\b|\b(?:2246822519|3266489917)\b", "hash/mixing primitive; not a decryptor by itself"),
      ("TEA/XTEA-style rounds", r"\b(?:xtea|\btea\b|delta)\b|0x9e3779b9|2654435769", "possible TEA family; confirm paired-word round structure"),
      ("RC4-style permutation / KSA / PRGA", r"\b(?:rc4|ksa|prga|sbox|state\[)\b|\b256\b.{0,50}\b(?:swap|key)\b", "possible RC4-like byte stream; verify permutation initialization and swap loop"),
      ("AES/block-cipher/library references", r"\b(?:aes(?:[-_ ]?(?:128|192|256))?|aes\.new|cipher\.aes|crypto\.subtle|openssl|chacha20|salsa20|blowfish|des\.new)\b", "algorithm/library name reference; availability and actual use need confirmation"),
      ("compression/container", r"\b(?:gzip|zlib|inflate|deflate|lzma|lz4|zstd|decompress|compress|unpack)\b|\bRSB1\b", "compression/packing may explain high entropy"),
      ("alphabet/substitution decoder", r"\b(?:alphabet|charset|lookup|inverse[_ ]?table|permutation|substitution|decode[_ ]?map)\b|table\.concat", "possible custom alphabet or substitution table"),
      ("hash/KDF/authentication", r"\b(?:sha-?1|sha-?256|sha-?512|md5|hmac|pbkdf2|scrypt|argon2|hkdf|digest|checksum)\b", "hash/KDF/MAC references; hashes are not generally reversible"),
      ("rolling/additive byte transform", r"\b(?:accumulator|rolling|carry|modulus|modulo|rotateleft|rotateright)\b|(?:byte|char)\s*\([^\n]{0,100}[+-]\s*(?:key|seed|i|index)", "possible stateful arithmetic transform"),
    ]
    findings=[]
    for family, pat, note in patterns:
        sites=[]
        for m in re.finditer(pat, scan, re.I):
            line=src.count("\n",0,m.start())+1
            preview=src[m.start():min(len(src),m.start()+160)].splitlines()[0]
            sites.append({"line":line,"evidence":_v4_redact(preview[:160])})
            if len(sites)>=30: break
        if sites: findings.append({"family":family,"hits":len(sites),"sites":sites,"interpretation":note})
    ranked=sorted(findings,key=lambda x:(x["hits"],x["family"]),reverse=True)
    return _json({"schema":"LuauLab.CryptoFingerprint.v1","input_sha256":hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),"findings":ranked,"strongest_candidates":[x["family"] for x in ranked[:5]],"not_a_cryptographic_proof":True,"limits":["Static tokens identify candidates, not verified algorithms.","Modern encryption cannot be cracked from algorithm names or entropy alone.","Verify rounds, state, key schedule, byte order, and test vectors before implementing a decoder."]})


def _tool_encryptx_static_decode(data, args):

                                                                                           
    try: obj=json.loads(data.decode("utf-8-sig"))
    except Exception as exc: raise ValueError("Expected a saved JSON file with Key and Script fields; no network fetching is performed") from exc
    if not isinstance(obj,dict) or not isinstance(obj.get("Key"),str) or not isinstance(obj.get("Script"),str):
        raise ValueError("JSON must contain string fields named Key and Script")
    key=obj["Key"]; encrypted=obj["Script"]
    if not key: raise ValueError("Key cannot be empty")

    cleaned="".join(c for c in encrypted if c in "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz234567=")
    if len(cleaned)<8: raise ValueError("Script field is too short to be a Base32 payload")
    cleaned += "="*((8-len(cleaned)%8)%8)
    try: decoded=base64.b32decode(cleaned.upper(),casefold=True)
    except Exception as exc: raise ValueError("Script is not valid Base32 after conservative cleanup") from exc
    raw=bytes(b ^ (ord(key[i % len(key)]) & 0xff) for i,b in enumerate(decoded))
    text=raw.decode("latin-1")
    try:
        repaired=text.encode("latin-1").decode("utf-8")
        if repaired: text=repaired
    except (UnicodeDecodeError, UnicodeEncodeError): pass
    if not text: raise ValueError("Decoded output is empty")
    return text


def _tool_envlogger_risk_scan(data, args):
    src=_source_text(data); scan=_masked_source(src)
    sources={
      "environment_introspection":r"\b(?:getgenv|getrenv|getfenv|setfenv|getgc|getreg|getinstances|getnilinstances|identifyexecutor|checkcaller|debug\.getregistry|debug\.info)\b",
      "filesystem_read":r"\b(?:readfile|readclipboard|listfiles|isfile|isfolder|readfolder)\s*\(",
      "executor_or_roblox_state":r"\b(?:Players\.LocalPlayer|LocalPlayer|game\.JobId|game\.PlaceId|UserId|NamecallMethod|CoreGui|syn\.|fluxus\.|krnl\.)\b",
    }
    sinks={
      "network_sink":r"\b(?:request|http_request|syn\.request|http\.request|HttpPost|PostAsync|RequestAsync|WebSocketService|WebSocket\.connect)\b|https?://[^\s\"']+",
      "file_sink":r"\b(?:writefile|appendfile|makefolder|delfile|writeclipboard)\s*\(",
      "dynamic_execution_sink":r"\b(?:loadstring|load)\s*\(",
    }
    source_hits={}; sink_hits={}
    for name,pat in sources.items(): source_hits[name]=[{"line":_adv_line(src,m.start()),"evidence":_v4_redact(src[m.start():m.start()+140].splitlines()[0])} for m in list(re.finditer(pat,scan,re.I))[:200]]
    for name,pat in sinks.items(): sink_hits[name]=[{"line":_adv_line(src,m.start()),"evidence":_v4_redact(src[m.start():m.start()+160].splitlines()[0])} for m in list(re.finditer(pat,scan,re.I))[:200]]
    lines=scan.splitlines(); flow=[]
    for i,line in enumerate(lines):
        has_source=any(re.search(p,line,re.I) for p in sources.values())
        if has_source:
            lo=max(0,i-2); hi=min(len(lines),i+6)
            block="\n".join(lines[lo:hi])
            related=[name for name,pat in sinks.items() if re.search(pat,block,re.I)]
            flow.append({"start_line":lo+1,"end_line":hi,"source_line":i+1,"nearby_sinks":related,"preview_redacted":_v4_redact(" ".join(src.splitlines()[lo:hi])[:600])})
    return _json({"schema":"LuauLab.EnvLoggerRisk.v1","input_sha256":hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),"sources":source_hits,"sinks":sink_hits,"nearby_source_sink_windows":flow,"interpretation":"Static risk indicators only; proximity is not proof of data flow.","execution":"The sample was not executed; no environment values were collected; no file or network APIs were called."})


def _tool_anti_tamper_flow_map(data, args):
    src=_source_text(data); scan=_masked_source(src)
    pats={
      "integrity_or_hash":r"\b(?:hash|sha\w*|md5|checksum|integrity|crc32|digest|verify)\b",
      "debug_or_executor_detection":r"\b(?:identifyexecutor|checkcaller|getgenv|getrenv|getfenv|debug\.info|debug\.getregistry|getgc|syn\.|fluxus\.|krnl\.)\b",
      "metatable_or_hook_detection":r"\b(?:hookfunction|hookmetamethod|getrawmetatable|setreadonly|newcclosure|NamecallMethod)\b",
      "timing_or_environment_check":r"\b(?:os\.clock|tick\s*\(|time\s*\(|DateTime\.now|RunService|IsStudio|IsServer|IsClient)\b",
      "termination_or_guard_response":r"\b(?:error|assert|Kick|Disconnect|Teleport|return\s+nil|while\s+true)\b",
      "branch_or_state_control":r"\b(?:if|elseif|else|return|break|continue)\b|==|~=",
    }
    found=[]
    for cat,pat in pats.items():
        for m in list(re.finditer(pat,scan,re.I))[:250]:
            line=_adv_line(src,m.start()); ls=src.splitlines(); preview=ls[line-1] if 0<line<=len(ls) else ""
            found.append({"category":cat,"line":line,"evidence":_v4_redact(preview[:240])})
    found.sort(key=lambda x:(x["line"],x["category"]))
    return _json({"schema":"LuauLab.AntiTamperMap.v1","sites":found,"counts":{k:sum(1 for x in found if x["category"]==k) for k in pats},"line_windows":[{"line":x["line"],"window":_v4_redact("\n".join(src.splitlines()[max(0,x["line"]-3):min(len(src.splitlines()),x["line"]+2)])[:600])} for x in found if x["category"] in ("debug_or_executor_detection","metatable_or_hook_detection","integrity_or_hash")][:150],"limits":"This maps suspicious call sites and nearby conditions; it does not prove a protection is effective or fully reconstruct branching semantics."})


def _tool_deobfuscation_route_planner(data, args):
    src=_source_text(data); scan=_masked_source(src)
    ext=json.loads(_tool_bytecode_container_detect(data,args))
    profiles=json.loads(_tool_obfuscator_profile_ensemble(data,args))
    enc=json.loads(_tool_cryptographic_transform_candidates(data,args))
    findings=[]
    if re.search(r"loadstring\s*\([^\n]*HttpGet|HttpGet\s*\([^\n]*\).*loadstring",scan,re.I|re.S): findings.append({"priority":1,"next":"loader-path-map","reason":"network loader and dynamic-code indicators; analyze a saved local copy first"})
    if re.search(r"\bstring\.char\s*\(|\butf8\.char\s*\(|\btable\.concat\s*\(",scan,re.I): findings.append({"priority":2,"next":"deobfuscate","reason":"constant string-builder transformations may be recoverable statically"})
    if re.search(r"\b(?:while\s+true|opcode|dispatch|prototype|upvalue|registers|bit32\.bxor)\b",scan,re.I): findings.append({"priority":2,"next":"vm-architecture-report","reason":"dispatcher/VM-like structure detected; use byte-level handler/state reports"})
    if re.fullmatch(rb"\s*[A-Za-z0-9+/\r\n]+={0,2}\s*",data) and len(data)>24: findings.append({"priority":1,"next":"auto-decode","reason":"input resembles Base64-only data"})
    if ext.get("signatures"): findings.append({"priority":1,"next":"bytecode-header-report","reason":"inspect binary/container evidence before choosing a decompiler"})
    top=profiles.get("ranked_profiles",[])[:5]
    if not findings: findings.append({"priority":3,"next":"static-recon-summary","reason":"no dominant specialized route; begin with a general static pass"})
    return _json({"schema":"LuauLab.RoutePlan.v1","input_sha256":hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),"ordered_steps":findings,"profile_candidates":top,"container_evidence":ext.get("signatures",[]),"recommended_external_static_tool":"ByteVeil for CFG/SSA/IR and MoonSec V3 serialized extraction; luaudec or PumbaaDev for valid raw Luau bytecode; verify every version-specific decoder against a known test sample.","do_not_assume":"Scores and token patterns are heuristic; this plan is not a claim the file is fully decoded."})

def _tool_obfuscator_evidence_chain(data,args):
    src=_source_text(data); scan=_masked_source(src)
    rules={
      "Luraph":r"\bLuraph\b|LPH_[A-Z0-9_]+|\bLuraph Obfuscator\b",
      "IronBrew/IronBrew2":r"\bIron\s*Brew\s*2?\b|\bIB2\b",
      "MoonSec":r"\bMoonSec\b|\bMSV3\b",
      "Prometheus/WeAreDevs":r"\bPrometheus\b|\bWeAreDevs\b|\bWRD\b",
      "PSU":r"\bPSU\s*(?:4\.[05])?\b|\bPSU\w*VM\b",
      "Clyde":r"\bClyde(?:\s*V[2-6])?\b",
      "77fuscator":r"\b77fuscator\b",
      "Ironveil":r"\bIronveil\b",
      "Hercules":r"\bHercules\b",
      "MoonVeil":r"\bMoonVeil\b",
      "LUAST":r"\bLUAST\b",
      "Generic VM state dispatcher":r"\bwhile\s+(?:true|1)\s+do\b|\b(?:opcode|instruction|dispatch|program_counter)\b",
      "Anti-tamper / executor probe":r"\b(?:identifyexecutor|checkcaller|getgenv|getrenv|debug\.getregistry|hookfunction|hookmetamethod)\b",
      "Dynamic payload loader":r"\b(?:loadstring|load)\s*\(|\bHttpGet\s*\(",
    }
    rows=[]; lines=src.splitlines()
    for family,pat in rules.items():
        sites=[]
        for m in list(re.finditer(pat,scan,re.I))[:80]:
            ln=_adv_line(src,m.start()); preview=lines[ln-1] if ln and ln<=len(lines) else ""
            sites.append({"line":ln,"matched_token":m.group(0)[:70],"preview":_v4_redact(preview[:180])})
        if sites: rows.append({"family_or_feature":family,"evidence_count":len(sites),"evidence":sites[:30]})
    return _json({"schema":"LuauLab.EvidenceChain.v1","input_sha256":hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),"evidence":rows,"confidence":"heuristic; explicit identifiers are stronger than structural patterns","next_step":"Use a known-version-specific decoder only when the family and input format have supporting evidence."})

def _tool_byteveil_dispatch(data,args,override=None):
    _v4_require_explicit_external(args); inp=_v4_named_input(args)
    tool=_v4_pick_tool_path(args,["build/byteveil","build/byteveil.exe","byteveil","byteveil.exe"])
    mode=override or (_arg(args,"engine",None) or "protectors")
    out=_arg(args,"bridge_output",None)
    if not out: raise ValueError("set --bridge-output; use --engine protectors|unpack|inspect-source|inspect-bytecode|disassemble|cfg|moonsec|moonsec-ir|moonsec-bytecode|structured|luau")
    dest=Path(out).expanduser().resolve(); dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    if mode=="protectors": cmd=[str(tool),str(inp),"--format","protectors","--no-color"]
    elif mode=="unpack": cmd=[str(tool),str(inp),"--format","unpack","--no-color"]
    elif mode=="inspect-source": cmd=[str(tool),str(inp),"--format","json","--no-color"]
    elif mode=="inspect-bytecode": cmd=[str(tool),"--bytecode",str(inp),"--format","json","--no-color"]
    elif mode=="disassemble": cmd=[str(tool),"--bytecode",str(inp),"--disassemble","--no-color"]
    elif mode=="cfg": cmd=[str(tool),"--bytecode",str(inp),"--cfg",str(dest),"--no-color"]
    elif mode in ("moonsec","moonsec-ir","moonsec-bytecode","structured","luau"):
        cmd=[str(tool),str(inp),"--format",mode,"--no-color"]
    else: raise ValueError("unsupported ByteVeil engine/mode: "+str(mode))
    if mode in ("moonsec-ir","moonsec-bytecode"): cmd.extend(["-o",str(dest)])
    timeout=max(2,min(int(_arg(args,"timeout",60)),300))
    try: proc=subprocess.run(cmd,capture_output=True,timeout=timeout,check=False,cwd=tool.parent)
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired: raise ValueError("ByteVeil timed out; no output was accepted")
    stdout=proc.stdout; stderr=proc.stderr
    if mode!="cfg" and mode not in ("moonsec-ir","moonsec-bytecode"):
        dest.write_bytes(stdout)
    exists=dest.exists()
    return _json({"adapter":"ByteVeil CLI (static analysis; input not executed by normal CLI)","mode":mode,"input":str(inp),"output_path":str(dest) if exists else None,"returncode":proc.returncode,"stdout_bytes":len(stdout),"stderr_preview_redacted":_v4_redact(stderr.decode("utf-8","replace")[:1600]),"output_sha256":hashlib.sha256(dest.read_bytes()).hexdigest() if exists else None,"output_bytes":dest.stat().st_size if exists else 0,"upstream":"https://github.com/Xyraniz/ByteVeil","note":"ByteVeil documents CFG/SSA/IR and a validated static MoonSec V3 serialized payload path; per-sample opcode mapping can remain unresolved. This adapter does not run equivalence harnesses."})


def _tool_luaudec_cli_bridge(data,args):
    _v4_require_explicit_external(args); inp=_v4_named_input(args)
    tool=_v4_pick_tool_path(args,["build/luaudec","build/luaudec.exe","build/Release/luaudec.exe","luaudec","luaudec.exe"])
    mode=_arg(args,"engine",None) or "decompile"; out=_arg(args,"bridge_output",None)
    options={"decompile":[],"disasm":["--disasm"],"cfg":["--cfg"],"info":["--info"],"verbose":["-v"],"roblox":["--roblox"],"standard":["--standard"]}
    if mode not in options: raise ValueError("luaudec --engine must be decompile|disasm|cfg|info|verbose|roblox|standard")
    if not out: raise ValueError("set --bridge-output for captured luaudec output")
    cmd=[str(tool),*options[mode],str(inp)]
    return _v5_capture_local_cli(cmd,args,tool.parent,out,"stolevchristian/LuauDecompiler (luaudec)","README describes Luau bytecode v3-v14; this experimental project still needs sample-specific validation.")


def _v5_capture_local_cli(cmd,args,cwd,out_path,project,note):
    dest=Path(out_path).expanduser().resolve(); dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    timeout=max(2,min(int(_arg(args,"timeout",60)),300))
    try: p=subprocess.run([str(x) for x in cmd],capture_output=True,timeout=timeout,check=False,cwd=str(cwd) if cwd else None)
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired: raise ValueError(project+" timed out; no output file was accepted")
    dest.write_bytes(p.stdout)
    return _json({"adapter":project,"command":list(map(str,cmd)),"returncode":p.returncode,"output_path":str(dest),"output_bytes":dest.stat().st_size,"output_sha256":hashlib.sha256(dest.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),"stderr_preview_redacted":_v4_redact(p.stderr.decode("utf-8","replace")[:1200]),"note":note,"sandbox_requirement":"Run after reviewing source/dependencies in a disposable offline environment; the adapter passes only a local input path and does not use a shell."})

def _tool_prometheus_deobfuscator_bridge(data,args):
    _v4_require_explicit_external(args); inp=_v4_named_input(args)
    tool=_v4_pick_tool_path(args,["bin/pdeobf.js"]); out=_arg(args,"bridge_output",None)

    node=shutil.which("node")

    cmd=[node,str(tool),str(inp),"-o",str(Path(out).expanduser().resolve())]
    res=_v4_run_local(cmd,args,cwd=tool.parent.parent,output_path=out)
    return _json({"adapter":"prostone4/Prometheus-Deobfuscator","result":res,"upstream":"https://github.com/prostone4/Prometheus-Deobfuscator","note":"Node 16+ according to README; test only the protector variant claimed by the checked-out revision."})


def _tool_psu_deobfuscator_bridge(data,args):
    _v4_require_explicit_external(args); inp=_v4_named_input(args)
    path=_arg(args,"tool_path",None)
    if not path: raise ValueError("set --tool-path to PSU-Deobfuscator repository root")
    root=Path(path).expanduser().resolve(); root=(root.parent if root.is_file() and root.name=="package.json" else root)
    if not (root/"package.json").is_file(): raise ValueError("--tool-path must identify the PSU-Deobfuscator root with package.json")
    out=_arg(args,"bridge_output",None)
    if not out: raise ValueError("set --bridge-output for the recovered Lua")
    import shutil
    npm=shutil.which("npm")
    if not npm: raise ValueError("npm not installed")
    cmd=[npm,"run","deobf","--",str(inp.resolve()),"-o",str(Path(out).expanduser().resolve())]
    res=_v4_run_local(cmd,args,cwd=root,output_path=out)
    return _json({"adapter":"memcpython/PSU-Deobfuscator","result":res,"upstream":"https://github.com/memcpython/PSU-Deobfuscator","note":"README says Node.js 18+, Java, and unluac are required. Runtime lifting stage is documented as static; validate dependencies before use."})

def _tool_moonsec_v3_cli_bridge(data,args):
    _v4_require_explicit_external(args); inp=_v4_named_input(args)
    tool=_v4_pick_tool_path(args,["MoonsecDeobfuscator.dll","MoonSecDeobfuscator.dll","publish/MoonsecDeobfuscator.dll","bin/Release/net8.0/MoonsecDeobfuscator.dll","MoonsecDeobfuscator.exe"])
    out=_arg(args,"bridge_output",None)
    if not out: raise ValueError("set --bridge-output; choose --engine devirtualize or disassemble")
    mode=_arg(args,"engine",None) or "devirtualize"
    if mode not in ("devirtualize","disassemble"): raise ValueError("--engine must be devirtualize or disassemble")
    if tool.suffix.lower()==".dll":
        import shutil
        dotnet=shutil.which("dotnet")
        if not dotnet: raise ValueError("dotnet is required for the selected DLL")
        cmd=[dotnet,str(tool)]
    else: cmd=[str(tool)]
    cmd += (["-dev"] if mode=="devirtualize" else ["-dis"])+["-i",str(inp),"-o",str(Path(out).expanduser().resolve())]
    res=_v4_run_local(cmd,args,cwd=tool.parent,output_path=out)
    return _json({"adapter":"tupsutumppu/MoonsecDeobfuscator","mode":mode,"result":res,"upstream":"https://github.com/tupsutumppu/MoonsecDeobfuscator","license":"GPL-3.0","note":"This stage emits Lua 5.1 bytecode or disassembly; source decompilation is a separate step."})


def _tool_77fuscator_cli_bridge(data,args):
    _v4_require_explicit_external(args); inp=_v4_named_input(args)
    tool=_v4_pick_tool_path(args,["deobfuscator","target/release/deobfuscator","77fuscatorDeobfuscator","deobfuscator.exe","77fuscatorDeobfuscator.exe"])
    out=_arg(args,"bridge_output",None)
    if not out: raise ValueError("set --bridge-output for the recovered Lua 5.1 bytecode")
    mode=_arg(args,"engine",None) or "decompile"
    if mode not in ("decompile","strings","dump-protos","dump-handlers","dump-lifted"): raise ValueError("unsupported 77fuscator mode")
    cmd=[str(tool),str(inp)]
    if mode!="decompile": cmd.append("--"+mode)
    cmd.extend(["-o",str(Path(out).expanduser().resolve())])
    res=_v4_run_local(cmd,args,cwd=tool.parent,output_path=out)
    return _json({"adapter":"Bytecoded1337/77fuscatorDeobfuscator","mode":mode,"result":res,"upstream":"https://github.com/Bytecoded1337/77fuscatorDeobfuscator","note":"README describes a Lua 5.1 binary chunk output; do not execute it to validate. Use a bytecode parser/decompiler next."})

def _tool_entropy_window_map(data, args):
    size = max(16, min(int(_arg(args, "window_size", 256)), 65536))
    step = max(1, min(int(_arg(args, "step", max(1, size // 2))), size))
    rows = []
    for off in range(0, len(data), step):
        chunk = data[off:off + size]
        if not chunk:
            break
        rows.append({"offset": off, "length": len(chunk), "entropy": round(shannon_entropy(chunk), 5), "printable_ratio": round(printable_ratio(chunk), 5), "type_guess": _file_type(chunk)})
        if off + size >= len(data):
            break
    return _json({"input_bytes": len(data), "window_size": size, "step": step, "windows": rows, "interpretation": "Entropy is a clue, not proof of encryption; compressed data can also have high entropy."})


def _tool_byte_distribution(data, args):
    counts = Counter(data)
    top = max(1, min(int(_arg(args, "top", 32)), 256))
    return _json({"bytes": len(data), "unique_byte_values": len(counts), "most_common": [{"byte_hex": f"0x{b:02x}", "decimal": b, "count": n, "ratio": round(n / len(data), 6) if data else 0} for b, n in counts.most_common(top)], "zero_bytes": counts.get(0, 0), "high_bit_bytes": sum(n for b, n in counts.items() if b >= 128), "histogram_256": [counts.get(i, 0) for i in range(256)]})


def _tool_cipher_compression_triage(data, args):
    signatures = {"gzip": data.startswith(b"\x1f\x8b"), "zlib_common": len(data) >= 2 and data[0] == 0x78 and data[1] in (0x01, 0x5e, 0x9c, 0xda), "bzip2": data.startswith(b"BZh"), "xz": data.startswith(b"\xfd7zXZ\x00"), "zip": data.startswith(b"PK\x03\x04"), "png": data.startswith(b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n"), "elf": data.startswith(b"\x7fELF"), "pe": data.startswith(b"MZ")}
    ent = shannon_entropy(data)
    printable = printable_ratio(data)
    if any(signatures.values()): hypotheses = [k for k, v in signatures.items() if v]
    elif ent >= 7.55 and printable < 0.25: hypotheses = ["high-entropy binary: encryption, compression, or packed data are all possible"]
    elif ent >= 6.5 and printable < 0.65: hypotheses = ["compressed or encoded binary is plausible", "test known codecs and encodings"]
    elif printable >= 0.85: hypotheses = ["text or encoded text is plausible", "inspect Base-N, hex, escapes, and source literals"]
    else: hypotheses = ["ambiguous binary/text data; use signatures, window entropy, and string extraction"]
    return _json({"type_guess": _file_type(data), "bytes": len(data), "entropy": round(ent, 5), "printable_ratio": round(printable, 5), "known_signatures": signatures, "hypotheses": hypotheses, "not_proof": True})


def _tool_base64url_decode(data, args):
    raw = data.decode("ascii", errors="strict").strip()
    raw = re.sub(r"\s+", "", raw).replace("-", "+").replace("_", "/")
    raw += "=" * ((-len(raw)) % 4)
    try:
        out = base64.b64decode(raw, validate=True)
    except binascii.Error as exc:
        raise ValueError(f"invalid Base64URL input: {exc}") from exc
    return out


def _tool_base58_decode(data, args):
    alphabet = "123456789ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijkmnopqrstuvwxyz"
    text = data.decode("ascii", errors="strict").strip()
    n = 0
    for ch in text:
        if ch not in alphabet:
            raise ValueError(f"invalid Base58 character: {ch!r}")
        n = n * 58 + alphabet.index(ch)
    body = n.to_bytes((n.bit_length() + 7) // 8, "big") if n else b""
    zeros = len(text) - len(text.lstrip("1"))
    return b"\x00" * zeros + body


def _tool_rot47(data, args):
    text = get_text(data)
    return "".join(chr(33 + ((ord(ch) - 33 + 47) % 94)) if 33 <= ord(ch) <= 126 else ch for ch in text)


def _tool_utf16_string_extract(data, args):
    min_len = max(2, min(int(_arg(args, "min_length", 4)), 1000))
    rows = []
    for encoding in ("utf-16le", "utf-16be"):
        unit = "little" if encoding.endswith("le") else "big"
        i = 0
        while i + 2 * min_len <= len(data):
            start = i
            chars = []
            while i + 1 < len(data):
                b = data[i:i+2]
                cp = int.from_bytes(b, unit)
                if cp in (9, 10, 13) or 32 <= cp <= 126 or 0xA0 <= cp <= 0x024F:
                    chars.append(chr(cp)); i += 2
                else:
                    break
            if len(chars) >= min_len:
                rows.append({"offset": start, "encoding": encoding, "length": len(chars), "text": _v4_redact("".join(chars)[:1000])})
            i = max(i, start + 2)
    rows.sort(key=lambda x: x["offset"])
    return _json({"strings": rows[:max(1, min(int(_arg(args, "top", 500)), 5000))], "count": len(rows), "redaction": "URLs and common secret forms are redacted"})


def _tool_lua_long_bracket_extract(data, args):
    src = _source_text(data)
    rows = []
    for token in tokenize_lua(src):
        if token.kind != "string" or not re.match(r"^\[(=*)\[", token.value, re.S):
            continue
        opening = re.match(r"^\[(=*)\[", token.value, re.S)
        level = len(opening.group(1))
        content = token.value[opening.end():]
        closing = "]" + opening.group(1) + "]"
        if content.endswith(closing): content = content[:-len(closing)]
        rows.append({"line": _adv_line(src, token.start), "delimiter_level": level, "length": len(content), "preview": _v4_redact(content[:400])})
    return _json({"long_bracket_literals": rows[:_arg(args, "top", 500)], "count": len(rows)})


def _tool_literal_context_index(data, args):
    src = _source_text(data)
    rows = []
    for pos, raw, decoded in _string_tokens(src):
        before = src[max(0, src.rfind("\n", 0, pos) + 1):pos]
        line_end = src.find("\n", pos)
        after = src[pos:len(src) if line_end < 0 else line_end]
        rows.append({"line": _adv_line(src, pos), "offset": pos, "raw_length": len(raw), "decoded_length": len(decoded), "value_redacted": _v4_redact(decoded[:500]), "left_context": _v4_redact(before[-100:]), "right_context": _v4_redact(after[len(raw):][:120])})
    return _json({"literal_count": len(rows), "literals": rows[:_arg(args, "top", 500)], "secret_values_redacted": True})


def _tool_hash_shape(data, args):
    src = _source_text(data)
    found = []
    for m in re.finditer(r"(?<![A-Za-z0-9+/=_-])([A-Fa-f0-9]{8,128}|[A-Za-z0-9+/=_-]{20,128})(?![A-Za-z0-9+/=_-])", src):
        val = m.group(1)
        if len(val) in (8, 16, 24, 32, 40, 44, 56, 64, 88, 96, 128):
            forms = []
            if re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-fA-F]+", val):
                forms += {8: ["CRC32-like"], 32: ["MD5-like"], 40: ["SHA-1-like"], 64: ["SHA-256-like"], 96: ["SHA-384-like"], 128: ["SHA-512-like"]}.get(len(val), ["hex digest/constant candidate"])
            if re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9+/]+={0,2}", val): forms.append("Base64-shaped candidate")
            found.append({"line": _adv_line(src, m.start()), "length": len(val), "shape": sorted(set(forms)) or ["opaque constant"], "preview": val[:5] + "…" + val[-3:]})
    return _json({"candidates": found[:_arg(args, "top", 500)], "count": len(found), "note": "Shape does not identify the generating hash algorithm with certainty."})


def _tool_api_argument_map(data, args):
    src = _source_text(data); scan = _masked_source(src)
    names = r"(?:HttpGet|HttpPost|GetAsync|PostAsync|RequestAsync|http_request|request|loadstring|load|writefile|appendfile|readfile|delfile|setclipboard|GetService|require|FireServer|InvokeServer|Teleport|Kick)"
    rows = []
    pat = re.compile(r"\b" + names + r"\s*(?:[:.]\s*[A-Za-z_]\w*)?\s*\(", re.I)
    for m in pat.finditer(scan):
        line = _adv_line(src, m.start())
        end = src.find("\n", m.start()); end = len(src) if end < 0 else end
        rows.append({"line": line, "call": m.group(0).strip()[:100], "source_preview": _v4_redact(src[m.start():min(end, m.start()+240)].strip()), "risk_area": "network" if re.search(r"http|request|getasync|postasync", m.group(0), re.I) else "dynamic_execution" if re.search(r"loadstring|\bload\b", m.group(0), re.I) else "filesystem_or_game_api"})
    return _json({"calls": rows[:_arg(args, "top", 500)], "count": len(rows), "static_only": True})


def _tool_credential_leak_audit(data, args):
    src = _source_text(data); scan = _masked_source(src)
    pats = {
        "discord_webhook": r"https?://(?:canary\.)?discord(?:app)?\.com/api(?:/v\d+)?/webhooks/\d+/[^\s\"'<>`?#]+",
        "slack_webhook": r"https?://hooks\.slack\.com/services/[^\s\"'<>`?#]+",
        "bearer_header": r"(?i)\bBearer\s+[A-Za-z0-9._~+/-]{8,}",
        "api_key_assignment": r"(?i)(?:api[_-]?key|client[_-]?secret|access[_-]?token|auth[_-]?token|discord[_-]?token)\s*[:=]\s*[\"'][^\"']{6,}[\"']",
        "query_secret": r"(?i)[?&](?:token|key|secret|auth|api_key|apikey)=([^&\s\"']{6,})",
    }
    rows = []
    for kind, pat in pats.items():
        for m in re.finditer(pat, src, re.I):
            snippet = _v4_redact(m.group(0))
            if kind in ("bearer_header", "api_key_assignment"):
                snippet = re.sub(r"(?i)(bearer\s+|(?:api[_-]?key|client[_-]?secret|access[_-]?token|auth[_-]?token|discord[_-]?token)\s*[:=]\s*[\"']?)[^\s\"']+", r"\1[REDACTED]", snippet)
            rows.append({"kind": kind, "line": _adv_line(src, m.start()), "finding": snippet[:220], "secret_returned": False})
    return _json({"findings": rows[:_arg(args, "top", 500)], "count": len(rows), "values": "always redacted", "output_note": "Use -o to save this redacted report locally. Full credentials are intentionally not reproduced."})


def _tool_file_side_effect_map(data, args):
    src = _source_text(data); scan = _masked_source(src)
    pats = {
        "write": r"\b(?:writefile|appendfile|saveinstance|writeclipboard|setclipboard)\s*\(",
        "read": r"\b(?:readfile|isfile|isfolder|listfiles|getcustomasset)\s*\(",
        "delete_or_move": r"\b(?:delfile|deletefile|makefolder|delfolder)\s*\(",
        "dynamic_eval": r"\b(?:loadstring|load|dofile|loadfile)\s*\(",
        "environment_write": r"\b(?:setfenv|rawset|setmetatable)\s*\(",
    }
    out = {}
    for kind, pat in pats.items():
        out[kind] = [{"line": _adv_line(src, m.start()), "preview": _v4_redact(src[m.start():min(len(src), src.find("\n", m.start()) if src.find("\n", m.start()) >= 0 else len(src))].strip()[:200])} for m in re.finditer(pat, scan, re.I)][: _arg(args, "top", 500)]
    return _json({"effects": out, "total": sum(map(len, out.values())), "mode": "source reference detection only; no file operations are performed"})


def _tool_dependency_require_map(data, args):
    src = _source_text(data); scan = _masked_source(src); rows = []
    for m in re.finditer(r"\brequire\s*\(\s*([^\n)]{1,180})\)", scan):
        expr = m.group(1).strip()
        raw = src[m.start(1):m.end(1)].strip()
        rows.append({"line": _adv_line(src, m.start()), "argument_expression": _v4_redact(raw), "literal_module_id": int(expr) if expr.isdigit() else None, "dynamic": not (expr.isdigit() or re.fullmatch(r"[\"'][^\"']+[\"']", expr))})
    urls = []
    for m in re.finditer(r"https?://[^\s\"'<>`]+", src, re.I):
        url = _v4_redact(m.group(0).rstrip(",);]}"))
        urls.append({"line": _adv_line(src, m.start()), "url": url})
    return _json({"require_calls": rows[:_arg(args, "top", 500)], "require_count": len(rows), "url_literals_redacted": urls[:_arg(args, "top", 500)], "network_used_by_analyzer": False})


def _tool_static_execution_sinks(data, args):
    src = _source_text(data); scan = _masked_source(src)
    pats = {
        "dynamic_code": r"\b(?:loadstring|load|dofile|loadfile)\s*\(",
        "remote_module": r"\b(?:require|HttpGet|GetAsync)\s*\(",
        "network_send": r"\b(?:PostAsync|RequestAsync|http_request|request)\s*\(",
        "server_event": r"\b(?:FireServer|InvokeServer|TeleportToPlaceInstance|Teleport)\s*\(",
        "sensitive_read": r"\b(?:getgenv|getfenv|readfile|identifyexecutor|gethwid|getclipboard)\s*\(?",
        "sensitive_write": r"\b(?:writefile|appendfile|setclipboard|hookfunction|hookmetamethod)\s*\(?",
    }
    records = []
    for category, pat in pats.items():
        for m in re.finditer(pat, scan, re.I):
            records.append({"line": _adv_line(src, m.start()), "category": category, "indicator": m.group(0), "preview": _v4_redact(src[m.start():min(len(src), src.find("\n", m.start()) if src.find("\n", m.start()) >= 0 else len(src))].strip()[:200])})
    records.sort(key=lambda r: (r["line"], r["category"]))
    return _json({"sinks": records[:_arg(args, "top", 500)], "count": len(records), "static_only": True})


def _tool_cff_metric(data, args):
    src = _source_text(data); scan = _masked_source(src)
    state_vars = Counter(re.findall(r"\b([A-Za-z_]\w*)\s*(?:==|~=|<=|>=)\s*(?:0x[0-9a-fA-F]+|\d+)\b", scan))
    numeric_branches = len(re.findall(r"\b(?:if|elseif)\s+[A-Za-z_]\w*\s*==\s*(?:0x[0-9a-fA-F]+|\d+)", scan))
    state_writes = len(re.findall(r"\b[A-Za-z_]\w*\s*=\s*(?:0x[0-9a-fA-F]+|\d+)\s*;?\s*(?:--[^\n]*)?$", scan, re.M))
    branch_count = len(re.findall(r"\b(?:if|elseif|else|while|repeat|until|for)\b", scan))
    handlers = len(re.findall(r"\[\s*\d+\s*\]\s*=\s*function\b", scan))
    score = min(100, numeric_branches * 3 + min(24, max(state_vars.values(), default=0) * 4) + min(24, handlers * 3) + min(20, state_writes))
    return _json({"score": score, "signals": {"numeric_state_branches": numeric_branches, "numeric_state_writes": state_writes, "control_keywords": branch_count, "numeric_function_table_entries": handlers, "candidate_state_variables": state_vars.most_common(20)}, "interpretation": "heuristic score for state-machine/CFF patterns; ordinary stateful code may score highly"})


def _tool_vm_state_graph_dot(data, args):
    src = _source_text(data); scan = _masked_source(src)
    sym = _arg(args, "symbol", None)
    var_counts = Counter(re.findall(r"\b([A-Za-z_]\w*)\s*(?:==|~=)\s*(?:0x[0-9a-fA-F]+|\d+)", scan))
    state = sym or (var_counts.most_common(1)[0][0] if var_counts else None)
    if not state:
        return "digraph VM {\n  label=\"No numeric state variable detected\";\n}"
    lit = r"(?:0x[0-9a-fA-F]+|\d+)"
    transitions = []
    pat = re.compile(r"\bif\s+" + re.escape(state) + r"\s*==\s*(" + lit + r")\s+then\b(.*?)(?=\belseif\b|\belse\b|\bend\b)", re.S)
    for m in pat.finditer(scan):
        start = int(m.group(1), 0)
        dests = re.findall(r"\b" + re.escape(state) + r"\s*=\s*(" + lit + r")", m.group(2))
        for dest in dests:
            transitions.append((start, int(dest, 0)))
    nodes = sorted(set([x for edge in transitions for x in edge]))
    if not nodes:
        return "digraph VM {\n  label=\"State variable found; no simple literal transitions proven\";\n}"
    lines = ["digraph VM {", f"  label=\"State transitions for {state}\";"]
    lines.extend(f"  s{n} [label=\"{n}\"];" for n in nodes)
    lines.extend(f"  s{a} -> s{b};" for a, b in sorted(set(transitions)))
    lines.append("}")
    return "\n".join(lines)


def _tool_disassembly_opcode_report(data, args):
    text = _source_text(data)
    op_re = re.compile(r"\b(?:LOAD[A-Z0-9_]*|GET[A-Z0-9_]*|SET[A-Z0-9_]*|CALL[A-Z0-9_]*|RETURN[A-Z0-9_]*|JUMP[A-Z0-9_]*|FOR[A-Z0-9_]*|NEW[A-Z0-9_]*|DUP[A-Z0-9_]*|CLOSE[A-Z0-9_]*|NAMECALL|FASTCALL[A-Z0-9_]*|PREPVARARGS|VARARG[A-Z0-9_]*|NATIVECALL)\b")
    counts = Counter(op_re.findall(text.upper()))
    lines = []
    for i, line in enumerate(text.splitlines(), 1):
        ops = op_re.findall(line.upper())
        if ops:
            lines.append({"line": i, "opcodes": ops, "text": _v4_redact(line.strip()[:300])})
    return _json({"opcode_frequencies": counts.most_common(200), "opcode_lines": lines[:_arg(args, "top", 500)], "opcode_line_count": len(lines), "note": "This is a text-disassembly heuristic, not a parser for every bytecode version."})


def _tool_wad_profile_scan(data, args):
    src = _source_text(data); scan = _masked_source(src)
    pats = {
        "wad_named_marker": r"\b(?:WAD|WeAreDevs)\b",
        "flattened_state_dispatch": r"\b(?:while\s+true|repeat)\b[\s\S]{0,4000}\b(?:state|pc|step|index)\s*==\s*\d+",
        "large_numeric_decision_tree": r"\b(?:if|elseif)\s+[A-Za-z_]\w*\s*==\s*\d+",
        "custom_alphabet_candidate": r"[\"'][A-Za-z0-9+/]{48,80}[\"']",
        "decode_table_candidate": r"\b[A-Za-z_]\w*\s*\[\s*[A-Za-z_]\w*\s*\]\s*\b",
        "dynamic_payload_sink": r"\b(?:loadstring|load)\s*\(",
    }
    hits = _v4_pattern_hits(src, scan, pats, raw_patterns=("wad_named_marker",))
    score = min(100, sum(len(v) * (30 if k == "wad_named_marker" else 6) for k, v in hits.items()))
    return _json({"profile": "WAD/WeAreDevs v1-style static profile", "score": score, "evidence": hits, "suggestion": "For a confirmed WAD v1.0.0 source wrapper, try the local WAD-deobf bridge; otherwise treat this as a heuristic only."})


def _tool_literal_auto_decode(data, args):
    src = _source_text(data); limit = max(1, min(int(_arg(args, "top", 60)), 250)); out = []
    for pos, raw, decoded in _string_tokens(src):
        blob = decoded.encode("utf-8", errors="replace")
        if len(blob) < max(10, int(_arg(args, "min_length", 10))):
            continue
        try:
            best, states = _auto_decode(blob, min(5, int(_arg(args, "depth", 4))), min(8, int(_arg(args, "beam", 6))))
        except Exception:
            continue
        final, chain, score = best
        if chain:
            preview = final[:350].decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
            out.append({"line": _adv_line(src, pos), "input_chars": len(decoded), "steps": chain, "score": round(score, 4), "output_preview_redacted": _v4_redact(preview), "output_bytes": len(final), "sha256": hashlib.sha256(final).hexdigest()})
        if len(out) >= limit:
            break
    return _json({"decoded_literal_candidates": out, "count": len(out), "note": "Payloads are treated as bytes/text only; no decoded code is executed."})


def _tool_source_structural_fingerprint(data, args):
    src = _source_text(data); toks = tokenize_lua(src)
    normalized = " ".join(f"{t.kind}:{('<literal>' if t.kind in ('string','number') else t.value)}" for t in toks)
    metrics = {"bytes": len(data), "lines": len(src.splitlines()), "tokens": len(toks), "unique_identifiers": len({t.value for t in toks if t.kind == "identifier"}), "strings": sum(t.kind == "string" for t in toks), "numbers": sum(t.kind == "number" for t in toks), "keywords": sum(t.kind == "keyword" for t in toks), "branches": len(re.findall(r"\b(?:if|elseif|else|while|repeat|until|for)\b", _masked_source(src))), "calls": len(re.findall(r"[A-Za-z_]\w*\s*\(", _masked_source(src)))}
    return _json({"metrics": metrics, "token_shape_sha256": hashlib.sha256(normalized.encode()).hexdigest(), "raw_sha256": hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(), "normalized_token_preview": normalized[:2000]})


def _tool_url_host_report(data, args):
    src = _source_text(data); seen = set(); rows = []
    for m in re.finditer(r"https?://[^\s\"'<>`]+", src, re.I):
        raw = m.group(0).rstrip(",);]}")
        parsed = None
        try:
            parsed = urllib.parse.urlsplit(raw)
            host = (parsed.hostname or "").lower()
            scheme = parsed.scheme.lower()
            port = parsed.port
        except ValueError:
            host, scheme, port = "invalid", "unknown", None
        key = (host, scheme, port)
        if key in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(key)
        path_value = parsed.path if parsed is not None else ""
        path_value = re.sub(r"(?i)(/api(?:/v\d+)?/webhooks/\d+/)[^/]+", r"\1[REDACTED_TOKEN]", path_value)
        path_value = re.sub(r"(?i)(/services/)[^/]+(?:/[^/]+){0,3}", r"\1[REDACTED_TOKEN]", path_value)
        path_value = re.sub(r"(?i)(/webhook/)[^/]+", r"\1[REDACTED_TOKEN]", path_value)
        rows.append({"line": _adv_line(src, m.start()), "scheme": scheme, "host": host, "port": port, "path_redacted": _v4_redact(path_value), "full_url": _v4_redact(raw)})
    return _json({"hosts": rows[:_arg(args, "top", 500)], "unique_hosts": len(rows), "network_connections_made": False})


def _tool_luau_call_frequency(data, args):
    scan = _masked_source(_source_text(data))
    pat = re.compile(r"\b([A-Za-z_]\w*(?:(?:\.|:)\s*[A-Za-z_]\w*){0,3})\s*\(")
    counts = Counter(re.sub(r"\s+", "", m.group(1)) for m in pat.finditer(scan))
    return _json({"calls": [{"name": name, "count": count} for name, count in counts.most_common(max(1, min(int(_arg(args, "top", 100)), 1000)))], "total_call_sites": sum(counts.values())})


def _tool_string_table_patterns(data, args):
    src = _source_text(data); scan = _masked_source(src); rows = []
    for m in re.finditer(r"\b(?:local\s+)?([A-Za-z_]\w*)\s*=\s*\{", scan):
        start = m.end()-1; end = scan.find("}", start+1)
        if end < 0: continue
        body = scan[start+1:end]; string_count = len(re.findall(r"(?:\"(?:\\.|[^\"])*\"|'(?:\\.|[^'])*')", src[start+1:end]))
        numeric_keys = len(re.findall(r"\[\s*\d+\s*\]\s*=", body)); indexed_refs = len(re.findall(r"\b" + re.escape(m.group(1)) + r"\s*\[", scan))
        if string_count >= 3 or numeric_keys >= 3 or indexed_refs >= 3:
            rows.append({"line": _adv_line(src, m.start()), "name": m.group(1), "string_entries": string_count, "numeric_keys": numeric_keys, "indexed_references": indexed_refs, "length": end-start-1, "candidate_role": "string/constant/opcode table; verify from references"})
    return _json({"tables": rows[:_arg(args, "top", 500)], "count": len(rows)})

def _tool_wad_deobf_bridge(data, args):
    _v4_require_explicit_external(args)
    inp = _v4_named_input(args)
    import shutil
    path = _arg(args, "tool_path", None)
    tool = None
    if path:
        p = Path(path).expanduser().resolve()
        if p.is_file(): tool = p
        elif p.is_dir():
            for rel in (".venv/bin/wad-deobf", ".venv/Scripts/wad-deobf.exe", "venv/bin/wad-deobf", "src/wad_deobf/__main__.py", "wad_deobf/__main__.py"):
                q = p / rel
                if q.is_file(): tool = q; break
        if tool is None: raise ValueError("--tool-path must point to wad-deobf executable or an installed repository layout")
    else:
        found = shutil.which("wad-deobf")
        if found: tool = Path(found)
    if tool is None: raise ValueError("Install AnnonyA/WAD-deobf or set --tool-path; upstream README: https://github.com/AnnonyA/WAD-deobf")
    mode = _arg(args, "engine", None) or "decompile"
    allowed = {"decompile": None, "strings": "--strings", "normalized": "--normalized", "vm-ir": "--vm-ir", "ir": "--ir", "diagnostics": "--diagnostics"}
    if mode not in allowed: raise ValueError("--engine must be one of: " + ", ".join(allowed))
    out = _arg(args, "bridge_output", None)
    if mode == "decompile" and not out: raise ValueError("set --bridge-output for the recovered source")
    if tool.suffix.lower() == ".py": cmd = [sys.executable, str(tool), str(inp)]
    else: cmd = [str(tool), str(inp)]
    if allowed[mode]: cmd.append(allowed[mode])
    if out: cmd.extend(["-o", str(Path(out).expanduser().resolve())])
    result = _v4_run_local(cmd, args, cwd=tool.parent, output_path=out)
    return _json({"adapter": "AnnonyA/WAD-deobf", "mode": mode, "result": result, "static_upstream_claim": "The upstream README says it parses text and does not execute the obfuscated payload.", "url": "https://github.com/AnnonyA/WAD-deobf"})

def _tool_lua_bytecode_header_guess(data, args):
    out = {"length": len(data), "first_32_hex": data[:32].hex(" "), "type_guess": _file_type(data), "possible_version_bytes": []}
    if len(data) >= 2:
        out["possible_version_bytes"] = [{"offset": i, "value": data[i], "hex": f"0x{data[i]:02x}"} for i in range(min(8, len(data))) if 3 <= data[i] <= 14]
    out["warning"] = "Candidate byte offsets are heuristic only; a proper Luau bytecode parser must validate the header and version." 
    return _json(out)


def _tool_hash_and_layer_manifest(data, args):
    best, states = _auto_decode(data, _arg(args, "depth", 7), _arg(args, "beam", 12))
    rows = []
    for blob, chain, score in states[:max(1, min(int(_arg(args, "top", 20)), 100))]:
        rows.append({"size": len(blob), "sha256": hashlib.sha256(blob).hexdigest(), "type": _file_type(blob), "entropy": round(shannon_entropy(blob), 5), "printable_ratio": round(printable_ratio(blob), 5), "score": round(score, 4), "transforms": [x["method"] for x in chain]})
    return _json({"input_sha256": hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(), "input_size": len(data), "candidates": rows, "selected_candidate_sha256": hashlib.sha256(best[0]).hexdigest(), "selected_chain": best[1]})


def _tool_lua_token_anomalies(data, args):
    src = _source_text(data); toks = tokenize_lua(src); stack = []; pairs = {"(": ")", "[": "]", "{": "}"}; issues = []
    for t in toks:
        if t.kind == "string" and len(t.value) and t.value[-1] not in ("'", '"', "]"):
            issues.append({"kind": "possibly_unclosed_string", "offset": t.start, "line": _adv_line(src, t.start)})
        if t.value in pairs: stack.append(t)
        elif t.value in pairs.values():
            if not stack or pairs[stack[-1].value] != t.value:
                issues.append({"kind": "unmatched_closer", "token": t.value, "offset": t.start, "line": _adv_line(src, t.start)})
            else: stack.pop()
    for t in stack:
        issues.append({"kind": "unclosed_opener", "token": t.value, "offset": t.start, "line": _adv_line(src, t.start)})
    return _json({"issues": issues[:_arg(args, "top", 500)], "issue_count": len(issues), "note": "Lexer-based diagnostics; not a full Luau parser."})

def _tool_bytewise_transform_hints(data, args):
    src = _source_text(data); scan = _masked_source(src)
    patterns = {
      "xor": r"\b(?:bit32\s*\.\s*bxor|bit\s*\.\s*bxor|\bxor\b|\^)",
      "and_masks": r"\b(?:bit32\s*\.\s*band|bit\s*\.\s*band|&|%\s*256)",
      "shifts": r"\b(?:bit32|bit)\s*\.\s*(?:lshift|rshift|arshift)\b|<<|>>",
      "modular_arithmetic": r"%\s*(?:256|255|65536|0x[0-9a-fA-F]+|\d+)",
      "rolling_state": r"\b([A-Za-z_]\w*)\s*=\s*\1\s*[*+^~%-]",
      "byte_reads": r"\bstring\s*\.\s*byte\s*\(|\bstring\s*\.\s*sub\s*\(|\bbuffer\s*\.\s*read\w*\s*\(",
      "byte_writes": r"\bstring\s*\.\s*char\s*\(|\bbuffer\s*\.\s*write\w*\s*\(",
    }
    return _json({"transform_hypotheses": _v4_pattern_hits(src, scan, patterns), "candidate_functions": json.loads(_tool_string_cipher_function_map(data, args)), "next_steps": ["Trace input/output types and byte order", "Record masks, shifts and state updates", "Validate against known plaintext or test vectors", "Do not identify an algorithm from one operator alone"]})


def _tool_secret_safe_export(data, args):
    result = _tool_safe_spy_bundle(data, args)
    target = _arg(args, "report", None)
    if target:
        Path(target).write_text(result, encoding="utf-8")
    return result
