def build_parser():
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="LuauLab Advanced", description="Self-contained Lua/Luau decoding, static analysis, VM research, safe spy reports, and guarded local tool adapters.")
    p.add_argument("--version", action="version", version="LuauLab All-In-One 6.0")
    subs = p.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)
    lp = subs.add_parser("list", help="list all available commands")
    lp.add_argument("--search", default="", help="filter commands by name/description")
    for name in TOOLS:
        sp = subs.add_parser(name, help=DESCRIPTIONS.get(name, "offline analysis tool"))
        sp.add_argument("input", nargs="?", default="-", help="input file path (default: stdin)")
        sp.add_argument("-o", "--output", help="save tool result to this file; safe for binary outputs")
        sp.add_argument("--literal", help="use given string as input instead of a file/stdin")
        sp.add_argument("--key", help="XOR key / integer byte key")
        sp.add_argument("--key-hex", help="hex byte sequence for XOR key")
        sp.add_argument("--top", type=int, default=20, help="maximum rows/candidates to report")
        sp.add_argument("--min-length", type=int, default=4, help="minimum extracted string length")
        sp.add_argument("--depth", type=int, default=7, help="maximum decode/pipeline depth")
        sp.add_argument("--beam", type=int, default=12, help="beam width for automatic decode search")
        sp.add_argument("--report", help="write JSON side report to this path when supported")
        sp.add_argument("--known-text", help="known plaintext fragment for xor-crib")
        sp.add_argument("--offset", type=int, default=0, help="offset of known plaintext inside ciphertext")
        sp.add_argument("--key-length", type=int, default=0, help="candidate repeated XOR key length")
        sp.add_argument("--max-key-length", type=int, default=32, help="maximum length to test for repeating-XOR recovery")
        sp.add_argument("--extract-dir", help="write recovered literal payloads as .txt files in this directory")
        sp.add_argument("--against", help="second source path for compare tools")
        sp.add_argument("--batch-dir", help="directory for batch-analysis")
        sp.add_argument("--limit", type=int, default=500, help="maximum files to process in a batch")
        sp.add_argument("--window-size", type=int, default=256, help="window size for rolling byte/entropy analysis")
        sp.add_argument("--step", type=int, default=128, help="step size for rolling byte/entropy analysis")
        sp.add_argument("--timeout", type=int, default=60, help="timeout for installed external CLIs")
        sp.add_argument("--debug-info", action="store_true", help="request bytecode debug info")
        sp.add_argument("--binary", action="store_true", help="request binary output from luau-compile")
        sp.add_argument("--json-path", help="extract one nested field from a JSON input")
        sp.add_argument("--symbol", help="focus state/variable analysis on a named identifier")
        sp.add_argument("--bridge-output", help="output path passed through to external decompiler (separate from report -o)")

        sp.add_argument("--tool-path", help="path to an already-installed upstream CLI/script or repository root")
        sp.add_argument("--engine", help="protector engine/version for upstream CLI, e.g. 14.7, 14.8, 14.9, 15")
        sp.add_argument("--allow-external-execution", action="store_true", help="explicitly allow launching the selected local upstream program")
        sp.add_argument("--detect-only", action="store_true", help="request upstream detect-only mode where supported")
    return p


def main(argv=None):
    parser = build_parser()
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    if args.command == "list":
        query = args.search.lower().strip()
        for i, name in enumerate(TOOLS, 1):
            desc = DESCRIPTIONS.get(name, "offline analysis tool")
            if query and query not in name.lower() and query not in desc.lower():
                continue
            print(f"{i:03d}. {name:<27} {desc}")
        print(f"\nTotal tools: {len(TOOLS)}")
        return 0
    try:
        if args.command in ("batch-analysis", "external-tools", "bytecode-toolchain-diagnose", "luau-parser-bridge", "published-toolchain-status", "luraph-latest-status", "external-tool-matrix", "upstream-tool-catalog", "upstream-project-index"):
            data = b""
        elif args.literal is not None:
            data = args.literal.encode("utf-8")
        elif args.input in (None, "-"):
            data = sys.stdin.buffer.read()
        else:
            data = Path(args.input).read_bytes()
        result = TOOLS[args.command](data, args)
        if isinstance(result, str): out = result.encode("utf-8"); binary = False
        elif isinstance(result, bytes): out = result; binary = True
        else: raise TypeError(f"unexpected output type: {type(result).__name__}")
        if args.output:
            Path(args.output).write_bytes(out)
            print(f"Saved {len(out)} bytes -> {args.output}")
        elif not binary:
            sys.stdout.write(result)
            if not result.endswith("\n"): sys.stdout.write("\n")
        else:
            try:
                text = result.decode("utf-8-sig")
                sys.stdout.write(text)
                if result and not text.endswith("\n"): sys.stdout.write("\n")
            except UnicodeDecodeError:
                print("Binary output; use -o OUTPUT to save it.")
                print("First 256 bytes (hex):", out[:256].hex(" "))
        return 0
    except (OSError, ValueError, UnicodeError, TypeError, KeyError) as exc:
        print(f"ERROR: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 2

if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
